# ![dsh-rewind](./icon.svg) dsh-rewind



[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-YIYuNCU%2Fdsh--rewind-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/YIYuNCU/dsh-rewind)

**DeepSeek Harness 的按轮回退插件。** 把文件改回某一轮开始时的内容，并另开会话。原来的会话记录保持不变。

- 每一轮开始时，记下工作区里符合条件的文件。快照放在工作区外面，不写进仓库的 Git 对象。
- 回退会撤掉这一轮之后的文件工具改动，以及两轮之间的手改和脚本改动。
- 回退对话时另开一个会话，不截断原来的记录。

界面语言为简体中文和 English。

## 安装

这是一个 DSH Profile Bundle。安装使用仓库里已经构建好的 `lib/`，不需要在本机再构建。

### 网页或桌面端

在 **添加插件** 的输入框填：

```text
github:YIYuNCU/dsh-rewind
```

`desktop` 这个 profile 由桌面端独占，不要运行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop`，也不要手改 profile 的 `package.json`。第一次启用如果提示无法导入，完全退出并重新打开客户端，再启用一次。

### 命令行

网页 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YIYuNCU/dsh-rewind
```

本地检出可以用相对路径或绝对路径：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-rewind
```

## 使用

每个用户回合末尾有 **回退这一轮**。打开后可以选择：

| 操作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 回退代码和对话 | 恢复文件，并另开一个会话 |
| 只回退代码 | 只恢复文件，当前会话不动 |
| 只回退对话 | 只另开会话，文件保持现状 |

没有可回退的文件时，仍然可以只回退对话。文件恢复失败时不会另开会话。同一工作区还有代理在跑时，默认不允许改文件。

设置在插件详情页，不在客户端的设置面板里。改完立即生效。

## 设置

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 跳过生成目录 | 开 | 不记录「生成目录」里列出的目录，回退时也不删除它们 |
| 生成目录 | 常见语言的生成目录和临时目录 | 目录名用逗号分开，按路径中的一整段匹配。`*.egg-info` 匹配以 `.egg-info` 结尾的目录。这里填的是完整名单。`build`、`bin`、`obj`、`out`、`vendor`、`Library` 这类较宽的名字可以删掉 |
| 记录回合之间的改动 | 开 | 每轮开始时记下工作区。之后的手改和脚本改动，回退到这一轮时撤掉 |
| 记录子代理 | 开 | 子代理改的文件算到父会话当前这一轮 |
| 命令工具 | 标明跑过命令 | 只标明这一轮跑过命令，不给命令做快照。合格文件仍回到这一轮开始时的内容。另一项是「不标明」 |
| 文件冲突 | 询问 | 文件已经和记录不一致时：询问、跳过，或覆盖 |
| 删除本轮新建的文件 | 开 | 关闭后，这一轮新建的文件留在原地 |
| 把原话放回输入框 | 开 | 回退对话后，把当时的用户消息放进新会话的输入框 |
| 运行中禁止改文件 | 开 | 同一工作区还有代理在跑时，不允许回退代码 |
| 保留天数 | 30 | `0` 表示不按天数删除 |
| 最大存储空间 | 2048 MiB | 全部会话加在一起的上限。超出后丢掉最旧的一轮，至少保留一轮 |
| 最大存储轮数 | 1000 | 全部会话加在一起最多保留这么多轮 |
| 保存地址 | 默认目录 | 留空使用默认目录。保存后把已有文件转移到新地址。新地址须为空或不存在，且不能位于工作区内 |

生成目录、符号链接、硬链接，以及超过大小或数量上限的文件，不会自动撤掉。单个文件默认不超过 8 MiB，一轮默认最多记录 2000 个文件。

默认保存地址是 `$DSH_HOME/rewind/v1`。没有该变量时用 `~/.dsh/rewind/v1`。在插件详情页改地址时，已有文件会一起转移。

## 兼容

`package.json` 声明的 DeepSeek Harness 版本：

```text
>=0.1.0-rc.8 <0.2.0 || ^0.1.7-rc.1 || 0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.2
```

Node.js：`^22.19.0 || >=24`。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
```

`pnpm test` 会先构建 `lib/`，再运行测试。测试覆盖修改前记录、失败工具、命令缺口、冲突、新建文件、排除路径、符号链接、保留上限、回合之间的手改，以及中断回退后的启动补偿。

## 许可证

[BSD-3-Clause](LICENSE)

plugins.description: On-demand tool loading for DeepSeek Harness: browse every tool as a directory, load only what you need.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-tool-manager (monorepo) English | [中文](README.zh.md) On-demand tool loading for DeepSeek Harness: every tool is browsable as a directory (category → group → tool) and only what an agent loads reaches the model's context. Built as a small core plus replaceable extension plugins. ## Quick start ```sh # 1. install the core plus the rule-based classifier (optional but recommended) dsh plugin --profile web add @lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager @lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-classifier-rules # 2. restart DSH, then ask the agent: "what tools do you have?" # it answers with tools_ls("/") — a directory, not 200 tool schemas # 3. want the UI? add the panel, then open Settings → "Tool manager" dsh plugin --profile web add @lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-panel ``` > **Install the scoped `@lvy-jsd/…` packages.** The unscoped `dsh-tool-manager` > on npm is a different project. Do not install both: each one narrows which > tools an agent can see, so together they hide tools from each other. On a fresh install every group is `uncategorized` until a classifier is installed — the tools are still browsable and loadable, only the categories are missing. See [Extending](#extending) to write your own classifier. | Package | What it does | |---|---| | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager`](packages/dsh-tool-manager) | Core: directory, `tools_ls` / `tools_load` / `tools_unload`, per-agent allowlist, the `toolCatalog` extension service. Without extensions every group is `uncategorized`. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-classifier-rules`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-classifier-rules) | Places groups into categories from built-in rules and your config overrides. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-risk-gate`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-risk-gate) | Confirms loading high-risk tools through the DSH approval channel, with a per-session allowlist. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-persist`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-persist) | Keeps loaded tools across a DSH restart, one state file per session. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-panel`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-panel) | Web panel: browse the tree, see each live session's loaded tools and token cost, load/unload from the UI, edit the always-on and high-risk lists, edit one tool's metadata, exempt one session. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-classifier-llm`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-classifier-llm) | Places groups with a small model, one request per group, cached by a hash of the group and its tool descriptions. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-capability-bridge`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-capability-bridge) | Load a named bundle of tools in one call: `tools_load(["cap:android-debug"])`. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-attribution-scan`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-attribution-scan) | Group tools by the plugin package whose source defines them. | | [`@lvy-jsd/dsh-tool-manager-dsbot-entry`](packages/dsh-tool-manager-dsbot-entry) | A "Tool manager" row in the ds-bot settings dialog that opens the panel. | | [`@lvy-jsd/create-tool-manager-plugin`](packages/create-tool-manager-plugin) | Scaffold your own extension: `npm create @lvy-jsd/tool-manager-plugin@latest my-ext -- --type classifier`. | See [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) for the design. ## Extending Every feature beyond the core is an ordinary plugin using the `toolCatalog` service, and the bundled `classifier-rules` package is written exactly as a third party would write it. Four extension points: | Point | For | |---|---| | `registerClassifier({ name, priority, group?, categorize? })` | placing tools into groups and groups into categories | | `annotate(match, { group?, category?, risk?, summary? })` | runtime metadata; `package.json` `dsh.toolCatalog` does the same without code | | `registerVisibilityFilter({ name, filter(agent, names) })` | narrowing what one agent may see — can only remove names | | `registerTargetResolver({ name, prefix, resolve })` | owning a target prefix, e.g. `cap:` | | `registerRiskGate` / `registerStateProvider` | confirming high-risk loads / keeping state across a restart | Hooks are plain events: `tool-catalog/before-load` (throw to veto), `after-load`, `before-unload`, `after-unload`, `before-rebuild`, `after-rebuild`, `state-changed`. Start from a generated package — it comes with a passing test: ```sh npm create @lvy-jsd/tool-manager-plugin@latest my-ext -- --type classifier cd my-ext && npm test ``` Two worked examples live in [`examples/`](examples), and the full interface list is in the core README and [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) §11. ## Develop and test Every package is written in TypeScript (`src/`) and compiled to `lib/` (JavaScript plus `.d.ts` type declarations); `lib/` is build output and not committed. The root `tsconfig.json` lists the packages (project references); the two browser halves (`client.ts`) have their own `tsconfig.client.json`, because DSH loads them as classic scripts, not modules. ```sh npm install # also links your local DSH host packages (scripts/link-host.mjs) npm run build # src/*.ts -> lib/*.js + lib/*.d.ts npm run typecheck # strict type check (tsc -b; writes lib/ too, references need it) node --test test/unit/*.test.mjs # pure catalog and registry tests (needs a build) node test/e2e.mjs # boots throwaway DSH instances; never touches your profile ``` Host packages (`@deepseek-ai/*`) are peers and are never installed from the registry (`.npmrc` sets `legacy-peer-deps`): a registry copy next to the plugin would shadow the DSH you actually run. `npm install` links them from `$DSH_APP` (default `~/.local/share/deepseek-harness/app`) instead. The end-to-end test boots the shipped `headless` profile in a temporary `DSH_HOME` once per profile (`core`, `rules`, `preset`, `persist`, `attr`, `attr-rules`, `exempt`, `gate`, `cap`, `llm`), with a test kit plugin and a scripted fake OpenAI-compatible model that records the exact tool list of every model request. The panel's server half is covered by unit tests that serve its routes over a real HTTP socket. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Proxmox VE VM control for DeepSeek Harness: see and click inside a VM console over VNC, plus commands, files and Unicode text through the QEMU guest agent.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pve-vm

**Proxmox VE VM control for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness): see a VM's screen and click in its console over VNC, plus commands, files and typed text through the QEMU guest agent.**

Almost every computer-use plugin drives the desktop the agent itself runs on — and therefore needs
X11 or Wayland, a screenshot tool and an input injector on that host. This plugin does something
different: it drives **the console of a virtual machine on a Proxmox VE node**, over one ssh
connection. The host can be a headless server, a Wayland desktop or a laptop in another country;
the guest can be Windows, Linux with any GUI, or a machine that has not booted yet.

```
agent ──► plugin ──► ssh ──► node: qm vncproxy ──► unix socket /var/run/qemu-server/<vmid>.vnc
                      └────► node: qm guest exec ──► qemu-guest-agent inside the VM
```

## What you get

* **Pixels** — `console_shot` returns the VM screen as an inline image (with `region` and `scale`
  to keep the token cost sane), and mouse/keyboard tools operate in VM screen coordinates: move,
  click, double click, drag, wheel, type, key combinations, and a batch runner that performs a
  chain of actions and returns a single frame at the end.
* **Commands** — `vm_exec`, `vm_file_read`, `vm_file_write`, `vm_status` through the QEMU guest
  agent. Deterministic and cheap: use pixels only where a GUI really is in the way.
* **Reliable input** — uppercase goes through Caps Lock (`qm monitor` → HMP `sendkey`), shifted
  symbols through RFB keysyms with a settle delay. This is what makes typing a password on the
  Windows login screen work instead of producing `xxXX` → `xxxX`.
* **Unicode text** — a Windows guest gets a scheduled task in the logged-in user's session
  (`SendKeys`), a Linux guest gets `xdotool`/`wtype` through the guest agent. Layout and
  modifiers stop mattering.
* **Clipboard** — `console_paste` writes UTF-8 text into the guest clipboard over RFB and presses
  Ctrl+V; `console_clipboard` reads the guest clipboard back, so text can leave the VM without OCR.
* **A settings card** in the web UI (English, Russian and Chinese labels), backed by the profile patch
  layer.
* **A live screen panel** — the “VM screen” tab in the right sidebar shows the frames the agent
  sees, taken from the very same VNC session, while the agent works. It follows the agent's VM
  automatically or stays on the VM you pick by hand. Watching only: the panel never clicks or types.
* **Zero runtime dependencies** — RFB, DES authentication, keysym tables and PNG encoding are
  implemented in this package on top of `node:crypto` and `node:zlib`. There is nothing to install
  on the host, and nothing to install on the node either.

Verified against `pve-manager 8.4.21` with Windows 11 / Windows Server 2025 and Linux guests, on
DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`.

## Requirements

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness **≥ 0.2.0-rc.2** | The plugin uses the 0.2.x plugin contract (`defineTool`, `ctx.tools`, `ctx.subprocess`, `ctx.attachments`, the `computerUse` slot, client-side `configForms`). It does not load on 0.1.x. |
| Node.js **≥ 22** | The harness runtime. |
| A **Proxmox VE** node with the `qm` CLI | `/usr/sbin/qm vncproxy`, `qm guest exec`, `qm monitor`. Containers (LXC) are not supported. |
| **SSH access to that node as `root`** (or an account that may run `qm`) | `qm` needs root on the node. Key-based access is expected (`BatchMode`, no password prompts). |
| **`AcceptEnv LC_*` in the node's `sshd_config`** | The VNC password is handed to `qm` as the `LC_PVE_TICKET` environment variable via `SendEnv`, so it never appears in `ps`. Without `AcceptEnv`, ssh silently drops it and the console cannot authenticate. |
| Host key already accepted | Connections run with `BatchMode=yes`; an unknown host key fails. Run `ssh <node>` once by hand, or add `StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new` to `sshExtraOptions`. |
| `qemu-guest-agent` **inside the guest** (optional) | Only the `vm_*` tools need it. Console tools work without any agent at all. |

## Install

```bash
# 1. Add the bundle
dsh plugin --profile web add github:taxah92/dsh-pve-vm

# 2. Make sure the bundle is enabled in the profile: dsh.profile.bundles must list "dsh-pve-vm"
#    (the plugin manager / market toggle does the same thing)

# 3. Restart the harness:  the host half of a plugin is loaded once per process
```

The plugin adds one row to the profile patch layer:

```yaml
- id: pve-vm
  name: dsh-pve-vm
```

The row id `pve-vm` **is** the settings namespace — do not rename it, or the settings card and the
patch layer will stop finding each other.

## Configure

Settings ▸ Plugins ▸ **Proxmox VE** in the web UI. Everything is written into the profile patch
layer, and the same values can be edited there by hand:

```yaml
- id: pve-vm
  name: dsh-pve-vm
  config:
    sshHost: proxmox            # alias from ~/.ssh/config, or an address
    sshUser: root
    sshPort: 22
    sshKeyPath: ''              # empty — default keys
    sshConfigFile: ''           # like `ssh -F`
    sshExtraOptions: []         # extra -o options, one per item
    allowVmids: [100, 101]      # VMs the plugin may touch; empty list forbids everything
    enableConsole: true
    enableGuest: true
    inputChannel: auto          # auto | hmp | vnc
    sendkeyDelayMs: 80
    consoleTimeoutMs: 20000
    sessionIdleMs: 300000
    guestTimeoutMs: 60000
    guestTypeCommand: ''        # script for typing non-ASCII text into a Linux guest
    viewAutoOpen: false         # open the "VM screen" tab by itself when the agent touches a console
    viewFollowAgent: true       # the panel follows the VM the agent works with
    viewFps: 2                  # frame pace in the panel, 1–4
    viewScale: 2                # frame resolution divisor: 1 native, 2 half, 4 quarter
```

**First run checklist**

1. `allowVmids` is empty by default — **nothing is allowed until you list a VM id**. This is the
   only gate the plugin has.
2. `ssh <alias> 'qm status <vmid>'` should work from the host without a password prompt.
3. `ssh <alias> sshd -T | grep -i acceptenv` must include `LC_*` (see Requirements).
4. Call `vm_status` — it reports whether the VM is allowed, whether the guest agent answers, which
   guest OS was detected, and whether a console session is open.

## Tools

### Console (VNC)

| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `console_shot` | `vmid`, `region?`, `scale?`, `drawCursor?`, `wake?` | Frame as an inline image. `scale` 1 / 0.5 / 0.25, `region` in VM pixels. Nearly uniform frames are flagged as `blank` (a blanked display or a locked screen). |
| `console_move` | `vmid`, `x`, `y`, `observe?`, `wake?`, `settleMs?`, `scale?`, `region?` | Move the pointer. |
| `console_click` | `vmid`, `x`, `y`, `button?`, `count?`, `observe?`, … | Click (2 = double click); returns a frame by default. |
| `console_drag` | `vmid`, `fromX`, `fromY`, `toX`, `toY`, `button?`, … | Drag — move a window, select a region. |
| `console_scroll` | `vmid`, `x`, `y`, `delta`, … | Wheel: positive scrolls up, negative down. |
| `console_type` | `vmid`, `text`, … | Printable ASCII only, `\n` presses Enter. Capitals go through Caps Lock, so expect ≈0.1 s per character. |
| `console_key` | `vmid`, `combo`, … | `enter`, `esc`, `tab`, `ctrl+alt+del`, `win+r`, `alt+f4`, `ctrl+shift+esc`, `f5`, and modifier-only combinations such as `alt+shift` (layout switch). |
| `console_paste` | `vmid`, `text`, `submit?`, … | Put any Unicode text into the guest clipboard and press Ctrl+V. Needs the clipboard-enabled VGA device and a SPICE agent. |
| `console_batch` | `vmid`, `actions[]`, `observe?`, … | A chain of actions (`move`, `click`, `drag`, `scroll`, `type`, `key`, `wait`) and one frame at the end. |
| `console_clipboard` | `vmid`, `timeoutMs?` | Read the guest text clipboard (extended VNC clipboard). Empty means "no text". |
| `console_release` | `vmid` | Close the console session (emergency brake: releases the ssh child and the QEMU connection). |

Every action tool accepts a common tail: `observe` (return a frame after the action, default true),
`wake` (Shift + poin

plugins.description: DSH 技能插件：按目标工程真实 C++ 标准审查代码，覆盖 RAII 与所有权、移动语义与值类别、异常安全、性能与内存、并发安全、编译期与 ABI；默认先出报告、用户确认后才改代码。
plugins.readme_text:
# @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

一个给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的 bundle 插件包，装好后提供一个 skill：**`cpp-opt-audit`**，用于审查或编写「又快又安全」的底层 C++ 代码。

它的核心约束是**先确认目标工程真实的 C++ 标准**：探测不到就问用户，标准确认之前不推荐、不写入任何高于该标准的特性。结论全部带着「检查点 / 为什么 / 反例→正例 / 适用标准」四要素。

## 安装

用 dsh CLI 装到指定 profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization
```

`--profile` 填要装到的 profile（这里按 web 写，`tui`、`desktop` 等同理）；`dsh plugin` 之后的参数会原样交给 pnpm，所以从本地目录安装时把包名换成目录的绝对路径即可：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库目录的绝对路径>
```

本包是 bundle 插件：安装时会写入该 profile 的包依赖，并选中本包的 `cordis.patch.yml`。**不要手动改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`，也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm。**

备选方式：在 DSH 会话里让智能体用 `plugin_manager` 工具的 `install_bundle` 动作安装，`target` 同样传包名或目录的绝对路径。

安装后无需重启即可在会话目录里看到 `cpp-opt-audit`；如果替换了已安装的同名包，需要重启以加载新的模块。

## 使用

- 模型自动触发：任务涉及 C++ 代码审查、优化、底层实现时，会话目录会提示模型先加载该 skill。
- 用户显式调用：直接输入 `/cpp-opt-audit`。

skill 的工作方式是**两阶段**：默认只读审查并输出带证据的报告，得到同意后才改代码。

## 内容结构

```
assets/cpp-opt-audit/
├── SKILL.md                          # 入口：硬规则、四阶段工作流、高频检查点速查表
└── references/
    ├── standard-detection.md         # 标准探测步骤、__cplusplus 校验、17/20/23 降级映射
    ├── audit-report-template.md      # 报告结构、P0/P1/P2 分级、单条问题写法
    ├── raii-ownership.md             # 一、RAII 与所有权（15 条）
    ├── move-value-categories.md      # 二、移动语义与值类别（12 条）
    ├── exception-safety.md           # 三、异常安全（14 条）
    ├── performance-memory.md         # 四、性能与内存（13 条）
    ├── containers-algorithms.md      # 五、容器与算法（7 条）
    ├── concurrency.md                # 六、并发安全（14 条）
    ├── templates-compile-time.md     # 七、模板与编译期（9 条）
    ├── standard-boundary.md          # 八、标准边界与 C++20/23 机制（24 + 11 条）
    ├── type-safety-abi.md            # 九、类型安全与 ABI（13 条）
    └── interface-design.md           # 十、对象语义与接口设计（13 条）
```

检查点按九个维度逐条整理（类型安全、ABI 与接口设计合为一个维度，共十个参考文件），每条标注适用标准；各文件末尾单列了尚未覆盖的主题，避免把「没查到」当成「没问题」。

## 作为纯文件 skill 使用

不想装插件时，把 `assets/cpp-opt-audit/` 整个目录复制到 skill 扫描根即可，例如：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`
- 项目级：`<工程根>/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`

目录名即 skill 名，`SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter 会被自动解析。

## 开发

本包是 Host-only bundle：零运行时依赖、无构建步骤，`index.js` 直接作为入口导出 `apply`/`inject`/`name`。

```bash
node --check index.js                                  # 语法检查
node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => console.log(m.name, m.inject))"
```

插件在 `apply(ctx)` 里用 `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)` 注册一个提供方，`list()` 解析 `SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter 生成目录条目，`get()` 每次重新读取正文（因此编辑 skill 内容无需重新安装）。

## 发布

```bash
npm publish --access public
```

`package.json` 中的 `repository` 字段请改成你自己的仓库地址。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器与插件——读已有配置而非要求作者重新移植，并明确报告哪些能跑、哪些缺密钥、哪些跑不了。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-babel **让 DSH 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器、插件与斜杠命令。** > 读它们已有的配置，而不是要求插件作者为 DSH 重新移植一遍。 [![简体中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-red.svg)](README.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue.svg)](README.en.md) [![test](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2EA44F?style=flat)](LICENSE) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel?style=flat&label=%E2%98%85)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2563eb.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
> dsh-babel 是社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，并非 DeepSeek AI 官方产品。 ## 它解决什么问题 插件作者要支持一个平台，就得为它单独写一份目录。一个典型的多平台插件会带六到八个这样的目录： ``` .claude-plugin .codex-plugin .cursor .gemini-extension.json ... ``` DSH 的那个格子通常是空的。dsh-babel 换个思路：**作者不用动，DSH 这边读他们已有的 `.mcp.json` / `commands/`**，把 N×M 的移植问题变成 N×1。 同时它做一件别家没做的事：**装之前就告诉你哪个能跑、哪个缺密钥、哪个根本跑不起来**——而不是装上去之后静默失败。 ## 功能 - **发现**：扫描 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件目录下的 `.mcp.json`，以及两种斜杠命令文件（`.md` / `.toml`）；根目录可配置。 - **归一化**：把多种 `.mcp.json` 方言（带 `mcpServers` 包装的 / 裸顶层的 / Codex 专有键的）降成**一套中间表示**。 - **预检**：四类检查把"静默失败"变成"明确原因"——依赖命令是否在 `PATH`、守护进程是否在跑（如 Docker socket）、密钥是否可用、版本是否未固定。 - **兼容性报告**：把每个服务器归入「可用 / 需密钥 / 不可用」，每条都附具体原因。 - **命令注册**：把发现到的斜杠命令注册进 DSH，支持 `{{args}}` / `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1` 参数替换。 - **MCP 注册**：连上 stdio 或 streamable-http 服务器，用 DSH 自己的 `createMcpToolDefinition` 注册工具。 - **密钥解析**：`process.env` 优先，其次 macOS 钥匙串的**白名单**（仅 GitHub token 家族）——绝不无差别翻钥匙串。 - **展示元数据**：`locale/` 文案与图标，配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，设置界面可渲染。 ## 安装 ```bash # 从 GitHub plugin_manager install_bundle github:Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel # 或本地目录 plugin_manager install_bundle /绝对/路径/dsh-babel ``` 也可以在 DSH Desktop 里走 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填入仓库地址或本地路径。 安装后默认 **dry-run**：只在日志里打印兼容性报告，**不注册任何东西**。 ## 配置 配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，因此会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → dsh-babel** 的配置界面里： | 配置项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `roots` | `[]` | 扫描根目录；字符串路径或 `{ source, path }`。留空时使用默认的 Claude / Codex 插件目录 | | `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告，不注册。要真正注册必须先设为 `false` | | `logReport` | `true` | 把兼容性报告打印到日志 | | `registerCommands` | `false` | 注册发现到的斜杠命令（需 `dryRun: false`） | | `registerMcp` | `false` | 注册预检通过（`severity: ok`）的 MCP 服务器（需 `dryRun: false`） | 开启真注册： ```yaml config: dryRun: false registerCommands: true registerMcp: true ``` ## 兼容矩阵（诚实版） | 外部形态 | 覆盖 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | MCP `.mcp.json`（stdio） | ✅ 高 | 免密钥、依赖命令存在的，基本可用 | | MCP `.mcp.json`（http/sse） | ✅ 高 | 依赖 bearer token 的会标「需密钥」 | | MCP（依赖宿主运行时变量） | ⚠️ 有损 | `CODEX_*` / `CLAUDE_*` 等对方宿主注入的变量，DSH 没有，标为不可用 | | MCP（OAuth） | ❌ 无对应 | `oauth_resource` 等 DSH 无等价物，丢弃并告知 | | 技能 `skills/*/SKILL.md` | ✅ 高 | 格式统一（由 skills-manager 等已有实现覆盖） | | 斜杠命令 `commands/*` | ✅ 已实现 | 发现 + 归一化 + 报告 + 注册 | | Hooks | ⚠️ 有损 | DSH 仅 7 个点、仅 command handler | | 子代理 `agents/*` | ⚠️ 降级 | DSH 无注册接口，只能降级为技能 | | 插件 UI / mods | ❌ 不支持 | 必须用 DSH client 插件重写，无法移植 | ## 报告长什么样 在一台装了 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件的机器上，首次加载会打印： ``` === dsh-babel 兼容性报告 === 文件: 28 服务器: 28 方言: {"bare":14,"wrapped":14} 传输: {"stdio":17,"streamable-http":11} 结论: 可用 14 / 需密钥 5 / 不可用 9 ✗ 不可用 (9): laravel-boost [stdio] BLOCKED - [command] command not on PATH: php terraform [stdio] BLOCKED - [daemon] docker installed but not running (no socket / probe failed) - [secret] missing credential: TFE_TOKEN codex_app [stdio] BLOCKED - [env] depends on CODEX_MCP_NODE_PATH (other-harness runtime), not available in DSH ``` 这就是这个插件的第二个价值：**明确告诉你为什么跑不起来**，而不是让用户以为「DSH 很烂」。 ## 目录结构 ``` index.js 插件入口（apply + schemastery Config，Cordis 宿主插件形式） cordis.patch.yml bundle patch（插入 dsh-babel 一行） locale/zh.json 卡片展示文案（标题 + 简介） locale/en.json same, in English icon.svg 插件图标 lib/normalize.mjs 内核：方言 → IR lib/discover.mjs 发现：遍历文件系统找声明 lib/preflight.mjs 预检：命令 / daemon / 密钥 / 版本 lib/secrets.mjs 密钥解析：env 为主 + 钥匙串白名单兜底 lib/commands.mjs 命令归一化：.md / .toml → 命令 IR lib/register.mjs 命令注册：ctx.commands.register + 参数替换 lib/register-mcp.mjs MCP 注册：连接 + createMcpToolDefinition + 工具注册 lib/report.mjs 报告：聚合 + 文本渲染 bin/dsh-babel.mjs CLI runner（本地测试用） test/ 单测 + 冒烟 docs/ 详细文档 CHANGELOG.md 版本变更记录 ``` ## 开发与测试 ```bash npm test # 全部单测（75 断言） node test/mcp-smoke.mjs # MCP 注册冒烟（需本地 symlink 到 DSH 包 + 真实服务器） node bin/dsh-babel.mjs # 直接跑一次报告 ``` ## 文档 - [功能详解](docs/FEATURES.md) - [配置参考](docs/CONFIG.md) - [兼容性说明](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) - [架构与中间表示](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [版本变更](CHANGELOG.md) ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Deep Feishu / Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness: Bitable (multidimensional tables), docs, sheets, wiki, drive, messages, plus a visual settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-feishu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Deep **Feishu / Lark** integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

It gives the agent eight tools that act on a real Feishu tenant (and a browser
panel that shows what it did and fixes authorization in one click):

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `feishu_bitable` | Create **Bitable (多维表格)** apps with their tables and fields in one call; list tables and fields; insert, search, update, and delete records in batches |
| `feishu_dashboard` | Create dashboards and **chart blocks** inside a Bitable (柱状图 / 折线图 / 饼图 / 排行榜 / 指标卡 / NPS … 15 types), position them, and read a chart's computed numbers |
| `feishu_query` | Run a **grouped, aggregated query** over a table (group by, sum / avg / min / max / count / distinct_count, filter, sort, top-N) with the aggregation done server-side |
| `feishu_doc` | Create documents; append Markdown (converted to native blocks), append raw blocks, read plain text, or import a local Markdown/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF file as a new cloud document |
| `feishu_sheet` | Create spreadsheets; add sheets; read, write, and append ranges |
| `feishu_drive` | Browse folders, create folders, upload and download files, move, delete, read metadata |
| `feishu_wiki` | List wiki spaces and nodes, resolve a wiki token to its document, create and move nodes |
| `feishu_message` | Send text, interactive cards, rich posts, files, and images; reply in a thread; post through a custom-bot webhook |
| `feishu_auth` | Diagnose authorization, produce the authorization URL, complete a manual code exchange, refresh, and log out |
| `feishu_api` | Call any documented Feishu open-platform path, with the same auth, retry, and error mapping |

New content lands in **the user's own cloud drive** because the tools act as the
authorized user, not as the app. When no user grant is stored they fall back to
the app identity and say so in a warning rather than silently filing documents
into a space the user cannot see.

---

## Quick start

### 1. Create a Feishu app

1. Open the [Feishu Open Platform](https://open.feishu.cn/app) (or
   [Lark](https://open.larksuite.com/app)) and create a **custom app**.
2. Under **凭证与基础信息**, note the **App ID** and **App Secret**.
3. Under **安全设置 → 重定向 URL**, add the callback this plugin serves:

   ```
   http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/feishu/oauth/callback
   ```

   The port is whatever DeepSeek Harness serves on (the plugin reads it from the
   host and reports the exact URI in `feishu_auth` action `status`).
4. Under **权限管理**, add the scopes below, then **publish a version** — scopes
   only apply after the version is released:

   | Scope | Needed for |
   |---|---|
   | `offline_access` | **Required** — without it Feishu returns no refresh token and the user must re-authorize every couple of hours |
   | `bitable:app` | Bitable |
   | `docx:document` | Documents |
   | `drive:drive` | Drive, imports, uploads |
   | `sheets:spreadsheet` | Spreadsheets |
   | `wiki:wiki` | Wiki |
   | `im:message`, `im:resource` | Messages and file/image sending |
   | `contact:user.base:readonly` | Reading the authorized user's name |

### 2. Enable the plugin

See [Install](#install) below, then restart DeepSeek Harness.

### 3. Configure it in the GUI

Open **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu**. Everything is editable there — no YAML by hand:

- **应用凭据** — the App ID, the App Secret (write-only), the credential
  reference name, and the brand (飞书 / Lark).
- **默认落点与身份** — the folder new content lands in, and which identity the
  tools use by default.
- **功能开关** — whether the tools register, whether the HTTP routes mount,
  whether the floating panel shows, and the tool-name prefix.
- **授权** — the scopes to request and the redirect URL to register.
- **高级** — endpoint overrides and the page-size caps.

**Saving writes only this plugin's entry** in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`,
which the harness hot-reloads, so most changes apply without a restart. The App
Secret is *never* written to that file: it goes straight into the credential
store under the reference name, and the page only ever shows whether it is set.

### 4. Authorize

Press **授权飞书** on the settings page, or ask the agent to run `feishu_auth`
with action `authorize_url`. The browser lands on the callback, the grant is
stored, and every later call acts as that user. The same form shows the redirect
URL to register on the Feishu app and lists the scopes to grant.

> Host without a reachable browser callback (a remote or headless session)? Open
> the URL anywhere, then pass the `code` query parameter to `feishu_auth` with
> action `complete`.

---

## Install

Two ways, and they are alternatives — **do not do both.** Each creates a loader
entry with id `feishu`, and the loader rejects a composition that defines one id
twice with `duplicate loader entry id`.

### As a bundle (recommended)

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so a bundle-aware CLI installs and
mounts it in one step:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:2048lr/dsh-feishu
```

That appends `dsh-feishu` to `dsh.profile.bundles` and profile boot merges
[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml), which inserts the plugin row. Nothing else
needs editing.

The settings page is aware of this: when the profile mounts the bundle, it writes
an **id-targeted config override** rather than a second `insert`, so saving from
the GUI never breaks the composition.

### By hand (no CLI)

The plugin must be resolvable from the profile's `node_modules`, so it is copied
there:

```powershell
# from the repository root
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1
```

The script copies the package into the profile's `node_modules` and inserts the
entry into `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: feishu
      name: dsh-feishu
      config:
        appId: cli_xxxxxxxxxxxx
        # appSecretRef: FEISHU_APP_SECRET
        # brand: feishu          # or lark
        # defaultFolderToken: fldcnxxxxxxxx
```

**Restart DeepSeek Harness.** The host half is a Node module cached in-process,
so a reload alone does not pick it up. The browser half reloads with the page.

After that first restart, use **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu** instead of editing the YAML:
the page rewrites the block the installer added and the harness hot-reloads it.

### Why the package avoids `@deepseek-ai/*` imports

A third-party plugin is loaded from a junction or a copied directory inside the
profile, where a bare `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` specifier resolves to whichever
DSH installation is reachable — which may not be the running host. The host half
therefore imports **only Node builtins** and hand-writes its tool definitions
and its configuration validation. The test suite checks every generated schema
against the real SDK validator, so the hand-written form cannot drift from what
the registry accepts.

---

## Configuration

All fields are optional except `appId`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `appId` | — | The Feishu app id. Required. |
| `appSecretRef` | `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | Credential reference resolved through the harness credential store, then the environment. |
| `appSecret` | `''` | Literal fallback. Discouraged: it puts a secret in configuration. |
| `brand` | `feishu` | `feishu` (open.feishu.cn) or `lark` (open.larksuite.com). |
| `apiBaseUrl` / `accountsBaseUrl` | per brand | Override the endpoints (for a proxy or a private gateway). |
| `defaultFolderToken` | `''` | Where new documents, sheets, Bitable apps, and uploads go when a call omits a folder. |
| `defaultIdentity` | `auto` | `auto`, `user`, or `app`. `auto` uses the user when authorized and otherwise the app, reporting the fallback. |
| `toolPrefix` | `feishu_` | Rename the tools (for example `fs_`). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt timeout. |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | Total attempts for rate-limited or transient failures (capped at 6). |
| `enableTools` | `true` | Register the model-facing tools. |
| `enableOAuth` | `true` | Mount the `/api/feishu/*` routes (status, activity, config, OAuth). |
| `enableUi` | `true` | Show the floating panel. |
| `oauthRedirectUri` | auto | Override the callback. Empty means "use

# dsh-claude-code-theme **Claude Desktop's visual language for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.** Warm paper neutrals, terracotta accent, readable prose, quiet layered surfaces and a continuous composer — applied through DSH's own theme extension point, not by patching its stylesheets. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-code-theme) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](./LICENSE)
## Before and after Stock DSH — right-aligned bubble on a blue-tinted canvas, soft 12–28px corners, a floating composer with a circular send button: With the theme — a deeper sidebar, a raised right-hand panel, prose set for reading, compact tool summaries, and a continuous composer: Light mode, on Claude's cream canvas with white raised sheets: --- ## Install ```sh dsh plugin install dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Or add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and its package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```yaml - insert: - id: claude-code-theme name: dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Reload the Web GUI. There is nothing to switch on: the theme composes over whichever palette you already use, so `light`, `dark` and `system` all keep working. ## What changes **Colour.** DSH's design system has three token tiers, and the theme works on all three: | Tier | What it is | What the theme does | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-static-*` | The raw colour ramps | Retints DSH's blue-tinted greys to Claude's warm paper greys, and DeepSeek blue to terracotta. The alias tier resolves through these, so this alone recolours most of the application. | | `--dsw-alias-*` | The semantic roles components consume | Pins the roles Claude treats differently: a cream canvas under raised sheets, a terracotta primary button and focus ring, warm hairlines, and text that stops short of pure white on dark. | | `--dsw-specific-*` | Named surfaces | Retunes the sidebar, composer, bubbles, menus and code surfaces. | **Surface hierarchy.** Claude Desktop stacks depth rather than flattening it, so the theme gives each column its own level instead of one shared grey: | Region | Dark | Light | | --- | --- | --- | | Sidebar | `#111110` (deepest) | `#f5f3ec` | | Canvas | `#171716` | `#faf9f5` | | Raised sheets — cards, composer, right panel | `#1d1d1b` | `#ffffff` | The right panel becomes a raised sheet separated by a hairline instead of floating as a detached card. **Geometry.** DSH routes **280 `border-radius` declarations through six `--dsw-radius-*` tokens** (measured across all 179 shipped UI bundles), so the theme re-points the scale itself: | Token | DSH | Theme | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-radius-xs` | 4px | 4px | | `--dsw-radius-sm` | 8px | 6px | | `--dsw-radius-md` | 12px | 8px | | `--dsw-radius-lg` | 16px | 12px | | `--dsw-radius-xl` | 20px | 16px | | `--dsw-radius-panel` | 28px | 20px | The corners that bypass the scale are reached through the stable `data-slot` and `data-*` hooks rather than a build hash. **Typography.** This is the part that most decides whether the result reads as a product or as a costume. Claude Desktop is a reading surface, so the transcript is set in the UI sans at a comfortable line height, and monospace is kept for the things that are actually code: | | Treatment | | --- | --- | | Assistant prose | UI sans, 1.65 line height, normal heading letter-spacing | | Inline code, code blocks, tool output | Monospace | | Sidebar, header, composer | UI sans | | Code-block banner | Sentence case, not shouted uppercase | **Transcript.** Your turn is a right-aligned bubble on a quiet surface; the assistant's is prose on the canvas; tool calls collapse into single-line summaries (`Ran 2 commands ›`) that expand in place, which is how Claude Desktop keeps a long working session scannable. **Composer.** One continuous rounded surface: the editor and the controls share a single card with no divider between them, the submit control is a circle, and focus draws a soft terracotta ring rather than a hard outline. **Chrome.** Quiet navigation rows instead of an elevated primary button, hover states limited to enabled controls, `focus-visible` rings for keyboard use, and thin warm scrollbars. ## Customisation Everything the component layer decides reads a `--cct-*` property declared once on `body`, so you can retune it from your own CSS without patching the package: ```css body { /* A serif reading face, the way long-form prose is often set. */ --cct-prose: Georgia, "Songti SC", serif; /* Roomier or tighter surfaces. */ --cct-composer-radius: 24px; --cct-control-radius: 6px; --cct-editor-inset: 20px; } ``` | Knob | Default | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `--cct-sans` | system UI stack | UI face, including the sidebar and composer | | `--cct-prose` | `var(--cct-sans)` | Face used for assistant prose only | | `--cct-mono` | DSH's code stack | Code, tool output and paths | | `--cct-control-radius` | `8px` | Buttons, rows, chips, code blocks | | `--cct-composer-radius` | `18px` | The composer surface | | `--cct-editor-inset` | `16px` | Composer text inset from its edge | | `--cct-focus` | brand primary | Focus ring colour | To retune colours instead, stack your own layer on top — later layers win per token: ```js ctx.theme.overrideTokens('my-tweaks', { '--dsw-alias-brand-primary': { light: '#c96442', dark: '#d97757' }, }) ``` ## How it works The plugin is a browser half plus an inert host row. The browser half (`lib/client.js`) does exactly two things, both inside one Cordis effect, so unloading or HMR removes the theme completely: 1. Calls `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-claude-code-theme', …)` with 174 tokens as `{ light, dark }` pairs. This is DSH's documented third-party theme extension point. The service stacks the layer over the active palette and `ui-layout` writes it as inline custom properties on `` — which is why the theme outranks the base palette sheets without `!important`, and why overriding the `--dsw-static-*` ramps propagates to every alias that resolves through them. 2. plugins.description: Open-source, local-first envelope messaging for DeepSeek Harness: a TypeScript node, human-first inbox, explainable collaborator discovery, and bounded LAN recovery.
plugins.readme_text:
# Linko

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Linko is open-source, local-first envelope messaging for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It helps agents find the right collaborator, exchange scoped context, and continue a task under explicit human-controlled policies.

Linko is an early runnable MVP. The repository remains specification-driven: product boundaries, state transitions, delivery recovery, privacy rules, and architecture decisions are written beside the runtime.

## Why Linko

LAN messaging and approval panels are useful building blocks. Linko adds the part that becomes more useful with a person's own evidence and context:

- Each person and Agent can keep a subjective set of capability claims; later releases may attach signatures without creating a global reputation score.
- A task query can produce a local recommendation with evidence and an explanation.
- Context is shared by scope and purpose instead of being broadcast as a complete private history.
- A person can answer an inbound request, ask their Agent to draft a reply, or delegate a bounded response policy.
- Every delivery is a small envelope with a human-readable cover, machine-readable semantics, and an optional local body or safe surface.
- The experimental first group profile is capped at 500 member principals, with group delivery and message-layer E2EE as separate milestones.

## Project status

The MVP runs a SQLite-backed node and a human-first envelope inbox. It supports an explicit two-node HTTPS pairing profile with a durable outbox, pinned certificates, bearer authentication, retry-safe command IDs, and REST recovery. The local node also exposes an advisory loopback WebSocket for live UI hints; paired WSS delivery remains a later milestone. The replaceable TypeScript DSH companion bridge now provides `ask`, `inbox`, `inspect`, `draft`, `approve`, and `reply` adapters over the local API. Message signatures and E2EE remain later milestones; this is not a 20,000-node capacity claim.

- Product scope: [English](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.zh.md)
- Architecture: [English](docs/architecture.md) · [中文](docs/architecture.zh.md)
- State and storage: [English](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.zh.md)
- Review record: [English](docs/review.md) · [中文](docs/review.zh.md)
- Roadmap: [English](ROADMAP.md) · [中文](ROADMAP.zh.md)
- Decisions: [English](docs/decisions/README.md) · [中文](docs/decisions/README.zh.md)
- Local node MVP: [English](packages/node/README.md) · [中文](packages/node/README.zh.md)
- DSH companion bridge: [English](packages/bridge/README.md) · [中文](packages/bridge/README.zh.md)
- Envelope inbox UI: [English](packages/web/DESIGN.md) · [中文](packages/web/DESIGN.zh.md)

## Design direction

The first physical store is one SQLite database behind one TypeScript node. Immutable event content is durable; delivery attempts, read state, approvals, and notifications are local operational state. REST cursor synchronization and the SQLite outbox remain the canonical recovery path. The approved [2026 transport decision](docs/decisions/0010-wss-live-session-and-recovery.md) selects WSS as the online live session; its implementation remains pending. A graph can be materialized later as a view over claims; a graph database is not required.

The network uses ordinary IP and authenticated TCP/TLS connections, with explicit pairing. mDNS/DNS-SD is an optional discovery hint only; it does not grant trust or carry message bodies. Linko adds no application-layer router or payload flooding, and requires no Linko-specific router or switch feature. WebTransport/QUIC remain deferred experiments alongside DHT, Merkle synchronization, full-mesh sockets, blockchain consensus, and Rust/WASM; each needs a measured reason and a fallback test.

## DeepSeek Harness fit

Linko is intended to be a community plugin and companion protocol for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. It follows the Harness model that capabilities are composable plugins, while keeping the Linko protocol independently usable by other agents and clients.

## Contributing

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the repository guidance in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Early contributions are most useful as design review, threat modeling, interoperability experiments, and small protocol fixtures.

## Topics

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮） | DeepSeek Harness Desktop Plugin: Auto‑maximize main window on launch (same as clicking the Maximize button manually)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-maximize
DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮）

适用于 DSH desktop profile，以及所有基于 Electron / 系统窗口运行 DSH 的场景。

**仓库**：Gitee（主）<https://gitee.com/FideFei/dsh-auto-maximize> ｜ GitHub（镜像）<https://github.com/FideFeiPlane/dsh-auto-maximize>

## 原理与平台支持

插件是 host-only 插件，随桌面版 host 进程在应用启动时加载。host 进程是 Node 子进程
（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，由 Electron 主进程拉起），拿不到 `BrowserWindow`，
因此按平台调用系统级「最大化」能力，全部**尽力而为、失败只记日志、绝不 crash host**：

| 平台 | 策略 | 依赖 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Windows | Win32 `ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_MAXIMIZE)` | **pwsh 7** → **Windows PowerShell 5.1** 自动回退 | pwsh 7 缺失时自动用 5.1（Windows 自带）；无需额外安装。PowerShell 按 PATH 解析、不写死安装路径；5.1 的 `Add-Type` 内置编译器，脚本两版通用 |
| macOS | 把窗口设为主屏可视区大小（`NSScreen.visibleFrame`，即「向窗口发送最大化指令」）；该调用失败时再点击绿色 `AXZoomButton` 作为补救 | `osascript`（系统自带） | 需要「辅助功能/Accessibility」授权，未授权会给出指引日志；`processName` 可覆盖应用名 |
| Linux | `wmctrl` → `xdotool` 设置 `_NET_WM_STATE_MAXIMIZED` | 通常**未预装**，需自行安装 | 尽力而为；两者都缺则跳过 |

窗口定位（Windows）：优先取 host 进程的父进程 PID（即 Electron 主进程）且可执行文件路径一致，
失败则按可执行文件路径扫描所有带主窗口的进程。macOS/Linux 按窗口标题/进程名匹配
（默认取运行中的可执行文件名，可用 `processName` 覆盖）。

**为什么不能直接调 `BrowserWindow.maximize()`**：host 进程是纯 Node（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，
已实测 `require('electron')` 失败），插件只能拿到系统级窗口句柄——因此「自动最大化」被实现为
「等价于用户点击一次最大化按钮」的系统调用，而非 Electron API 调用。

## 安装

### 方式一：通过插件市场 / npm（推荐，发布后可用）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-auto-maximize
```

### 方式二：本地工程安装（开发调试）

在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）：

```jsonc
// package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-auto-maximize": "file:./plugins/dsh-auto-maximize" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* 追加 */ "dsh-auto-maximize" ] } }
}
```

然后 `pnpm install`，重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖 `auto-maximize` 行即可：

```yaml
- id: auto-maximize
  config:
    enabled: false        # 禁用
    timeoutMs: 30000      # 等待窗口出现的超时（毫秒，默认 20000）
    processName: 'DeepSeek Harness'   # macOS/Linux 定位窗口用的进程名
```

配置项：

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | `false` 时整个插件不做事 |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `20000` | 启动后持续寻找窗口的最长时间（毫秒） |
| `processName` | string | 可执行文件名 | macOS/Linux 定位窗口用的进程/窗口标题名 |
| `logFile` | boolean \| string | `~/.dsh/auto-maximize.log` | 诊断日志：`false` 关闭文件日志；字符串指定自定义路径；删除文件即清空 |

## macOS：需要「辅助功能」授权

macOS 出于安全限制，用 `osascript`（System Events）控制其他 App 的窗口必须先获得
**「辅助功能 / Accessibility」**授权。

> ⚠️ **注意事项：指令形式同样需要授权。** 插件把窗口直接设为 `set position/size`（「向窗口发送
> 最大化指令」）还是点击 `AXZoomButton`，**两种方式都走同一套 macOS Accessibility API，都需要
> 辅助功能授权**。原因：插件跑在 host（外部 Node 进程）里，要挪动另一个进程的窗口只能走该 API，
> 系统的闸门拦的是 API 本身、不是进程身份——哪怕 `osascript` 是 DSH 自己的子进程也一样（TCC 会把
> 授权追溯归属到 DSH 应用，所以勾选 DeepSeek Harness 即可覆盖它，但这并不豁免授权）。唯一能免授权的
> 路径是让 DSH 在自身进程内最大化自己的窗口（如启动参数 / host→main 的 IPC 调
> `BrowserWindow.maximize()`），那需要 DSH 本体提供通道，插件作为外部方做不到。**因此请保留授权**。

插件未获授权时会在 host 日志输出指引（关键字 `dsh-auto-maximize`），按以下步骤授权后重启即可：

1. 打开 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能**；
2. 勾选 **DeepSeek Harness**（以及承载/启动它的终端或启动器，如有）；
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness（授权对已运行的进程不生效）。

仍无效时，可用 `processName` 指定实际的进程名——打包后应用显示名可能与可执行文件名不同。

**诊断日志**：从 1.1.2 起，插件每一步都会追加写入 `~/.dsh/auto-maximize.log`
（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\auto-maximize.log`）。排查「没生效」时直接看这个文件，能立刻看到
`osascript` 返回的 `perm:`（缺授权）/ `nowindow:`（没找到窗口）/ `maximized-bounds`（成功）等结果。
不需要日志时用 `logFile: false` 关闭，或直接删除该文件清空。每次启动会把上一次日志轮转为
`auto-maximize.log.old`，只保留本次与最近一次，文件不会无限累积。

> 对比：**Windows 端不需要任何额外权限**——`ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_MAXIMIZE)` 是直接 Win32 API
> 调用（非模拟点击），对同一用户的窗口无需提权。

## 卸载

从 profile 的 `package.json` 两处（`dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`）移除
`dsh-auto-maximize`，再执行 `pnpm install`，重启应用。

## 开发

```sh
npm install   # 无第三方运行时依赖；仅 dev 需要（测试用 node:test）
npm test      # 冒烟测试：模块加载 / 禁用分支 / 效果注册
npm pack      # 生成可发布的 tarball（先跑测试）
```

## 发布到 npm

```sh
npm login                                   # 首次
npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
```

发布后即可在 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 插件市场的
「申请收录插件 ↗」入口提交收录（指向 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
的 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml`，见 [提交指南](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/contributing.md)）。

## 已知限制

- 仅在桌面版（desktop profile）有意义；web profile 无窗口，插件会安静跳过。
- 只启动时执行一次，不会干预会话中手动调整的窗口状态。
- 多实例/多窗口：Windows 上优先通过「host 的父进程 PID + 可执行路径」精确定位所属实例的
  主窗口，多个 DSH 实例互不干扰；父进程匹配失败时才按可执行路径扫描，此时多开场景可能
  命中另一个实例的窗口。macOS/Linux 取「最前端/首个匹配」窗口，多开时建议用 `processName` 区分。
- 失败只写 host 日志（关键字 `dsh-auto-maximize`），不影响应用运行。

## Roadmap（未实现，欢迎 PR）

- **设置 UI 开关**：把 `enabled` 接进「设置 → 通用设置」。当前为 host-only 插件，只能通过
  `cordis.patch.yml` 配置；做成界面开关需要 client-plugin 侧的设置面板扩展。
- **去掉 PowerShell 依赖**：Windows 端可改用 FFI（koffi 等）直调 `user32.dll`，免起子进程；
  但会引入原生二进制，破坏「零运行时依赖」，故暂未采用（现状：PS 5.1 为 Windows 自带）。
- **正式图标**：`assets/icon.svg` 为占位设计（最大化双框图形），欢迎替换为正式图标。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © FideFei

plugins.description: Model-controlled context blocks for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-block-ptc

**English | [中文](README.zh.md)**

[![CI](https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-block-ptc.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-ptc)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Blackboard blocks for **PTC mode** in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Version `0.3.0` layers the block protocol on the built-in `run_code` transport.
DSH's PTC presentation allows only `run_code` to be called directly, so the
model declares blocks in the tool description:

```
run_code({ description: "[block: auth] Rework the auth tests", code })
```

A *block* is a blackboard region. Every program the model runs is tagged with
block ids, and when the block's work is finished the model hands in a summary
**it writes itself** — which then replaces that block's messages in the model's
own context. The original messages stay in the append-only session log, so the
human transcript keeps everything and replay stays deterministic.

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 or newer**; no upper version bound
- Community plugin maintained by [mengwEX](https://github.com/mengwEX)
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — the only external import is `node:crypto`
- License: **MIT**

## Table of contents

- [Why](#why)
- [Context and cache comparison](#context-and-cache-comparison)
- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Install](#install)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Reference](#reference)
- [Design notes](#design-notes)
- [Verification](#verification)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Known limits](#known-limits)
- [Development](#development)
- [License](#license)

## Why

Automatic compaction condenses history when token pressure builds, and it
decides what to condense by size. It has no idea that the last forty messages
were one finished sub-task and the next ten are a new one.

This plugin lets the model draw that line itself: open a block, work inside it,
and close it with a handover summary — so the context it keeps is the one it
chose to keep. The model submits the summary inside its program call; the plugin
does not run a separate summarizer model.

## Context and cache comparison

![Illustrative comparison of input context and modeled cache hits for the same synthetic conversation](docs/assets/context-comparison.en.png)

**Mechanism illustration, not an API benchmark.** Both panels replay the same
synthetic four-task workload with assigned token weights. Full bar = input
context; blue = modeled cache hits, orange = modeled cache misses. Cached tokens
still occupy the context window.

After a block closes, the next request carries a summary in place of its
completed work. Replacing history can also invalidate the cached suffix:
**smaller context does not guarantee a higher cache-hit rate or a lower bill**.
The closing assistant/tool pair settles before replacement; original user
messages remain. The baseline has not reached its automatic compaction threshold.

See the [data, assumptions and reproduction steps](docs/context-comparison/README.md).
The plugin's `tokensFreed` is not a provider cache-hit measurement.

## How it works

The model's whole surface is the built-in PTC transport plus one
program-callable:

```
run_code({ description: "[block: <ids>] <goal>", code })   the only tool it may call directly
await tools.block_summary({ ids, summary })                  callable from inside a program
```

1. The header in `run_code.description` names the blocks a program advances.
   Its ids apply to the complete assistant message, including preceding
   thinking/text, and its tool results. Calls in the same assistant message
   contribute the union of their ids.
2. `tools.block_summary({ ids, summary })` replaces the complete interval from
   the earliest to the latest occurrence of any target id with one summary.
3. The summary inherits the union of the interval's ids minus the target ids.
   It can participate in a later summary. A summary with no remaining ids stays.
4. If a tool pair in the interval is unfinished, the request is queued until
   its result lands. A protected system/developer message refuses the
   entire interval; no prefix is silently replaced.

```text
A A B A C B  -- summary([A]) --> S[B] C B
S[B] C B    -- summary([B]) --> T[C]
T[C]        -- summary([C]) --> U[]
A A B A C B -- summary([A, B]) --> S[C]
```

What the human sees afterwards: the transcript still shows every original
turn (the log is append-only); the model's next request shows the summary
instead. In the Web UI the summary renders as a compaction checkpoint node.

## Install

Requirements: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.2` and its bundled runtime, with
Cordis `>=4.0.5`. Neither peer range has an upper version bound. The plugin
is a profile **bundle**: installing it adds one row to `dsh.profile.bundles`
and one new agent preset, `block-ptc`. It does not modify the shipped `ptc`
preset.

The version ranges allow newer hosts to load the plugin; they are not a record
of completed compatibility checks. Live host verification for this release used
DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. DSH's plugin loader includes prereleases when evaluating its
peer ranges. The plugin checks the required tool/prompt methods before mounting
and the session methods before summarizing, and reports missing capabilities.
Method presence does not verify event semantics, preset configuration or model
behaviour; these still need validation when the host changes.

### From npm (recommended)

Find **dsh-block-ptc** in the Harness Plugin Manager and install it, or ask an
agent with the Plugin Manager tool enabled to install the bundle:

```
plugin_manager  install_bundle  dsh-block-ptc
```

The package is published on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-ptc).
Restart the application after installation and select the **Block PTC** preset.

### From a local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc.git
```

Install the absolute checkout path through the Plugin Manager:

```
plugin_manager  install_bundle  /absolute/path/to/dsh-block-ptc
```

Both methods use pnpm in the target profile. The local form installs a `link:`
dependency for development. Versioned source archives are also available under
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc/releases).

### Manual install (equivalent, if you prefer files)

In `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-block-ptc": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-block-ptc" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-block-ptc"] } }
}
```

then run pnpm in that directory.

### After installing

1. The preset appears in the session preset picker as **Block PTC**.
2. **Restart the application once.** The loader keeps a plugin module per
   resolved URL, and installing a bundle changes the composition; a running
   host keeps the old module generation until it restarts.
3. Start a session with the **Block PTC** preset.

### Uninstall

```
plugin_manager  remove_bundle  dsh-block-ptc
```

then restart. `plugin_manager set_bundle dsh-block-ptc enabled=false` disables
it without removing the package.

## Quick start

Say what you want done, then let it close the block when it finishes:

> Read the parser module, explain how the tokenizer works, then close the block
> and continue with the lexer.

You should see:

- the model calling `run_code` with a description such as
  `[block: tokenizer] Explain the tokenizer` for everything it runs;
- a closing call to `block_summary` whose return value is
  `{"replaced": 3, "tokensFreed": 346}` — how many messages were replaced and
  the estimated token count of the replaced messages (before counting the new summary);
- a `<block-summary>…</block-summary>` node sitting where those messages were.

If a program call is refused with *"every `run_code` description must start
with `[block: <ids>] <goal>`"*, that is the preset's guard working. Retry the
program with the header; the refused call itself is not t

plugins.description: Unified rail for the DSH sidebar: sort the top panels and the bottom actions as one list. / DSH 左侧栏统一排序插件：顶部面板与底部动作混排成同一条序列。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-railist

**English** | [中文](#中文)

---

## English

Manage the whole DSH left column as one list: reorder rows across the panel list and the footer action row, rename them, change their icons, hide them, and fold them into Groups. Everything is configured in a new Settings tab and applies immediately.

> A fork of [dsh-panellist](https://github.com/qwq1999/dsh-panellist). Upstream manages the panel list alone; this fork extends it to a single sequence spanning two seats.

---

## Features

- **One sequence across seats** — the panel list and the footer action row are sorted as a single list, so a row can be dragged from one into the other.
- **Reorder by drag** — drag any row to a new position; the rail follows the list live.
- **Rename and re-icon** — give any row your own label and pick its icon from a built-in set.
- **Show / hide** — take a row off the rail without uninstalling its plugin.
- **Groups** — fold several rows into one Group row with a flyout menu; ungroup at any time.
- **Appearance override** — adjust the rail's own look from the Settings tab.
- **Config file's full path** — shown in Settings so you can back it up or edit it.

The Settings row itself always stays last and cannot be dragged, and every change is written to disk only when you press Save.

## Screenshots

| Settings → Panel list | Appearance override | A Group menu on the rail |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| ![Settings → Panel list](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![Appearance override](docs/images/settings-appearance.png) | ![A Group menu on the rail](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) |

## Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-railist
```

Then restart DSH. To remove it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-railist
```

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Profile | `web` |
| Platform | Windows / macOS / Linux desktop |

## Configuration

Your settings live in `~/.dsh/railist.json`. The full path is also shown in the Settings tab. If a row's plugin is missing or disabled, the row is kept in the file and marked as missing rather than being deleted.

## License

MIT

---

## 中文

把 DSH 左侧栏当成一整条列表来管理：跨「面板区」与「底部动作区」调整顺序、重命名、换图标、隐藏，以及把若干行折叠成分组。全部在设置页完成，改完立即生效。

> 本项目 fork 自 [dsh-panellist](https://github.com/qwq1999/dsh-panellist)。上游只管理面板区；本 fork 把它扩展成跨越两个区域的同一条序列。

---

## 功能

- **跨区域同一条序列** —— 面板区与底部动作区当成一条列表排序，所以一个行可以从一个区域拖进另一个区域。
- **拖动排序** —— 把任意行拖到新位置，左侧栏实时跟随。
- **重命名与换图标** —— 给任意行起自己的名字，并从内置图标集里挑图标。
- **显示 / 隐藏** —— 把某一行从左侧栏隐藏，而不必卸载它的插件。
- **分组** —— 把若干行折叠成一个分组行（带展开菜单），随时可以解组。
- **外观覆盖** —— 在设置页调整左侧栏自身的外观。
- **配置文件全路径** —— 设置页直接显示，方便你备份或手动编辑。

「设置」那一行固定在最下方、不可拖动；所有改动都要点保存才会写进磁盘。

## 效果图

| 设置 → 面板列表 | 外观覆盖 | 左侧栏上的分组菜单 |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| ![设置 → 面板列表](docs/images/settings-panel-list.png) | ![外观覆盖](docs/images/settings-appearance.png) | ![左侧栏上的分组菜单](docs/images/rail-group-menu.png) |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-railist
```

装完重启 DSH。卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-railist
```

## 兼容版本

| 要求 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Profile | `web` |
| 平台 | Windows / macOS / Linux 桌面端 |

## 配置

配置存在 `~/.dsh/railist.json`，设置页里也会显示完整路径。如果某一行的插件被卸载或停用，这一行会保留在配置里并标记为「已缺失」，不会被自动删掉。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: 阅读代码 · DSH 独立插件：一个独立于普通工作区选择的代码阅读模式：先理解业务，再梳理调用链、精读实现，最后通过具体场景验证理解。
plugins.readme_text:
# 阅读代码 · DSH 独立插件

一个独立于普通工作区选择的代码阅读模式：从业务问题或具体代码出发，按需要解释业务、调用链与实现逻辑，不必依次完成固定阶段。

> 当前源码工作区已加入代码优先的 IDE 工作台、选区逻辑图与方法级阅读关联；下方既有 0.1.7 发布归档仍是原发布时的不可变快照。源码改动需重新构建、以新版本打包并安装后才会更新已运行的 DSH。

- **独立入口**：侧边栏“阅读代码”，位于工作区列表上方，不替换原工作区或对话入口。
- **多仓库项目**：一个阅读项目绑定 1–12 个本地仓库。绑定不可变，切换普通 DSH 工作区不会改变阅读目标；添加仓库时新建项目。顶部仓库选择 → **管理仓库…** 可确认移除整个项目，仅从选择器与阅读列表收起，磁盘源码和原阅读档案保留；重新打开目录会新建项目。
- **需求驱动**：从问题出发时按需解释业务、调用链和关键实现；从代码出发时聚焦选区、项目内上下游和代码逻辑。业务发现只用于宽泛目标，理解自查只在用户需要时进行；每轮一个知识点。
- **默认仓库名**：选择本地目录即可开始，不必填写项目或仓库名称。已有档案名称保留。
- **代码证据**：仓库 ID、相对路径、行号、SHA256、符号文本线索与读取时间；打开证据和发布知识点时重新核验，源码变化会使旧证据失效。
- **固定留痕**：读取审计、阶段历史、知识点 Markdown、Mermaid 原文、最终对话文本与汇总导出。
- **代码阅读配色**：语法高亮、真实行号、较大行距、长行折行与高对比代码面板；着色完全在本地页面完成，不额外发送源码或执行代码。
- **IDE 阅读工作台**：左侧文件目录、中间代码与阅读共用的文档标签、右侧阅读列表。初次打开仓库中央显示“选择文件，开始阅读”，不以大输入框占据代码区；需要问题阅读时再打开。页面不显示固定阶段导航，生成后只展示实际内容维度，跟随宿主明暗主题。
- **文件工作台**：桌面默认展开左侧目录，可切换字面量检索与人工批注、折叠或在 200–420px 内调宽；中间源码支持最大化、真实行号、字号和折行。最多保留 12 个内存文件标签，切换时重读并核验版本、恢复各文件位置，不持久化浏览器源码。窄屏两侧按需用抽屉打开，优先保留中央空间。
- **完整方法级阅读**：代码解读的最小范围是方法、函数或构造器等完整可调用单元；类或整文件是更大的范围，不把局部语句当完整方法。文档／数据文件豁免；未知编程语言不会因缺少高亮而跳过规则。模型识别语义边界，Host 核验实际字节版本、UTF16 行列与连续完整读取证据，不宣称全语言 AST 证明。
- **源码上的阅读记录**：在同一项目内跨阅读会话关联已归档代码单元。打开或重新加载文件、核验哈希后，行号栏显示已有 AI 解读的标记，悬停方法或聚焦标记可看归档结论；标记点击打开预览，预览按钮精确打开对应会话与知识点。没有额外模型调用，也不将结论或源码新增到浏览器持久化；已有解读不等于你已理解。
- **选区逻辑图**：手动选择方法或类的文字范围（最多 8,000 个 UTF16 单位），右键或 Shift+F10 使用 **AI 生成逻辑图**，沿用会话模型与发送范围确认。片段会先扩展读取所属完整代码单元，方法优先展示有证据的控制流、分支、异常与返回；类按实际协作绘图。结果在中央阅读文档中图优先显示，普通解释和追问仍可用；界面不自动框选符号，不是 AST 或静态调用图。
- **阅读位置**：按会话在原档案中保存知识点、查看／主动理解标记、源码哈希与滚动位置，以及当前显示代码还是阅读内容；兼容旧档案。只保存位置元数据，不新增浏览器源码或对话存储；恢复源码时重新读取核验，不能恢复不存在的历史字节。深入前可保留返回位置。
- **调用前确认**：首次调用、提供方／模型或绑定范围变化须重新确认。显示所选提供方，实际端点以 DSH 配置为准，不仅凭模型名称宣称本地。
- **版本化批注**：手动批注存阅读工作区，记录原字节哈希、UTF16 行列、选文和附近上下文。变更仅提供待复核候选，不猜新行号；人工重新绑定保留历史，回滚也不自动解除已观察到的复核状态。
- **Mermaid**：支持时序图、流程图、类图、状态图、ER 图；危险指令与资产节点在渲染前拒绝，SVG 清洗后在禁止脚本的 iframe 中展示。

## 先安装，再开始阅读

当前发布版本 **0.1.7**，目标 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**。普通使用者安装预构建包即可，不需要另行安装 Node、pnpm、React 或现场编译；模型提供方需在 DSH 中配置。目标版本是兼容声明，不是对正在运行的 DSH 的自动探测。

**本地发布产物：**[0.1.7 安装包](<releases/dsh-code-reading-0.1.7.tgz>) · [SHA256 校验文件](<releases/dsh-code-reading-0.1.7.tgz.sha256>) · [发布报告](<releases/dsh-code-reading-0.1.7.release.json>)。这些链接指向当前源码工作区的交付文件，不是公共下载地址；仅克隆源码不保证同时获得归档。

1. 获取可信的安装包与同次发布的校验文件，核对 SHA256；校验一致不等于发布者签名。
2. 在**当前 DSH 应用的插件／Bundle 管理界面**用归档绝对路径安装并启用。提示 `restart-required` 时必须**完整退出并重开 DSH**；仅刷新浏览器不能更新旧 Host。不要用 CLI 管理桌面版保留的 profile。
3. 左侧打开 **阅读代码 → 安装与使用**，确认 Client、Host 都是 `0.1.7` 且项目列表加载完成，再创建项目。版本不一致时创建和发送会暂停，并显示恢复步骤。

在源码工作区根目录可用 PowerShell 获取安装路径与哈希：

```powershell
(Resolve-Path '.\releases\dsh-code-reading-0.1.7.tgz').Path
Get-FileHash '.\releases\dsh-code-reading-0.1.7.tgz' -Algorithm SHA256
```

详细步骤、完整重启／仅刷新的决策表、升级回退与按错误码排障见 [安装手册](<docs/INSTALL.md>)；从第一次创建到导出的操作见 [使用手册](<docs/USAGE.md>)；变更见 [更新记录](<CHANGELOG.md>)。

## 使用

1. 在 DSH 左侧点击 **阅读代码**。安装器如提示 `restart-required`，需完整退出并重新打开 DSH（不只是刷新页面）；仅 Client 入口未更新时才刷新当前页面。
2. 点击 **打开本地仓库**，从已有 DSH 工作区添加仓库，或选择本地绝对目录，自动使用目录名称。仓库不能与产物目录重叠，也不能重复或互相嵌套。点击 **打开仓库**仅保存记录，不自动请求模型；**更多 → 打开其他仓库** 可另建绑定。
3. 打开仓库后，中央默认显示 **选择文件，开始阅读**。从左侧 **文件目录** 单击文件，在中央只读查看；文件和阅读内容使用同一排文档标签切换。
4. 手动框选方法或类的文字范围，右键或 Shift+F10 选择 **AI 生成逻辑图**；只需解释时用 **让 AI 分析选中代码／解释这段**。先核对中央底部的 **阅读模型**，首次调用、提供方／模型或绑定变化时确认 **源码发送范围**；每轮只发布一个知识点。
5. 想从问题出发时，底部 **问题阅读** 打开当前记录，或右侧 **新建阅读** 打开临时阅读，在中央阅读文档填写目标并 **开始阅读**。新建后仅浏览源码、选模型、填写问题或取消发送都不会保存会话，也不出现在阅读列表；确认发起分析，或显式保存人工批注时才保留。未发起的草稿离开后不恢复。点击右侧已有记录只打开它，即使尚无内容也不会再新建。
6. 逻辑图在中央阅读文档中优先展示，随后核对解释、结论和证据。内容维度只切换已归档内容，不改变内部阶段、不请求模型；普通追问不会自动延续上一轮的绘图任务。**继续阅读** 或明确追问才开始下一轮，查看过不自动记作理解。
7. 右侧 **阅读列表** 默认展示 **阅读中** 的会话；记录旁 **归档** 只收起会话，知识点、证据、批注和位置都保留。在 **已归档** 中可查看并 **恢复**；恢复前不能发送新分析，进行中的阅读须先停止或等待结束再归档。点击证据在中央打开对应文件，重新核验 SHA256。
8. 选择代码后 **用于追问** 可固定上下文，临时浏览其他文件不替换它。深入后可 **返回原阅读路线**；**保存阅读位置** 和切换主题会保存位置元数据。
9. 在知识点下折叠查看 **历史追问与对话记录**；右侧列表底部 **阅读产物 → 导出档案** 保留汇总导出。**阅读设置**仅设置默认阅读代码模型并显示插件档案根目录；默认模型只用于之后新建的阅读，不覆盖已有会话或 DSH 全局默认，可选择跟随 DSH 默认。

普通 DSH 侧边栏切换工作区不会重绑仓库。重新打开本页面可以继续原阅读会话。暂停／停止只终止当前轮次，不删除档案。

### 方法标记如何认定

只有明确归档了完整代码单元、证据能连续覆盖其范围且文件 SHA256 与当前加载版本一致，才显示行号栏标记。类／文件概览不自动等于其所有方法已有解读；旧记录没有方法范围时不猜测补齐。源码版本不同的结论仍留在阅读历史中，但不挂到当前旧行号；重新阅读后可建立新版本关联。标记只是“已有 AI 解读”，不是“你已理解”或整仓业务仍正确的证明。关联检查发生在打开／重新加载文件时，不是实时监听；达到检索或显示预算会提示截断。

### 遇到问题先看这里

| 现象 | 建议处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 已安装但没有“阅读代码”入口 | 确认安装在当前应用／profile 且已启用；按安装器提示完整退出重开，Host 生效后 Client 仍旧时再刷新当前页。 |
| Host／Client 版本不一致 | 完整重启 DSH 后刷新页面，不要绕过版本检查继续创建或发送。 |
| 删除仓库提示 `UNKNOWN_METHOD` | 当前 Host 尚未加载删除接口，本次删除未执行。确认已安装包含该功能的 Host，完整退出 DSH（含托盘）后重开；若仍不支持，需要更新安装包。仅刷新网页或重新构建源码不会更新已安装的旧 Host。同版本号也可能是不同构建，当前源码握手会额外核验删除能力。 |
| 项目列表或档案加载失败 | 使用页面的对应重试入口；失败不代表数据为空，先确认实际档案目录，不要急着重复创建。 |
| 模型目录为空或加载失败 | 在 DSH“设置 → 模型”配置后重新加载目录，再确认当前会话的提供方与模型；恢复目录不会自动替你换模型。 |
| 提示项目已保存，但会话步骤未完成 | 先刷新检查仓库列表，再用该项目的“新阅读会话”继续，不要重复新建项目。 |
| 修改目录后找不到原档案 | 在“安装与使用 → 诊断信息”核对实际根目录与来源；改变配置不会自动搬迁旧档案。 |

网络请求若显示“结果未确认”，先刷新核对已有结果，不要假设操作失败后盲目重复提交。更多情况见 [完整排障手册](<docs/INSTALL.md>)。

## 只读与信任边界

阅读 Agent 只拥有以下五个专用工具：

| 工具 | 能力 |
| --- | --- |
| `reading_catalog` | 查看项目、绑定、当前阶段与主题 |
| `reading_files` | 有界枚举文件 |
| `reading_search` | 有界字面量搜索，不执行正则表达式或项目代码 |
| `reading_read` | 通过只读文件句柄读取有限行范围并创建证据 |
| `reading_publish` | 向固定目录发布一个结构化知识点并结束本轮 |

Host 根执行守卫与被保留的 preset 守卫共同拒绝 shell、通用文件写入、网络工具、子代理、工作流及插件转调。即使在普通权限界面选择更宽模式，也不能为阅读 Agent 放行这些工具。框架自身的模型调用不属于被禁止的工具网络访问。

受控产物由 Host 写入；Agent 不能指定产物文件名或任意写入路径。源码根与产物根绑定时检查分离，拒绝符号链接／junction、硬链接、路径穿越、UNC、ADS 和设备路径。扫描会跳过依赖／构建目录及部分常见敏感文件名；**这不是通用秘密检测或 DLP**，仓库内其他普通文本仍可能包含敏感信息。

**重要限制：这是插件工具边界，不是操作系统级沙箱。** 同一账户的其他本地进程如果能在路径检查与实际操作之间并发替换目录，纯 Node.js 路径 API 不能提供原子目录句柄约束。本插件不宣称能抵御这种恶意本地文件系统竞态，也不阻止其他普通 DSH 会话修改同一仓库。请使用可信、权限受控的产物目录；不支持把不受信任的并发本地写入者纳入“严格只读”保证。需要该保证时，应额外使用 OS ACL、只读挂载或独立容器。

证据表示“某时刻实际读取到这些字节”，不是跨文件／跨仓原子快照，也不等于 AI 结论必然正确。工具的 `symbol` 线索只做文本匹配；完整方法范围由模型识别，Host 核验字节版本、坐标及连续完整证据覆盖，不是 AST 解析、静态调用图或编译器证明。请核对事实、推导与假设标注。

## 固定目录

默认根目录：

```text
%DSH_HOME%/code-reading
# 未设置 DSH_HOME 时：%USERPROFILE%/.dsh/code-reading
```

优先级为 Host `dataDir` → `DSH_CODE_READING_HOME` → `DSH_HOME/code-reading` → 用户主目录 `.dsh/code-reading`。自定义值必须是非空本机绝对路径，Windows 必须包含盘符（如 `D:\DSHData\code-reading`），不接受 `\reading`、`/reading` 等缺少盘符的路径或 UNC，也不自动展开 `%变量%` 或 `~`。改变已有运行时的根目录需要完整重启，不自动迁移旧档案。不同 DSH profile 若希望隔离阅读档案，应使用不同 `dataDir`；不要让两个独立 DSH 进程同时写同一根。页面 **安装与使用 → 诊断信息**显示实际位置与来源。

```text
code-reading/
  projects/<project-id>/
    project.json
    sessions/<reading-id>/
      state.json
      annotations.json
      audit.jsonl
      notes/<lesson-id>.md
      diagrams/<lesson-id>.mmd
      messages/<dsh-event-seq>.json
      exports/reading.md
```

- `audit.jsonl` 留存操作、仓库／路径、范围、哈希和时间；不保存源码全文或原始搜索词。
- `annotations.json` 保存人工批注、选区及附近上下文、哈希、提交凭据和重新绑定历史；单文件原子提交是权威，审计 `*-attempt` 仅代表尝试。它含代码片段，不是完整源码备份。
- `messages/` 保存用户和导师的最终文本，不保存隐藏推理或所有工具结果。DSH 原始 Session 日志仍按 DSH 自身规则保存在原位置。
- Mermaid 内嵌代码块保存在知识点 Markdown 中；通过结构化 `mermaid` 字段发布时，会额外生成独立的 `.mmd` 文件。因此没有独立图文件不一定表示图源码未归档。
- 笔记与最终消息可能包含源码片段。目录不是加密保险库，请按项目敏感级别管理访问、备份与保留周期。
- 不自动删除档案，不宣称跨文件事务完全原子。消息归档失败会显示错误，随后重放完整连续 DSH 事件前缀；孤立的失败发布临时文件不能被当成已提交知识点。

## 资源限制

当前版本仅支持本地、非链接、UTF-8 普通文本文件：

- 单文件最多 1 MiB；页面阅读器一次加载完整文件，不再分页，最多 20,000 行（超限整份拒绝，不显示截断文件）。Agent 取证工具单次仍最多 400 行、100,000 字符。
- 文件枚举最多访问 8,000 个条目；搜索最多 2,000 个文件、16 MiB、80 条命中；达到上限会标为截断。自定义依赖缓存目录可能占用预算；遇到截断时可指定已知入口文件路径直接读取，不能把“未检出”当作“不存在”。
- 单会话最多 500 条证据、100 个知识点、2,000 条最终消息；审计／状态文件上限 8 MiB。到限后应新建阅读会话。
- 每个知识点最多 12 个完整代码单元，所有结论／主题／代码单元合计最多 40 条不同证据引用。方法可跨多次有界读取，不能用局部证据冒充完整范围；超过预算需调整阅读目标，不能降为语句片段后声称完整方法。
- 方法关联在同项目内有界检索，最多展示 200 条当前版本记录；达到会话／知识点／验证或显示预算会明确提示截断，旧版本和旧档案的计数也可能只是已扫描部分。
- 文件阅读器按完整文件展示；选区仍不超过 8,000 个 UTF16 单位。批注正文最多 4,000 字符，每会话最多 100 条／400 次提交／8 MiB，每条最多 20 个绑定历史版本；代码变动后只有人工确认或重绑清除已观察到的复核状态。
- Mermaid 最多 10,000 字符、160 行、120 条边；不支持 HTML、链接／点击回调、图片／图标资产、初始化配置或自定义 CSS。
- 仓库移除只改变固定项目元数据，不自动删除源码或阅读档案；未实现磁盘目录删除、项目迁移 UI、AST 分析器、全仓索引、自动运行项目或跨仓一致性快照。

## 安装与兼容性

目标运行时：**DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`**。无需修改已安装 DSH 的源码，提供原生 Host 插件、独立 preset 与 Client 模块。

发布命令生成 `releases/dsh-code-reading-0.1.7.tgz`、同名 `.tgz.sha256` 与 `.release.json`。使用归档绝对路径安装并启用；本工程没有 `preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare` 安装期脚本。`prepack` 只校验已有构建；不要批准不明构建脚本或为不兼容的 DSH 版本盲目授予版本豁免。发布前会拒绝覆盖旧版本文件，保护已安装引用的归档。

卸载／停用不删除阅读档案；保留的旧阅读工具会 fail closed。重新启用在同一 Host 根下复用 store 与锁，避免旧会话和新页面形成双写运行时。普通 DSH 会话不受阅读工具守卫影响。

Client 使用 DSH 原生模块工厂并外置 React。修改本工程后必须重新构建、打包和安装，按安装器提示重启 Host 或刷新 Client；桌面 startup profile 仅刷新页面不足以加载新的 Host。本工程不是替代 W

plugins.description: 多机 dsh 控制：从本地一个窗口驱动你其他服务器上的 dsh——远端会话原生进侧栏，整台远端界面也能搬进来。· Control the dsh instances on your other machines from one local window.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-control

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Every machine already runs dsh. Make this one window the front end for all of them.**

Chat with the dsh instances on your other machines, natively from your local sidebar.
Remote sessions stream back token by token; the remote uses its own model credentials,
tools and sandbox. Zero changes on the remote. Zero dependencies. One-line install.

![dsh-control in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/hero.png)

*Two dsh windows answering the same question. The left window shows a session auto-named
`控制端·<local title>` (①) — that naming only happens on the machine the plugin drives. The right
window shows the workspace `cn-dsh2` the plugin created (②) and the model route set to the
environment name (③).*

> 🎬 A 15-second capture (one-click connect → streaming reply) is being recorded.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:6mt/dsh-control
```

Use the profile you already run (usually `web` or `desktop`). No build step, no native
modules, no dependencies — the plugin is plain JavaScript and installs as-is.

<details>
<summary>GitHub slow or blocked? Install from the release tarball instead</summary>

Download [dsh-control-0.2.1.tgz](https://github.com/6mt/dsh-control/releases/download/v0.2.1/dsh-control-0.2.1.tgz)
and run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add ./dsh-control-0.2.1.tgz
```
</details>

After installing, **fully quit and reopen dsh** (⌘Q — closing the window is not enough),
then:

- Right sidebar →「远程 dsh 环境」→ type `user@host` → connect
- Left sidebar →「🌐 远程环境」→ pick the environment tab to enter the remote's full UI

> Upgrades need the same ⌘Q: a plugin's host half loads at process start.

> An npm package (`dsh-control`) is prepared and can be published later; the GitHub
> command above is the current install path.

## Install failed?

- **Retry once** — the install pulls the repo from GitHub and resolves peers from npm;
  on a bad network pnpm can time out.
- **Seeing `allowBuilds` / "prepare script"** — that is dsh's generic hint for *any*
  failed git-hosted install. This plugin has no build scripts (its only script is
  `test`), so nothing needs approving; just retry.
- Still stuck? Use the release tarball instead (above).

## Versions & updating

- **What you get**: `github:6mt/dsh-control` installs the newest commit of `main` and
  **pins it in your profile's lockfile** — it does not silently follow later commits.
- **Update**: `dsh plugin --profile <your profile> update dsh-control`, then ⌘Q
- **If it says "Already up to date" and the version does not move** (you installed a
  pinned `#vX.Y.Z` earlier), re-add the un-pinned form — verified to pull the latest:

  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:6mt/dsh-control
  ```
- **Pin a version**: `github:6mt/dsh-control#v0.2.1` (tag) or `github:6mt/dsh-control#<commit>`
- Changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## How is this different from the same-named `dsh-control` skill?

There is another project called `jacjackai/dsh-control` — a **skill** that lets an AI agent
operate the DSH **on your own machine**. This repository is a **plugin** for a different
job: **across machines**. It brings the dsh instances you already run on other servers into
one local window (their sessions appear natively in the sidebar, and the whole remote UI
can be opened in place). The two can coexist.

## How is this different from dsh-remote / dsh-remote-ssh?

![How the two approaches differ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/compare.svg)

| | Remote-workspace plugins (dsh-remote, …) | **dsh-control** |
|---|---|---|
| The remote machine is a | **file system** (SFTP tool set) | **dsh that is already running there** |
| Sessions live | local session + remote directory | **remote sessions, native in your sidebar** |
| Credentials & tools | configured locally, SSH config duplicated | the remote's own — nothing copied |
| Remote needs | only SSH | dsh installed (≥0.2.0-rc.2) with its web instance running |
| Changes on the remote | some deploy dsh for you | **zero** (read-only probing + the remote's own API) |

The two **coexist** (tested side by side): no dsh on the remote → use dsh-remote;
dsh already there → use dsh-control.

## What it does

![The remote dsh environments panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/panel.png)

*The「远程 dsh 环境」panel: type `user@host` and connect — the row then reports its state and
whether the environment already has its workspace.*

- **One-click connect** — type `user@host`; the plugin probes the remote dsh, fetches
  its access token and opens an encrypted channel (~5 s)
- **Automatic workspace** — each environment gets a same-named local workspace; any
  session created inside it automatically becomes a remote session
- **True streaming** — remote replies flow in token by token, not dumped at the end
- **Paired naming** — remote sessions are named `控制端·<local title>`, so both sides match
- **Visible & self-healing** — remote sessions are marked in the sidebar; disconnects
  are reported honestly and repaired by one click

### The whole remote UI, brought inside

「🌐 远程环境」in the sidebar renders the remote machine's **complete dsh interface**
(workspaces, sessions, chat, settings) inside one local page, with a tab per environment:

![The remote environment page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/remote-env.png)

*A real run on the remote machine. ① the environment tab — one tab per machine;
② the remote's own workspaces and sessions; ③ a real session running there — subagents,
code blocks and model usage all inside the page; ④ open it in a standalone window.*

- **The real interface, not a re-implementation** — the remote dsh renders itself, so it
  tracks whatever version the remote runs
- **Same-origin proxy** — the page is served by your local web server; the remote's
  credentials are injected server-side, so the browser never sees a token and any auth
  shell in front of the remote is irrelevant (traffic reaches the remote's loopback
  through the encrypted channel)
- **Switching panels keeps it alive** — go handle a local session and come back; the
  remote view is still there, no reload, no reconnect
- **Compression kept for assets** — only the document is uncompressed (it gets
  instrumented); bundles keep gzip

## Security

**What it does on your machine**: one state file
(`$DSH_HOME/dsh-control/state.json`, mode 0600, holds the remote access tokens) and an
on-demand SSH tunnel process.
**What it never does**: no installs or writes on the remote, no lifecycle management of
the remote dsh, never reads your other local credentials, tokens never enter logs.
When passwordless SSH is not set up it shows the exact one-line fix — passwords are
never stored. Details in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Known limitations

- The remote must already run dsh (≥ 0.2.0-rc.2) with its web instance (otherwise use a
  remote-workspace plugin)
- Connects over SSH (passwordless or configured key; a no-SSH "direct address" mode is
  implemented but not yet exposed in the UI)
- The remote-environment page **is** the remote's own UI: actions there really affect the
  remote machine (exactly as if you opened it in a browser)
- The first visit loads the remote's front-end assets (a few seconds depending on the
  network); later visits do not reload
- Sidebar markers and the streaming feel are verified by eye per release
- Cancelling a remote turn is implemented but marked experimental

## Development

```sh
node --check lib/*.js
for t in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$t"; done   # 52 checks: unit / contract / structural invariants
scripts/verify-boot-selfheal.sh                # boot self-heal (needs a local dsh runtime)
```

## License

MIT © 6mt
