# dsh-general-agentics **General Agentics 發行套件（bundle）for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)。** 用戶先安裝 DSH，再安裝本套件，一次獲得： 1. **貼牌**：側邊欄 mark/wordmark、對話首頁 hero 文字 logo 與致敬行、品牌主色、分頁標題、favicon、輸入框下方的 START HERE 模塊（皆為執行期替換，不修改、不破壞已安裝的 DSH） 2. **自帶技能**：14 個（`ga-identity` ＋ 13 個方法論技能，見下） 3. **MCP 預配置**：`ga-status`（`ga_bundle_info` 身分回報 ＋ `ga_health_check` 安裝健康自檢） 4. **設定面板**：Settings → General Agentics（bundle 版本、每個精選插件的版本與更新狀態、隨附技能、一鍵／手動更新） 5. **13 個精選第三方插件**：隨套件安裝並啟用（見「精選插件」一節） Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed. ## 設計原則 - **只走官方縫隙**：品牌透過三個 generic brand slot 佔位（`priority: -1` 陰影覆蓋官方 occupants——slot 規則是「同 cell 最低 priority 者渲染」），不停用 `ui-brand-official`，不修改任何 DSH 檔案。 - **不破簽章、不怕升級**：本套件存在於 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles//node_modules`），DSH 升級不會覆蓋它；解除安裝即完全還原官方品牌。 - **手寫、零建置**：`lib/client.js` 採用 shell module loader 的 lazy-CJS 形狀（與 dsh-pomodoro 等第三方出貨格式一致），無需 repo 內未發佈的 build preset。 ## 覆蓋範圍（誠實清單） | 表面 | 本套件 | 備註 | |---|---|---| | 側邊欄 mark / wordmark | ✅ | slot 佔位；2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測（乾淨 profile）確認渲染 | | 對話首頁 hero mark | ✅ | slot 佔位；實測確認我們的 wordmark 渲染 | | 品牌主色 | ✅ | `theme.overrideTokens`（light/dark 成對，契約要求）。注意 token 寫在 `` 的 inline style 上，不是 `:root`；量測時別探 `document.documentElement` | | 分頁標題 | ✅ | 執行期改寫 + MutationObserver 抵抗 shell 重設；實測 `document.title === "General Agentics"` | | favicon | ✅ | 執行期替換 `link[rel=icon]`；實測兩個 link 皆為 data URI 且含品牌色 | | PWA 名稱 | ⚠️ 盡力 | manifest link 換 data URI，瀏覽器是否採納視實作 | | 首跑 Preview Notice 彈窗 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | client 樹內字串，一次點名 DeepSeek Harness 三次，是客戶第一眼看到的畫面。2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測發現；client.js 修得到（尚未修） | | Hero tagline「Into the Unknown」 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | 與我們的 hero wordmark 並排顯示；同為 client 樹內字串，尚未修 | | 桌面殼（Dock icon／選單／About） | ❌ | 在簽章保護的 app.asar 內，本套件不碰 | | host 端字串（system prompt、User-Agent） | ❌ | 硬編碼；以 `ga-identity` skill 於任務層補償 | ## 安裝 ```sh # 方式一：GUI（App 運行中）——側欄 Plugins → Add plugin → 貼包名或本機路徑 dsh-general-agentics # npm 包名（發佈後） /path/to/dsh-general-agentics # 本機 clone 的絕對路徑 # 方式二：模型側工具（App 運行中）——對話中請 agent 執行 # plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-general-agentics" } # 方式三：CLI（desktop profile 須先完全退出桌面 App） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-general-agentics ``` 安裝後： - **網頁重新整理一次**（Cmd+R）即可載入品牌 client half（側邊欄 mark/wordmark、hero 文字 logo 與致敬行、主色、分頁標題、favicon、輸入框下方的 START HERE 模塊） - **新建的 session** 會獲得 `ga-identity` 等 14 個技能與 `mcp__ga-status__ga_bundle_info` 工具（MCP 伺服器於組合套用時即由 host spawn） - 完全重啟 App 亦無妨 **解除安裝／停用**： ```sh # 停用（保留檔案）：GUI Plugins 頁關閉 bundle，或在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 寫： # - id: general-agentics # disabled: true # 解除安裝：GUI Plugins → Remove，或退出 App 後 CLI： dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-general-agentics ``` **開發迭代**：以 `link:` 指向本機 clone 安裝——改 `lib/client.js` 後重新整理頁面即生效； 改 `cordis.patch.yml` 或 `lib/index.js`（host 半）則套用新組合（HMR live）。 內容變更後重新以 `file:` 安裝時記得升版號——pnpm 對同版號的 `file:` 包可能不重新解包。 離線驗證組合用拋棄式 profile：見 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 13。 **發布前注意**： - LICENSE 已在 repo 根目錄（npm 自動收入 tarball） - MCP row 已是可攜形式（`process.execPath` + `baseUrl`，見 `cordis.patch.yml`；實測紀錄在 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 14） - 對外表述維持 "Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed" ## 套件結構 ``` dsh-general-agentics/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 宣告＋精選插件 dependencies ├── cordis.patch.yml # 本套件 Loader row＋MCP row＋精選插件 insert rows ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # host half：技能 provider（掃 skills/ 註冊） │ └── client.js # browser half：品牌 slot、主題、標題/favicon、START HERE ├── brand/ │ ├── mark.svg # 佔位 mark 設計檔（client.js 內有對應 inline 版本） │ └── wordmark.svg # 佔位 wordmark 設計檔 ├── skills/ │ ├── ga-identity/ # 自帶技能：General Agentics 身分與簽署 │ ├── (13 個方法論技能) # vendored from obra/superpowers @ bb92a77（MIT，逐字未改） │ ├── superpowers/ # 上游 LICENSE + UPSTREAM-SHA（無 SKILL.md，不註冊） │ └── THIRD-PARTY.md # 署名與更新指引 ├── mcp/ │ └── ga-status-server.mjs # ga_bundle_info 狀態回報（零依賴 stdio MCP server） └── test/ └── skill-provider.test.mjs # node --test，零依賴 ``` ## 換正式品牌素材 | 要換什麼 | 改哪裡 | |---|---| | 產品名稱 | `lib/client.js` 的 `PRODUCT_NAME` / `PRODUCT_SHORT_NAME` | | mark 圖形 | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAMark`（paths）＋ `brand/mark.svg` | | wordmark | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAName` | | 品牌色 | `lib/client.js` 的 `BRAND_COLOR` / `FAVICON_COLOR`（light/dark 成對） | | favicon | `lib/client.js` 的 `faviconHref()` | ## 隨附技能（bundled skills） 14 個技能隨包註冊（`ctx.skills.registerProvider`，bundled rank 600——用戶自帶同名技能一律優先）： - `ga-identity`：以 General Agentics 身分自介與簽署產出 - 13 個方法論技能 vendored 自 [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)（MIT，逐字未改）： `brainstorming`、`writing-plans`、`executing-plans`、`test-driven-development`、`systematic-debugging`、`verification-before-completion`、`writing-skills`、`diagnosing-superpowers`、`subagent-driven-development`、`dispatching-parallel-agents`、`requesting-code-review`、`receiving-code-review`、`finishing-a-development-branch` ——15 個上游技能取 13；`using-superpowers`（其「任何回應前必查技能」規則與 `ga-identity` 的身分主導權衝突）與 `using-git-worktrees`（團隊 git 工作流）刻意不入，理由見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。 **感謝**：Jesse Vincent (obra) 與 superpowers 貢獻者；詳見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。 ## 精選插件（curated plugins） 隨套件安裝並自動啟用（`dependencies` ＋ `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert row；row id 一律 `ga-` 前綴，避免與用戶直裝的同名插件撞 id）。 | 插件 | 功能 | 需要什麼才會「看得見」 | |---|---|---| | `dshmarket` | 插件市集 | 設定 → Plugin Market | | `dsh-better-sidebar` | 側欄：檔案樹／編輯器／變更／任務／側聊 | 基本即有；`agentOpenTools` 與 sentinel tab 已預設開啟（只新增，不動其他 tab） | | `dsh-comments` | **自家工具**：劃選回覆片段、逐段點評，可一鍵把全部點評組裝成訊息送回 | 立即可用 | | `dsh-promptimizer` | **自家工具**：一鍵用當前選定模型改寫草稿 prompt（Light/Standard/Deep） | 需要可用的模型 | | `dsh-sentinel` | 排程監看面板（BSD-3-Clause，隨包附授權） | 立即可用；better-sidebar 的 sentinel tab 已預設開啟 | | `dsh-cost-meter` | 會話費用統計 | 每條回覆的用量行（本套件已預設 `performanceUsage: detailed`） | | `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` | 回覆內嵌互動 UI 卡片 | 本套件已預設區塊位置與提示 | | `dsh-context` | 上下文洞察／管理 | 本套件已預設開啟 fleet 分頁 | | `@liustack/modsearch` | 免費網頁＋X 搜尋聚合 | 本套件已接管 `web` 的 `searchProvider`（用戶 profile patch 可改回） | | `@ricardochen1996/dsh-browser-use` | 瀏覽器自動化 | **需 `uv`**（首次自動建 Python venv ~25MB） | | `@xmanrui/dsh-im` | 微信／飛書／企微／釘釘／TG／Slack… 橋接 | **需 IM 應用憑證**，否則只有背景日誌 | | `@liustack/modlens` | 給純文字 LLM 的視覺能力 | **需 Antigravity CLI**（未隨包） | | `dsh-mobile` | 手機／局域網安全訪問、目錄選擇器 | 佔用一個 TCP 埠（預設 3443）；同機第二個 gateway 會撞埠 | ## DSH 版本相容性（0.2.1 的安裝閘門） DSH 0.2.1 起，安裝時會先讀插件的 manifest 檢查相容性（`dsh-app-boot` 的 plugin-compatibility）：**有 `engines.dsh` 就只看它，否則檢查它對 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 peer 範圍**，用 `semver.satisfies(..., {includePrerelease:true})` 判斷。**只要有一個插件不合格，整個安裝會被拒絕並回滾**。 因此本套件： - 宣告 `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2"`（只用 `>=`，才不會把 rc 版擋掉） - 精選清單以 **0.2.1 可接受的版本**為 floor；發佈前用 `npm run check-dsh-compat` 核對 - **兩個插件目前不納入**（在 0.2.1 上無法安裝，非我們能修）： | 插件 | 原因 | |---|---| | `@michengai/dsh-agency-agents` | 所有已發佈版本的 peer 只列出 0.1.x 的 dsh，沒有任何版本被 0.2.1 接受 | | `dsh-web-search-pro` | 0.2.x 全部封頂 `<0.2.1-0`；唯一能過的是 0.1.2（降級，故不納入） | 需要它們時可手動安裝並自負風險： ```sh dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @ --dsh-version 0.2.1-rc.2 --accept-risk ``` 上游發佈相容版本後，把 row 加回 `cordis.patch.yml` 即可（`test/bundle-manifest.test.mjs` 會檢查依賴與 row 是否一致）。 ## 設定面板（Settings → General Agentics） 設定側欄多一個 **General Agentics** 分頁，回答「這個 bundle 到底裝了什麼、要不要更新」，並在介面上分成五個區塊： 1. **狀態總覽**：版本、狀態 chip（已是最新／N 項待處理／可更新）、檢查時間，以及「重新檢查」 2. **需要注意**：缺少外部依賴（`uv` 等，附一鍵複製修法）、未提供（可複製安裝指令）、直裝重複 3. **更新**：一鍵更新（二次確認）＋進度計時＋`aria-live`，失敗顯示 `code` 與原因，並有可複製的手動指令 4. **精選插件**：依用途分組（搜尋／介面／行動／自家／通訊），可篩選（全部／有新版／需注意／未提供）與搜尋；每列可展開看宣告範圍、已裝與 registry 版本、落後原因、複製安裝指令與 npm 連結 5. **隨附技能**與**前置條件**（無法隨 npm 套件提供的項目，標示已就緒／需自行確認） 首次開啟會有一張可關閉的「這個 bundle 給了你什麼」引導卡。面板語言**跟隨瀏覽器**（zh/en，可用 `localStorage['general-agentics/lang']` 覆寫），所有字串來自兩份鍵集相同的字典。 - **bundle 版本**：目前版本 vs registry 最新版（本地開發版領先 registry 時會標「本地版本領先 registry」而不是誤報有更新） - **13 個精選插件**：每個的宣告範圍、**實際已安裝版本**、registry 最新版，以及 `有新版` / `最新` / `未提供` / `直裝重複` 標記（後者代表這個 profile 又直裝了一份，會啟用兩次） - **14 個隨附技能**：名稱清單 - **更新**：一鍵更新走 profile 的 plugin manager（`installBundle`）；沒有 manager 的 profile 會顯示可複製的手動指令（**desktop profile 的 CLI 被 Electron 獨佔，請用面板按鈕**）。`link:`／`file:` 安裝會額外提示「更新會改用 registry 版本」 - **精選插件怎麼更新**：插件是上游 npm 套件的依賴，**bundle 升版本身不會移動插件版本**（pnpm 以 lock 為準）；只有當該次發佈**提高了 floor**（例如 `^0.68.1` → `^0.72.0`）時，一鍵更新才會把插件一起帶上去。發佈前用 `npm run check-upstream` 看差距，提 floor 後必須在乾淨 profile 驗證過再發（0.x 的 minor 依 semver 可能不相容） 資料來自 host 半註冊的唯讀端

plugins.description: AI 输出信任边界：检查代码有没有直接执行 AI 输出（eval/shell/SQL/路径）。
plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) **大模型安全**：直接执行模型输出（eval / shell / SQL / 文件路径）是风险很高的一类 —— 这里查代码里有没有这么干。 **关键词**：AI 输出 · AI 安全 · 提示注入 · 提示词注入 · 大模型安全 · 任意代码执行 · LLM 安全 · 大模型 **Keywords**: AI output trust · prompt injection · LLM security · code execution · OWASP LLM **AI 输出信任边界** —— 检查代码有没有直接执行 AI 输出。 ## 不装它会怎样 你的 agent 里有这么一行： ```js eval(aiResponse); ``` 想法是「让模型生成一小段脚本，我执行它」。 **但 AI 输出是不可信输入** —— 它可能被提示注入控制，也可能自己发挥。 你等于把**任意代码执行权交给了一个概率模型**。 OWASP 把这单列为 **LLM05 Improper Output Handling**。 ## 它查什么 | 级别 | 内容 | |---|---| | 🔴 严重 | `eval(aiResponse)` / `new Function(...)` | | 🔴 严重 | AI 输出拼进 `exec` / `spawn` | | 🟠 高 | AI 输出拼进 SQL | | 🟠 高 | 文件路径来自 AI 输出（路径穿越）| ## 它不会误报「只是调了模型」 变量识别用**精确命名**，不是「看到 `.content` 就报」。 **这段不报**（调了模型，但当成不可信输入处理）： ```js const raw = result.choices[0].message.content; const parsed = safeJsonParse(raw); if (!schema.validate(parsed)) throw new Error('invalid'); ``` **这段报**： ```js eval(aiResponse); ``` ## 正确的做法 ``` AI 输出 → 结构化解析 → Schema 校验 → 白名单分支 → 参数化查询 → 路径规范化 + 断言在允许根目录内 ``` ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust # 或纯 CLI npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust ``` ## 用法 ```bash dsh-ai-output-trust --demo # 看检出效果 dsh-ai-output-trust --list-rules # 列出规则和依据 dsh-ai-output-trust --html r.html ``` ![dsh-ai-output-trust 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/report.png) ![dsh-ai-output-trust 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/demo.png) ![dsh-ai-output-trust 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/rules.png) ## 边界 - **只查四种明确的高危用法**（eval / shell / SQL / 路径）。其它「间接信任」不在范围。 - **靠变量命名识别** —— 建议统一命名（`ai*` / `llm*` / `model*`），否则会漏。 - **不做数据流分析**，只看调用点附近。 - 与 [dsh-ci-guard](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) 分工：那个查 GitHub Actions 脚本注入，这个查运行时。 本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。** --- ## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 38 个） > 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。 **国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling) **AI 与 Agent 治理**（6）｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。 ---

plugins.description: Declare an enterprise world, derive the agent's tools and permissions from it, and enforce them. A platform on DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepWork

[![CI](https://github.com/zhangcun1995521/deepwork/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhangcun1995521/deepwork/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> An enterprise agent has to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
> to, and **what it is allowed to touch**. DeepWork is where an enterprise writes that down —
> and where an agent's tools and permissions are derived from it, and enforced.
>
> It is deliberately not part of an agent. The world it describes belongs to the enterprise, so
> the second agent, the third, and the one after that read the same one.

DeepWork is a platform built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). DSH ships a complete agent harness; DeepWork adds the one thing it does not ship — the
enterprise's own world, and the rules for acting in it. A plugin, not a fork, and a new domain
costs YAML rather than code.

## What the governance is, and what it is not

The rules are enforced against **declarations**, not against behaviour. A capability says what its
tool touches — which argument is a path it writes, which program it starts — and the guard judges
every call against that plus the domain's grants, before it runs and in the audit trail afterwards.
Nothing verifies the declaration against what the tool actually does. A capability that described
itself dishonestly would be trusted, and a tool that reaches the world through its own code rather
than through the shell it declared is outside the door entirely.

So the guarantee here is **advisory**: a capability that declares honestly is governed, refused when
it must be, and recorded every time — and reviewing that capability is what makes its declaration
true. What this repository does **not** claim is that nothing can exceed its authority. Claiming that
needs a boundary the current composition cannot express: one where the only way to touch the world
is a channel the guard can see, so that "undeclared" and "impossible" become the same thing. That is
the direction this project is built to move in, and it is not where it is today. The
[architecture document](docs/architecture.md) says which branches pass without judging anything, so
a reader can check the claim against the code.

## The whole project, as one line

Every part of this repository is one step of the same journey: a **world is declared**, an
**agent is equipped** from it, and what that agent does is **governed** on the way out.

```
   the enterprise's world                       what the agent gets
   ──────────────────────                       ────────────────────
①  declared    objects, relations, states,  →   a domain is data: `schema.yaml` and the
               who may write what                instances beside it

②  derived     read tools, the write tool,  →   a capability is declared, not coded —
               declared actions and queries      nothing in TypeScript to add or remove

③  authorised  `written_by` per type,       →   the host's own file and shell tools are
               roles per deployment              covered too; no roles means read-only

④  gated       states, the moves between    →   a move needing a second pair of eyes is
               them, and what each needs         refused without a verdict from somebody
                                                 other than the person making the move

⑤  recorded    the audit trail and write    →   every attempt, refusals included; field
               provenance                        names and never field values

⑥  checked     `npm run validate`           →   a declaration that did not take effect is
                                                 a failure, not a silence
```

Read it top to bottom and this repository is one thing. Read the sections below out of order
and it is a list of mechanisms.

The same line as a picture:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph assembly["assembly"]
    prof["a profile: which plugins, which roles, which domain, which mode — changing the deployment changes only this layer"]
  end

  subgraph data["a domain — data, not code"]
    schema["schema.yaml — objects · relations · functions · states and transitions · who may write · actions · queries · situation · skill"]
    inst["the instances beside it"]
  end

  subgraph dw["DeepWork — a plugin, not a fork"]
    eng["the engine — reads the domain, builds the graph, derives the edges"]
    der["derivation — the read tools and query modes, the write tool, declared actions, the lifecycle's requirements"]
    gov["governance — the guard mounted globally in front of every call, permissions derived from written_by, review checked against provenance, an audit of field names and never field values"]
    inj["injection — the rules the situation marks, in the prompt and in the catalogue"]
    cap["a capability — a second plugin, declaring what its tools touch"]
  end

  subgraph hosted["the host — DeepSeek Harness"]
    loop["the agent loop · the tool registry · the skill and prompt registries · the session"]
    own["its own file and shell tools"]
  end

  prof --> dw
  schema --> eng
  inst --> eng
  eng --> der
  eng --> gov
  eng --> inj
  der -->|"the tool surface an agent is given"| loop
  inj -->|"the rules block, and the catalogue"| loop
  gov -->|"judges each call before it runs"| loop
  cap -->|"declares, so it is judged too"| gov
  gov -->|"or the host's own tools are the way around it"| own
  loop -->|"a write that was allowed"| wrote["the instance file, and one structured audit entry"]
  gov --> refused["a refusal, and one structured audit entry naming the rule that refused"]
```

Two places in that picture answer questions people expect one place to answer, so they are worth
naming. The guard is the door: before any tool runs, may this call touch this path at all. The write
path is the desk: may this content be written, by this caller, in this state. A capability's own
tools stop at the door; this plugin's write tool passes the door unjudged and is settled at the desk,
because nothing declares `ontology_write` and it is not in the built-in table — so its authority
lives inside the tool rather than in the mounted guard.

[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) is the same route written out — the layers, one write end to end, and the limits named; and the [same document in Chinese](docs/architecture.zh.md) is there for a reader who works in Chinese.

## Who this is for

Anyone putting an agent into a real business system. A forward-deployed engineer standing up
the first use case; a platform team that has to answer "what is this agent allowed to touch,
and who approved it"; the team that inherits it six months later.

## If you only look at one thing

`packages/ontology/examples/engagement` is the whole line at small scale: four stages, three of
them gated on a signature scoped to that stage, one declared action, one relation.

```sh
corepack pnpm install            # once, right after cloning — nothing else is needed
npm run validate                  # is it sound? exit 0 or a list of what did not take effect
node packages/ontology/scripts/show-derivation.ts packages/ontology/examples/engagement
```

The second command prints what came out of the declaration — and note what it prints with no
roles configured: three read tools, no write tool, and no actions derived, because an
unconfigured deployment is a read-only one.

Then `packages/ontology/src/examples.test.ts` runs it for real — a stage cannot be entered
without its signature, a signature for one stage does not open the next, and the role that
makes a move cannot sign for it. Those three sentences are the project, and they are a test
rather than a paragraph.

## The gap this fills

DSH ships a complete agent harness — loop, tools, skills, workflows, plan mode, approval,
subagents, sandboxing. What it does not ship is any notion of *the enterprise world* the
agent is working in. A general agent sees `document_001`, `project_782`, `user_23891`. An
enterprise agent needs to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
to, and what it is allowed to touch.

That gap is semantic, not mechanical

plugins.description: Keeps archived sessions out of the DSH conversation list and adds a panel to restore them or delete them permanently - session log, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-purge

Keeps archived sessions out of the DSH conversation list, and gives them one place to be restored — or **deleted for good**, which DSH itself deliberately has no path for.

> Looking for the npm name `dsh-archive-manager`? That one belongs to a different, unrelated
> plugin. This is `dsh-archive-purge`.

![The archived-session panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge/main/docs/panel.png)

*Every screenshot here is rendered from invented sessions — no real titles, paths or sizes.*

## The two gaps it closes

DSH can archive a session, but:

- **Archiving is only a view concern.** The sidebar keeps rendering archived rows whenever *View options → Archived* is set to show them, and it keeps them in archived search results too. There is no switch that means "never show these".
- **Nothing ever deletes a session.** `dsh-client-ui-workspace` documents no session deletion and `dsh-session-persistence` documents no delete seam, so archived sessions accumulate on disk forever.

This plugin closes both: it pins archived sessions out of the list, and it owns the erase path.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-archive-purge
```

Use your own profile name in place of `desktop` (for example `web`). Then switch it on under **Settings → Plugins**, where it appears as `dsh-archive-purge`. Turning it off disables the host routes and the browser panel together and leaves session data untouched.

## What it does

| | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **Always hidden** | In the sidebar conversation list, an archived session row is never shown — whatever *View options → Archived* is set to. A component registered on `shell.overlay` writes `[data-row-key="session:<id>"]{display:none}` for every id in the registry's `archivedSessionIds`, plus a fallback rule keyed on the accessible description so archived search-result rows are covered as well. |
| **Filter reset** | The browser-persisted `dsh.workspace.view.v5` has its `archivedFilter` reset to the shipped default (`default`, i.e. "hide archived"), so the menu stops claiming "All conversations (show archived)" while showing nothing. |
| **Management panel** | A sidebar icon plus a centre-column panel lists every archived session with its workspace, path, disk footprint, creation time and child-session count; it supports search, multi-select and batch unarchive. |
| **Permanent delete** | Delete sessions one at a time or in bulk, behind a confirmation dialog that names the sessions, their size, and exactly what will be removed. |

The panel takes its colours from the host's `--dsw-alias-*` tokens and ships English and Chinese wording, so it follows whichever theme and locale the app is in rather than a look of its own.

## Permanent delete: the exact boundary

![The confirmation dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge/main/docs/confirm.png)

One delete removes four things:

1. **The session log directory** `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/<encoded-session-id>/` — the session's own directory, every format generation in it, and any session-local artifact;
2. **The projection-cache record** `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`;
3. **The archive and pin records** (`archivedSessionIds` / `pinnedSessionIds` in the workspace registry);
4. **The row in your browser** — announced through the session controller's own `api-session/removed` remote event (`@mode emit`) so the client drops the row instead of leaving a clickable ghost.

**Deliberately kept:** attachment files. Attachments are content-addressed and may be shared with other sessions, so they are out of scope. The panel says so at the bottom. An archived entry whose log is already gone from disk only has its record cleaned up, and the button reads "Clear record" instead.

## Refusals run before any write

![A batch that skipped one session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge/main/docs/refusals.png)

A batch reports each outcome separately: what was deleted and how much it freed, what had no log left to delete, and what was refused — named, with the reason.

- The session is **not in the archive set** → skipped. Deletion is only ever available for archived sessions.
- An **agent for that session still exists in this process** (`ctx.agents.get(id)`) → refused (`live`). An agent may already hold the log's write handle, and deleting the file underneath it would let the writer resurrect the log.
- The `workspace/session-activity` waterfall still reports **work in progress** → refused (`active`).
- The target directory is not **inside the configured sessions root**, or its name is not exactly the encoded session id → refused (`outside-root`).

Being merely *loaded* is deliberately **not** a refusal reason: the browser keeps an in-memory mirror for every rendered session row and never releases it, so refusing on that would make every archived session undeletable after enough browsing. The gate matches DSH's own archive gate (the activity waterfall) plus one cheaper agent check. Skipped and failed sessions are listed individually in the panel, with the reason.

## Ghost rows, and the two layers that remove them

DSH's browser session list is **event-driven**: it only adds and removes entries in response to `api-session/added` / `api-session/removed`. A deleted session also leaves the archive set, so in the sidebar it goes from "hidden" to "should be shown" — and the cached row becomes a visible, clickable row that fails with `session/not-found` when opened.

Two layers remove it:

- **Host side (authoritative).** After a successful delete and *before* the archive set is rewritten, the host emits `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)` — the remote event the session controller defines and forwards for exactly this fact. The client receives a `{ kind: 'remove', sessionId }` change and drops the row. Emitting before the registry write avoids a flash where the row is un-hidden and then disappears.
- **Client side (self-healing fallback).** The inventory carries `persistedIds` — the session ids the host's persistence layer actually knows. The panel diffs the browser's cached ids against it, folds the remainder into the same hide rule, and shows the count under the title. The diff is recomputed on every read rather than accumulated, so one failed read cannot permanently hide a live session. Ids deleted within this page session are tracked separately as a union, since that needs no read to take effect.

**If you deleted sessions before both layers existed**, those leftover rows need one page reload to disappear — the client re-fetches the list from the host on load. Deletions made afterwards do not leave them.

## Known leftovers

- **Dangling ids in workspace membership.** `tables.workspaces.<id>.sessionIds` is a persisted member array and the host exposes no "remove a member" operation (`insertSessionBefore` only inserts and orders). A deleted session's id therefore stays in that array. DSH tolerates missing members — it looks up a summary while deriving rows and skips what it cannot find — so this never renders as a row. It is bookkeeping residue, not a UI problem.
- **Agent lifetime.** Archiving only stops, hides and gates a session; it does not destroy the agent. Agents are reclaimed when the agent-loop provider unloads or the process exits. A session archived in the current DSH process is therefore refused by this plugin until you restart DSH. See *Refusals* above.

## Maintenance notes

- To land a delete precisely, the host half **copies verbatim** the `encodeSegment` function from `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`. If a DSH upgrade changes the session directory layout, that function has to follow it. Until then a delete refuses (because the directory name is not the encoded session id, or holds no session log) rather than removing the wrong thing.
- The client hide rule depends on the sidebar's `data-row-key="session:<id>"` attribute, which `dsh-client-ui-workspace` adds itself. If that ever changes, the `aria-description` fallback rule still applies.
- There is **no build step and no runtime dependency**: both halves are plain ESM shipp

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering & productivity skills, adapted for DeepSeek Harness as a Cordis bundle plugin. MIT licensed.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Matt Pocock Skills

> Matt Pocock's [engineering and productivity skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), adapted for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DSH) as a Cordis bundle plugin.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

## What's Included

This plugin provides the skills from Matt Pocock's repository that **do not overlap** with DSH built-in skills. The following are already built into DSH and are therefore **not** duplicated here:

| DSH Built-in | Matt's Equivalent |
|---|---|
| `tdd` | `tdd` |
| `grilling` | `grilling` |
| `diagnosing-bugs` | `diagnosing-bugs` |
| `code-review` | `code-review` |
| `prototype` | `prototype` |
| `research` | `research` |
| `wizard` | `wizard` |
| `writing-for-agents` | `writing-for-agents` |
| `domain-modeling` | `domain-modeling` |
| `codebase-design` | `codebase-design` |

### Skills Provided by This Plugin

#### Engineering (user-invoked)

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `ask-matt` | Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the user-invoked skills. |
| `grill-with-docs` | Grilling session that also builds your project's domain model, sharpening terminology and updating `GLOSSARY.md` and ADRs inline. |
| `triage` | Move issues through a state machine of triage roles. |
| `improve-codebase-architecture` | Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick. |
| `setup-matt-pocock-skills` | Configure this repo for the engineering skills (issue tracker, triage labels, domain doc layout). Run once per repo. |
| `to-spec` | Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker. |
| `to-tickets` | Break any plan, spec, or conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets. |
| `implement` | Build the work described by a spec or set of tickets, driving TDD at pre-agreed seams. |
| `implement-spec` | Implement a whole spec on one integration branch using concurrent subagents. |
| `wayfinder` | Plan a huge chunk of work as a shared map of decision tickets, then resolve them one at a time. |
| `retro` | Suggest improvements to the coding agent's environment after a session. |
| `pr` | The shape a pull request body should take. |

#### Productivity (user-invoked)

| Skill | Description |
|---|---|
| `grill-me` | Get relentlessly interviewed about a plan or design. |
| `handoff` | Compact the current conversation into a handoff document. |
| `teach` | Teach the user a new skill or concept over multiple sessions. |
| `to-questionnaire` | Turn a decision into a Markdown questionnaire for the person who can answer it. |
| `wait-what` | Re-pitch a message with the context you're missing. |

## Installation

### Option 1: Install as a DSH Cordis Bundle (recommended)

1. Clone this repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Henrycheheng/dsh-plugin-matt-skills.git
   cd dsh-plugin-matt-skills
   ```

2. In your DSH session, ask the agent to install the bundle:
   > "Please install the bundle at `/path/to/dsh-matt-pocock-skills` using plugin_manager"

3. After installation, the skills appear in your session skill catalog.

### Option 2: Copy to `~/.dsh/skills/` (simple, no plugin)

```bash
# Copy only the skill directories you want
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills
cp -r assets/skills/grill-with-docs ~/.dsh/skills/
cp -r assets/skills/ask-matt ~/.dsh/skills/
# ... etc
```

DSH's filesystem skill provider automatically discovers skills under `~/.dsh/skills/`.

## Usage

Once installed, skills are available via the DSH skill system:

- **User-invoked skills**: mention the skill name in conversation (e.g., "use ask-matt", "run grill-with-docs")
- **Model-invoked skills**: the agent automatically selects them when the task matches

## Adaptation Notes

The original skills were written for Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI. This DSH adaptation:

- Replaces `sub-agent` references with DSH's `subagent` tool
- Replaces Claude Code-specific tool calls with DSH equivalents
- Adds DSH-compatible YAML frontmatter (`whenToUse`, `user-invocable`, `disable-model-invocation`)
- Skips skills already built into DSH to avoid duplicates

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

- Original skill content: Copyright © 2026 Matt Pocock
- DSH adaptation and plugin plumbing: Copyright © 2025 Contributors

plugins.description: AI research toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: model release radar, model benchmark & community report, AI news digest. 零依赖 Node，4 工具 + 3 技能。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ai-research

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ai-research.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ai-research)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-ai-research.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

**AI 研究三件套** —— 三套零依赖的 Node 工具 + 三份技能 + 一个 DSH 宿主插件：

| 工具 | 回答什么问题 | 数据面 |
|---|---|---|
| **ai-model-radar** | 「最近发了哪些新模型？」 | 发布追踪站 / OpenRouter 上架记录 / 官方博客 RSS / GitHub release / arXiv / Hacker News |
| **model-report** | 「某模型实测、口碑怎么样？A 和 B 哪个强？」 | 13 路结构化跑分（Artificial Analysis、Vals AI 50 基准、SWE-bench、SWE-rebench、ARC Prize、LMArena 人类盲测、llm-stats、benchlm…）+ 英文社区（HN / X / Reddit）+ 中文社区（B站 / CSDN / 微信公众号 / 掘金 / 知乎 / 小红书）+ 2~4 模型重合基准逐项横评 |
| **ai-news-radar** | 「AI 圈最近发生了什么？」 | 46 个 RSS/HTML 源 + 22 个官方 X 账号（按天轮转）+ Google/Bing 新闻检索 + HN / Reddit / 微信公众号，按 8 个主题分类去重 |

产物都是**带来源链接的 Markdown**（一份文档一个 H1 → 元信息引用块 → 目录 → 自动编号章节），
可直接给人读，也可喂给模型做二次解读。**所有数据都来自公开网页 / 公开接口，无 API key 依赖。**

> 研究用途。抓到的是**当时网页上写的东西**，不是事实核验；引用时请连同数据截止时间与数据缺口一起引用。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-ai-research/
  tools/                      # 工具源码（单一事实来源，零依赖纯 Node ESM）
    ai-model-radar/           #   collect / summarize / renderMarkdown / run.mjs 命令行
    model-report/             #   13 路结构化源 + 中文社区 + X/Reddit + LMArena(parquet) + 渲染
    ai-news-radar/            #   源清单 + 采集 + 分类去重 + 渲染 + cli.mjs
  skills/                     # 三份技能正文（Markdown + frontmatter）
  packages/dsh-ai-research/   # 可发布的 DSH 插件包（宿主半，注册 4 工具 + 3 技能）
    index.js                  #   注册与参数校验；工具实现在运行时 import
    cordis.patch.yml          #   profile 插入点
    sync-tools.mjs            #   tools/ → 包内 tools/（发布前 --check）
    sync-skills.mjs           #   skills/ → 包内 skills/（发布前 --check）
    tools/  skills/           #   生成物：包内自包含副本（勿手改）
  PUBLISHING.md               # 发布与投稿清单（npm / 插件目录 / Discussions）
```

## 快速开始（不需要 DSH）

需要 **Node ≥ 18**（用到内置 `fetch`；建议 20+）。无需 `npm install`，仓库零依赖。

```bash
# 最近 7 天有哪些新模型
node tools/ai-model-radar/run.mjs --days 7 --out ./digests

# 某模型体检（--brief 只出一页素材包，快得多）
node tools/model-report/cli.mjs "Gemini 4 Argon" --out ./results
node tools/model-report/cli.mjs "Gemini 4 Argon" --brief --fast

# 2~4 个模型横评（--auto 3 = 自动挑 3 个段位相近的对手）
node tools/model-report/cli.mjs --vs "Gemini 4 Argon,Claude Opus 5.5" --auto 3 --out ./results

# AI 圈新闻日报
node tools/ai-news-radar/cli.mjs --days 1 --out ./digests
node tools/ai-news-radar/cli.mjs --list-sources        # 列源清单
```

常用开关：`--fast` / `--no-x` / `--no-reddit` / `--no-lmarena` / `--no-cn` / `--per-source 5` / `--json`。
想看模块化调用（自己写脚本）见 `skills/*.md` —— 它们同时是**给 agent 的操作手册**，把每个源怎么解析、有哪些坑都写在里面。

## 装成 DSH 插件

插件让这三个工具在**任何会话 / 工作区**都能直接调（4 个工具：`ai_model_radar` / `model_report` / `ai_news_radar` / `ai_fetch_article`）。

**A. 从 npm 装（推荐）**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-ai-research          # 或：node "<DSH app>/lib/plugin-cli.js" desktop add dsh-ai-research
```

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主启动时组装 bundle 图），这三个技能与四个工具在任何会话里都能调。

**B. 本机 link（开发用）** —— 见 `packages/dsh-ai-research/README.md` 的「本机安装」。

**C. 手工三步**（等价于官方 CLI）：profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dependencies` 加一条、`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾加一条、`node_modules` 下建软链，然后**重启 DSH**（宿主插件在启动时组装 bundle 图）。

工具实现在插件里是**运行时 import**：包内 `tools/`（由 `sync-tools.mjs` 同步进来，自包含）；
包内没有 `tools/` 时回退到"本文件上两级"的源码布局；两者都可用插件配置的 `root` 覆盖。

## 环境变量

**一切运行期状态都在用户主目录，不在仓库里** —— 所以仓库可以放心公开，工具也不会因为升级包而丢缓存。

| 变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_HOME` | 状态根目录（缓存 / cookie / 限流状态） | `~/.dsh-ai-research` |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_PROXY` · `MODEL_REPORT_PROXY` · `MR_PROXY` · `HTTPS_PROXY` · `HTTP_PROXY` | 出网代理（按此顺序取第一个非空；`off`/`0`/`none` = 关闭） | 未设 = **直连** |
| `NO_PROXY` / `no_proxy` | 免代理主机（支持 `*`、`example.com`、`.example.com`） | — |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_COOKIES` · `MODEL_REPORT_COOKIES` | cookie 文件路径 | `<home>/cookies.json` |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_CHROME` · `CHROME_PATH` · `CHROME_BIN` | 浏览器可执行文件（小红书走无头 Chrome） | 按平台常见安装位置 + `PATH` 自动探测 |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_CHROME_PROFILE` | 无头浏览器 profile 目录 | 系统临时目录 `dsh-chrome-xhs` |
| `DSH_AI_RESEARCH_OUT` | ai-news-radar 的默认落盘目录 | `./digests` |

国内网络环境常常需要代理才能访问 HF / Google News / Reddit / X，例如：

```bash
DSH_AI_RESEARCH_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 node tools/model-report/cli.mjs "某模型"
```

## 需要自备的凭据（可选）

只有两个源要登录态，**没有也能跑**（会在报告的「数据缺口」里显式声明，绝不静默返空）：

- **知乎**、**小红书** —— cookie 放进 `<home>/cookies.json`，字段名 `zhihu` / `xiaohongshu`。
  导入方式见 `skills/model-report.md`：`node tools/model-report/set-cookie.mjs zhihu ["<关键词>"] --test`。
- cookie 文件等同登录凭据：**不要提交、不要外发**（`.gitignore` 已挡）。

## 已知边界（都写在技能文件里，这里只列结论）

- **抓取是有礼貌的**：串行 + 间隔的请求节奏、磁盘缓存、以及真被限流时的熔断与 `gaps` 声明。
  X 的 syndication 是硬配额（30 次 / 15 分钟）；小红书走无头浏览器且每天新开页面上限 4 次，命中风控即 24h 冷却。
- **有些站就是拿不到**（Cloudflare / 登录墙 / 客户端渲染），技能里逐条记了「试过但拿不到，别再重复探」，例如 lmarena.ai 站点本体、HuggingFace 模型卡正文、Bloomberg / FT / Reuters 正文。
- **不同源的分数不可混算**：AA 智能指数、benchlm 综合分、LMArena Elo 是三套刻度，只能各自内部比；横评里只对**同名基准**做逐项对比（同名 harness 也可能不同，只能当方向参考）。
- 命令示例以 **Windows / PowerShell** 为准（源码作者在 Windows 上开发）；macOS / Linux 把 `$env:X=...` 换成 `X=... 命令` 即可，路径与浏览器探测都已按平台分支。

## 开发

```bash
# 改完 tools/ 或 skills/ 后同步进包（发布前用 --check 卡住漂移）
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-tools.mjs
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-skills.mjs
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-tools.mjs  --check
node packages/dsh-ai-research/sync-skills.mjs --check

# 语法自检
node --check tools/model-report/lib.mjs
```

改插件本体（`packages/dsh-ai-research/index.js`）后要**重启 DSH** 才生效。

## 发布

见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)：GitHub 建仓（`dsh-plugin` topic + 满 1 天）→ npm 发布 → 两个插件目录 PR → 官方 Discussions「Show Your Plugins!」。

## License

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH skill map: all your loaded skills, sorted into your own categories, in a right-sidebar tab.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-map

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![dsh-skill-map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/main/assets/banner.svg)

**It sorts all your skills, so you can find the right one fast.**

Once you have installed a lot of skills in DSH, the names stop telling you which one does what. This plugin (a small add-on for DSH) puts them on one page in the right sidebar, and you group them your own way. Code in one pile, docs in another, spreadsheets in a third — or often used and rarely used.

What you sort is saved on your own computer, so a new version of the plugin will not wipe it.

## What it looks like

![The skill map panel: workspace tabs on top, skills sorted into categories, Unassigned and the total at the bottom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/main/assets/skill-map-panel.png)

## What it does

- One more page in the right sidebar, just for skills.
- One workspace is one way of sorting. Click the little tab on top to switch to another way.
- Want to keep another way of sorting? Click "+" to make one; double-click a tab to rename it, click "×" to delete it (it asks first).
- On first open, you can let AI sort everything for you once.
- Or make your own categories first, then let AI put the skills that are still loose into them. Anything you placed stays where you put it.
- Categories can be renamed, dragged into a new order, or deleted. Drag a skill and it moves to another category.
- Each skill is one line: the name, then one sentence about what it does. Hover over the line to see which GitHub project it came from and a longer description.
- The search box finds skills by name and by those descriptions.
- Click a line and `/skill-name` is copied, ready to paste into the composer.
- Not sure where a skill goes yet? Drop it in "Unassigned" at the bottom of the list.
- If a description looks thin, press Update and let AI write more. AI never overwrites a line you wrote yourself.

## Install

Install DSH first. Then paste this line into a terminal and press Enter:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kissfire/dsh-skill-map
```

Restart `dsh web`, and the right sidebar gets one more tab: "Skill Map".

If that does not work, download the ready-built package instead. The link never changes and always points at the newest release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/kissfirembx/dsh-skill-map/releases/latest/download/kissfire-dsh-skill-map.tgz
```

## License

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

## For more detail

The fine print, for people who want it. Click to open.

<details>
<summary>Where it shows up, where the file lives, changing the language</summary>

- With `dsh-better-sidebar` installed it is a tab in that sidebar; without it, a tab in the official right Sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`), opened once on first load.
- When neither right sidebar is running it falls back to a central panel and adds an icon in the sidebar's panel list, so there is always a way in.
- Everything you sort lives in `$DSH_HOME/skill-map/map.json`. If the file is missing or broken it goes back to "no workspace yet" instead of planting a classification you never confirmed.
- The gear in the header switches the description language: the skill's own text, or a translation cache in `$DSH_HOME/skill-map/descriptions.<lang>.json`. A skill with no row in the cache keeps its own text.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Config</summary>

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Master switch for the host routes. |
| `customSkillDirs` | string[] | Extra skill roots to scan besides the official ones. |
| `dshHome` | string | DSH home override; the workspace document lives under it. |
| `agentsHome` | string | Agents home override (`~/.agents`). |
| `syncModel` | string | Model route (`provider/model`) used by Update and auto classify. Defaults to the model this profile's agent runs. |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Routes</summary>

| Route | Method | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/list` | GET | Every skill, plus each workspace with its placements resolved. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/save` | POST | Writes the whole workspace document. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/workspaces/auto` | POST | Classify with the model: propose a scheme for an empty workspace, place only the unassigned skills in one that already has categories. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/health` | GET | Health check carrying the skill and workspace counts. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/sync` | POST | Asks the model for the missing and changed copy. |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Security and limits</summary>

- At most 20 workspaces, and at most 200 categories per workspace; categories are flat, with no nesting.
- Every route is loopback-only (or a paired device), and skill roots are read-only; the plugin writes only its own files under the DSH home directory.
- The workspace document is written atomically and parsed defensively; a broken file degrades to the blank state.
- Update and auto classify need an `llm` service in the profile; without one they report it as unavailable, and a scheme proposal falls back to the built-in table.
- The browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC day (random id plus package name): [src/client/telemetry.ts](src/client/telemetry.ts).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Development and release</summary>

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
```

To ship: bump `version` in `package.json`, run `pnpm publish:npm`, then attach the `npm pack` artifact to a GitHub release.

</details>

plugins.description: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness: memory and system prompt, search routing, interactive visual cards, prompt rewriting.
plugins.readme_text: # DSH 插件集 **中文** | [English](#english) 一套用于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 桌面版的插件。每个独立成仓库、独立安装 —— 只取你需要的即可。 ## 插件一览 | 插件 | 作用 | |---|---| | [dsh-memory-system-prompt](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-memory-system-prompt) | 全局记忆（AI 主动写入与读取）+ 用户级系统提示词。索引每轮注入但不占上下文。 | | [dsh-web-search-router](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-web-search-router) | 按模型通道分流搜索：官方账号走 DeepSeek 官方搜索，其它通道走你的自建服务。失败时给出可读原因，而不是一句 500。 | | [dsh-visual-card](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-visual-card) | AI 交一段 HTML，在对话里渲染成可交互卡片 —— 能点、能键盘操作、能全屏、能导出。 | | [dsh-prompt-crafter](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-prompt-crafter) | 发送键旁一个按钮，把草稿改写成更好的提示词。三档力度；内置免费模型通道，零配置零费用，不可用时自动回退。 | ## 安装 **推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用： ``` dsh-visual-card ``` 安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。 命令行方式（先完全退出应用）： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` 然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。 > 四个包都已发布到 npm，当前版本 `1.0.0`。 ## 共同的取舍 这几个插件针对同一版 Harness 编写，有几处一致的判断： - **Host 与 Client 分开。** 凡是涉及模型可见状态的（工具、路由、提示词装配）都在 `index.js` 里跑在 Host；用户看得见的在 `client.js` 里填槽位。改 Host 要重启，改 Client 通常刷新页面即可。 - **填槽位，不改造。** 都不修改宿主原有界面，只往宿主已经渲染的槽位里注册内容，所以 Harness 升级不会悄悄把它们弄坏。 - **失败要说清楚。** 配置不对时，提示直接指出该去改哪个设置，而不是甩一段堆栈。 - **设置在 `~/.dsh/` 下。** 每个插件各占一个目录，卸载包不会删数据，重装后自动接上。 ## 许可 MIT，各仓库内有独立副本。 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) A set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Desktop. Each lives in its own repository and installs independently — take only the ones you want. ## The plugins | Plugin | What it does | |---|---| | [dsh-memory-system-prompt](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-memory-system-prompt) | Global memory the model writes and reads itself, plus a user-level system prompt. The index is injected every turn without consuming context. | | [dsh-web-search-router](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-web-search-router) | Routes search by model channel: official DeepSeek search on account routes, your own endpoint elsewhere. Readable failure reasons instead of a bare 500. | | [dsh-visual-card](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-visual-card) | The model hands over HTML and it renders as an interactive card in the conversation — clickable, keyboard-operable, fullscreen, exportable. | | [dsh-prompt-crafter](https://github.com/MCJF28/dsh-prompt-crafter) | One button next to the send key rewrites your draft into a better prompt. Three levels; bundled free model channel, zero cost and zero setup, falls back automatically. | ## Install **The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app: ``` dsh-visual-card ``` The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits. From the command line (quit the app completely first): ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-visual-card ``` Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app. > All four packages are published to npm at `1.0.0`. ## Common ground These plugins were built against the same Harness and share a few deliberate decisions: - **Host versus client split.** Anything that touches model-visible state (tools, routing, prompt assembly) runs in `index.js` on the host; anything the user sees runs in `client.js` and fills a slot. Host changes need a restart, client changes usually just a page refresh. - **Slots, not forks.** None of them modify the shipped UI. They register into slots the host already renders, so a Harness update cannot silently break them. - **Readable failures.** When something is misconfigured, the message names the setting to fix, rather than surfacing a stack trace. - **Settings live in `~/.dsh/`.** Each plugin keeps its own directory there, so uninstalling the package leaves the data behind and reinstalling picks it up again. ## License MIT. See each repository for its own copy.

plugins.description: Xiaoyaoyou glyph-water background for DeepSeek Harness new conversations: flowing text light, ripples, and sparse accents.
plugins.readme_text:
# 逍遥游 · Glyph Water

A DeepSeek Harness visual plugin for the **new conversation screen only**.
Fixed Chinese glyphs form a quiet surface. Their opacity flows like mist;
clicks create outward ripples, with sparse blue accent clusters.

一个只在 **新建会话页** 生效的 DeepSeek Harness 背景插件。
字形固定，明暗流动。点击空白区域会荡开涟漪。
进入已有对话或插件页后，背景自动卸载。

## Screenshots / 效果截图

Two user-provided screenshots, shown as a looping GIF.
Each screenshot stays visible for 2.5 seconds. This is a slideshow,
not a recording of the continuous animation.

使用两张实机截图制作循环 GIF，每张停留 2.5 秒。
这是截图轮播，不是连续动画录屏。

![Two screenshot states of the Xiaoyaoyou glyph-water background](docs/images/preview.gif)

Original images / 原始清晰截图：
[截图一](docs/images/new-conversation.png) · [截图二](docs/images/new-conversation-ripple.png)

## Companion editor / 配套编辑器

[Glyph Studio](https://github.com/Aimer779/glyph-studio) is the standalone
editor behind this plugin. Use its parameter panel to explore text, gradients,
ripples and accent colors. This repository contains the DSH integration.

需要可视化调参时，使用原项目
[字间 · Glyph Studio](https://github.com/Aimer779/glyph-studio)。
它提供文字、渐变、波纹和点缀的参数面板。
导出的参数可写入本插件的 `theme.json`，再重新构建安装。

## Install / 安装

**Tested and declared compatible with DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` only.**
Desktop on Windows was tested. Other versions and platforms are unverified.
The manifest restricts installation to that DSH version.

1. Download `local-dsh-xiaoyaoyou-0.1.0.tgz` from
   [Releases](https://github.com/Aimer779/dsh-xiaoyaoyou/releases/tag/v0.1.0).
2. Open a terminal in the download directory and run:

   ```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./local-dsh-xiaoyaoyou-0.1.0.tgz
   ```

3. Restart DeepSeek Harness. Open **Plugins** and confirm that
   **逍遥游 · 字间水面 / Xiaoyaoyou · Glyph Water** is enabled.
4. Open a new conversation.

安装包已包含前端构建产物，无需安装时构建。
在下载目录执行上述命令，再重启 DSH。
在插件页确认开关已启用，打开新建会话即可。

The package is distributed through GitHub Releases, **not npm**.
Its package identifier is `@local/dsh-xiaoyaoyou`.
`private: true` prevents accidental npm publication; it does not prevent
installation from the release archive.

Disable it from the Plugins page. To uninstall:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @local/dsh-xiaoyaoyou
```

## Behavior / 效果

- Fixed 18 × 20 px glyph grid, using a passage from Zhuangzi's *Xiaoyaoyou*.
- Flowing opacity fields; glyphs do not translate or jitter.
- Click ripples with a narrow crest and a fading wake.
- Sparse, irregular clusters of accent-colored glyphs.
- Pale radial gradient confined to the new conversation content area.
- Input fields, buttons, menus and links do not trigger ripples.
- Hidden windows pause animation; reduced-motion preference shows a still field.
- Leaving the hero screen releases the canvas, animation and event listeners.

The supplied preset uses propagation speed 1200, idle depth 0.23,
threshold 0.31, and four accent clusters of seven glyphs each.
The original tuning panel is not included in this plugin.

## Customize and build / 修改与构建

Requires Node.js 22 or newer. No package dependencies are required.
React is supplied by the DSH frontend module loader.

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Aimer779/dsh-xiaoyaoyou.git
cd dsh-xiaoyaoyou
node build.mjs
node --test test/*.test.cjs
pnpm pack --out local-dsh-xiaoyaoyou-0.1.0.tgz
```

Edit `theme.json`, then rebuild and reinstall the archive.
Do not edit generated `client.js` directly.
No localhost server or original Glyph Studio checkout is needed.

修改 `theme.json` 后，重新构建并安装生成的包。
文字、渐变色、点缀颜色和动画参数都保存在此文件中。

## Integration and limits / 接入边界

The plugin registers through DSH's `window.__ModuleLoader__` and
`shell.overlay` slot. The adapter attaches a decorative layer to:

```css
[data-phase="hero"] [data-conversation-content][data-content-phase="hero"]
```

This semantic DOM contract was verified against the desktop's bundled
`0.2.1-rc.2` frontend. It is not a guaranteed public background-slot API.
If DSH changes that contract, the adapter must be updated.
If no matching node exists, the plugin displays nothing.

There are no agent tools, network requests, telemetry or conversation-text reads.
The decoration uses `aria-hidden` and does not capture pointer events.
It does not modify DSH's application files or global theme settings.

## Verification / 验证

Verified on 2026-10-18:

- New conversation: glyph field and click ripple visible.
- Existing conversation and Plugins page: no plugin background.
- Return to new conversation: background returns.
- Automated lifecycle tests: mount once, unmount, dispose, pause when hidden,
  reduced motion, and no restart from deferred font readiness after disposal.

No test message was sent to a model. The first-send transition was not tested
end to end; its lifecycle state change is covered by the adapter tests.
Other DSH releases, dark mode, platforms and the Web profile are unverified.

## Source and license

Effect algorithms originated in [Glyph Studio](https://github.com/Aimer779/glyph-studio).
The classical Chinese passage is public-domain text.
Plugin code: [MIT](LICENSE).

DSH references:
[plugin packaging guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md),
[community contribution guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

plugins.description: Expose a stdio MCP server (Playwright, Chrome DevTools, any MCP) as native DeepSeek Harness tools
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-host

Expose **any stdio MCP server** as native DeepSeek Harness tools. Host-only plugin, no browser UI, no npm dependencies.

Built for one job: let a DSH agent drive a browser through the official **Microsoft Playwright MCP** server, attached to the Edge/Chrome you are already using.

## What it does

1. On load, spawns the MCP server once (default `npx --yes @playwright/mcp@latest --cdp-endpoint=msedge`).
2. Calls `initialize` + `tools/list`, converts each tool's JSON Schema into a DSH parameter schema, and registers it with `ctx.tools.register`.
3. Every tool call is forwarded as `tools/call`; the result is returned as JSON. Images (screenshots) are written to a temp file and returned as a path, not as base64.

Tools are renamed: `browser_navigate` becomes `edge_navigate` (prefix configurable).

## Default tool set (12 of Playwright's 25)

`edge_navigate`, `edge_navigate_back`, `edge_snapshot`, `edge_click`, `edge_type`, `edge_fill_form`, `edge_press_key`, `edge_tabs`, `edge_take_screenshot`, `edge_evaluate`, `edge_wait_for`, `edge_close`.

The full set costs prompt space in every session, which is why it is not the default. Set `MCP_BRIDGE_ALL=1` to expose everything.

## Install

```powershell
cd E:\dsh
.\rollback.cmd guard add "file:C:\path\to\dsh-mcp-host"
.\rollback.cmd health
```

Restart DSH (or rely on hot-load) and open a new session.

## Configuration

| Env var | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_COMMAND` | `npx --yes @playwright/mcp@latest --cdp-endpoint=msedge` | The MCP server command line (any stdio MCP server) |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_PREFIX` | `edge` | Tool name prefix |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_ALL` | unset | `1` = register every tool the server offers |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_TOOLS` | unset | Comma-separated allow-list of MCP tool names |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT` | `120000` | Per-call timeout (ms) |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_INIT_TIMEOUT` | `30000` | Startup timeout (ms) |

## Prerequisite for the Edge/Chrome you are already using

Open `edge://inspect/#remote-debugging` (or `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`) and enable **Allow remote debugging for this browser instance**. Then `--cdp-endpoint=msedge` (or `=chrome`) attaches to that running browser with your logins and extensions. Without the toggle, Playwright launches a fresh browser instead.

## Failure behaviour

If the MCP server cannot start or does not answer, the plugin **registers nothing and logs the reason** 鈥?it never throws, so it cannot take the host boot down. Check `MCP_BRIDGE_INIT_TIMEOUT` and the stderr tail printed in the DSH console.

## Privacy

The bridge itself makes no network calls. It spawns exactly one child process (the MCP server you configured) and forwards bytes between it and the tool call. With `--cdp-endpoint`, the MCP server attaches to your existing browser, which means it can see and act on the tabs you have open 鈥?treat that as giving the agent your browser session.

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: OpenChamber-style handoff review for DeepSeek Harness: linked read-only review sessions, round by round.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-handoff-review

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin that hands the
current session's changes to a linked, **read-only review session** — a
round-by-round handoff review in the spirit of OpenChamber.

The implementation session keeps working; an ordinary review session in the same
workspace reviews the change in an independent context. Its report can be sent
back to the implementer, later revisions can be sent back to the reviewer, and
every round is kept in a durable link record. The plugin only adds commands,
routes, projections, listeners and UI slots: nothing is written into the DSH
kernel, and removing the bundle removes everything it registered.

**交接續作 / handoff continuation** is the other direction: a compact `交接`
button in the composer turns the current session into a deterministic handoff
prompt for a **new ordinary session** in the same workspace, so long-running work
can continue in a fresh context. The existing review flow is unchanged; the
continuation surface is purely additive (new routes, slot registrations and
locale keys only).

![Handoff review panel](docs/screenshots/panel.png)

*Link state, both sessions, actions and round history in the right-sidebar
panel (session and link ids masked).*

![Handoff review settings](docs/screenshots/settings.png)

*Reviewer route and handoff limits under Settings → Handoff Review.*

## Features

- **One command to start.** `/handoff-review focus on retry logic` (or the
  composer dock button) creates or reuses a link, opens a review session and
  delivers a handoff brief: goal, review focus, changed files, unified diff,
  verification and open questions.
- **Read-only reviewer.** Three independent layers: a durable
  `sandbox/mode: read-only` session event, removal/denial of write tools on the
  reviewer's scoped tool runtime, and an `approval: never` policy.
- **Round loop.** Send the reviewer's report back to the implementation session;
  after the fixes, send only the changes after the last handoff watermark as
  round + 1. `maxRounds`, per-round dedupe and a delivery rate limit keep the
  loop bounded.
- **Panel and history.** Right-sidebar panel with link state, both sessions with
  real navigation, expandable round history, handoff/report previews, a
  changed-files diff drawer, and multi-link selection in the dock.
- **Optional auto-continue.** Start the review once and reports/revisions are
  delivered automatically when each turn ends, until a stop condition (see
  below).
- **Configurable reviewer.** Provider, model, thinking effort and agent preset,
  picked from the installed catalog.
- **交接續作 / continuation handoff.** A compact `交接` button opens a
  lightweight modal with a read-only preview of the exact prompt that will start
  the new session, **provider / model / thinking-effort selectors** for that
  session (defaulting to the source route, with the effort list following the
  chosen model), and an optional supplement. Confirming creates an ordinary
  **writable** session in the same workspace, titles it
  `Continuation: <source title>`, and delivers the prompt as its first user
  message so the new agent starts immediately.
- **Localized UI.** English and Traditional Chinese, light/dark via theme
  tokens.

## Requirements

- DSH Desktop (`0.2.x`), **or** a matching `dsh` CLI serving the Web GUI with
  `dsh web` (`0.2.x`). Both GUIs use the same Web client and the same
  per-profile **Plugins** page. The profile must be base-backed and provide
  `ctx.storageDomain` (the shipped `desktop` and `web` profiles do).
- Node.js >= 20 for development and tests only; a built checkout needs no build
  step.

## Install (DSH Desktop or `dsh web` GUI)

This is a profile bundle with a Host half and a Web Client half. Both DSH GUIs
render the same Web client, so installation is identical:

1. Open the **Plugins** page in the sidebar (Chinese UI: 侧栏「插件」).
   **Settings → Built-in plugins** (设置 →「内置插件」) is only the read-only
   inventory; installation happens on the Plugins page.
2. Click **Add plugin** (「添加插件」) → **Install a third-party plugin**
   (「安装第三方插件」).
3. Enter the **absolute path** of this directory, for example
   `/path/to/dsh-handoff-review`. A packed tarball
   (`pnpm pack`) or a Git URL also works; the npm registry name does not, because
   this package is private. For a local checkout the Host records a
   `file:`/`link:` dependency.
4. The dialog inspects the package first: `not-a-bundle` means the chosen path is
   not this repository or its `dsh.bundle.patch` is missing. Click **Install**,
   then **Enable now** (「立即启用」) when it finishes. If you closed the dialog,
   switch the bundle on under **Installed plugins** (「已安装插件」).
5. Apply the change. A profile without HMR needs a full restart — quit and reopen
   DSH Desktop, or stop and restart the `dsh web` process. A browser refresh
   alone does not reload the Host half; the plugin page's toast says whether a
   restart is required.
6. Verify: **Installed plugins** lists `dsh-handoff-review`; Settings →
   **Built-in plugins** shows its rows; in a live session the composer dock shows
   the **交接** / **Handoff** button and `/handoff-review` is available. The
   plugin's own UI is localized en / zh-TW, independent of the DSH UI language.

Notes:

- **One profile = one install.** The Desktop app manages
  `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`; `dsh web` boots `~/.dsh/profiles/web`. If you use
  both GUIs, install the bundle in each profile.
- For a local checkout DSH uses the checkout's own dependencies and peers, so run
  `pnpm install` (or `npm install`) in this directory before installing a fresh
  clone.
- If the **Plugins** page says it is unavailable, the running Host has no managed
  profile (for example a non-profile `dsh` mode); start DSH Desktop or `dsh web`
  instead.
- If the bundle installs but no UI appears: make sure it is switched on under
  **Installed plugins**, restart the app once (the Host half loads at boot), then
  check its card for a problem tag (for example an incompatible DSH version).
- Uninstall from **Plugins → Installed plugins** and restart.
- A build that surfaces plugin management differently may still show it as
  **Settings → Plugins**; the inventory-only **Built-in plugins** section cannot
  install bundles.

### Install from the CLI (`dsh web` profile)

The GUI is the recommended path, but a base-backed profile can also be managed
from the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-handoff-review
# then restart the dsh web process
```

`dsh plugin` forwards package operations to pnpm in the profile directory and
selects the bundle after a successful install. The `desktop` profile is owned by
the app: manage it from the Desktop GUI (or the Desktop-installed `dsh` command);
an npm-installed CLI rejects plugin-management requests for it.

The bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) contributes one composition row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: handoff-review
      name: dsh-handoff-review
      config:
        maxRounds: 3
        maxHandoffChars: 30000
        diffPerFileChars: 6000
```

## Use

1. Work in an implementation session until it has `edit`/`write` changes.
2. Run `/handoff-review focus on retry logic`, or click **Handoff review** in the
   composer dock. The review session appears in the same workspace, titled
   `Review: <impl title> (round N)`.
3. Open the review session and let the reviewer work.
4. When the reviewer finishes, the link becomes `feedback_ready`. In the
   implementation session press **Send feedback** (or run
   `/handoff-review feedback` from the review session).
5. After the fixes, press **Send revision** (or `/handoff-review revision`) — only
   changes after the last handoff watermark are sent, round + 1. Past
   `maxRounds`, the dock offers **Send revision (force)** and the command accepts
   `--force`.
6. Repeat, then press **Close** (or `/handoff-review close`). Sessions are never
   deleted; the review session keeps its history.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/handoff-review [focus]` | create/reuse a link and deliver a handoff |
| `/handoff-review status` | print the current link state |
| `/handoff-rev

plugins.description: DSH bundle that supervises the BrowserSkill (bsk) bridge daemon as a host child process: starts with DSH, stops with DSH, auto-restarts after crashes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bsk-daemon
