| `pan123_mkdir` | 新建目录 |
| `pan123_upload` | 上传单个文件 |
| `pan123_download` | 按文件 id 下载到本地 |
| `pan123_direct_link` | 取临时直链 |
| `pan123_rename` / `pan123_move` / `pan123_delete` | 改名 / 移动 / 删除 |
| `pan123_backup_workspace` | 工作区增量备份（支持 `dryRun` 预演） |
| `pan123_backup_status` | 查看历史备份记录 |
| `pan123_scan_workspace` | 只扫描不上传，检查忽略规则与大小限制 |

会话里可以直接说：

> 把当前工作区备份到 123 云盘的 `dsh-backup/python`，先预演一遍。

## 安全说明

* **密码不保存**：只用于调用一次登录接口，换回 JWT 后即丢弃；
  传递方式是**子进程环境变量**而不是命令行参数（命令行会出现在进程列表里）。
* **token 加密存储**：DPAPI 密文（用户级），文件在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-123pan/session.dat`；
  拷贝到别的用户/机器上无法解密。加解密由核心的 `protect` / `unprotect` 子命令完成，
  但**落盘始终由 Node 侧执行**——因为核心子进程可能处于受限令牌，写不了用户目录。
* **接口是客户端私有 API**：不是公开开放平台接口，可能随客户端版本变化；
  仅建议个人账号低频自用，高频调用可能触发风控。
* **HTTP 桥只监听本机**：`/api/dsh-123pan/*` 仅接受回环地址 + POST，
  并校验 `Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-Site`，避免被网页跨站调用。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-123pan/
├── index.js              Host 入口：注册工具 + HTTP 桥
├── client.js             设置页 UI（跟随宿主主题）
├── lib/
│   ├── core.js           核心进程封装（NDJSON 结果 + 进度轮询）
│   ├── api.js 相关         —— 见 native/core
│   ├── backup.js         工作区扫描、增量判定、目录结构还原
│   ├── bridge.js         本机 HTTP 桥（门禁 + 错误整形）
│   └── tools.js          agent 工具定义
├── native/core/
│   ├── main.cpp          CLI 与 NDJSON 协议
│   ├── api.cpp           123 云盘 API（登录/列目录/上传/下载/回收站）
│   ├── http.cpp          HTTPS 客户端（OpenSSL + Windows 证书存储）
│   ├── winutil.cpp       UTF-8/UTF-16、DPAPI、路径工具
│   ├── json.hpp          极简 JSON（解析 + 序列化）
│   └── build.sh          静态构建脚本
├── locale/{zh,en}.json   插件标题与描述
└── icon.svg
```

## 核心 CLI 约定

`native/core/123pan-core.exe` 也可以独立使用（调试或脚本化）：

```bash
# 输出默认到 stdout；用 --ndjson <文件> 改为追加写文件
123pan-core.exe list --parent 0 --limit 10
123pan-core.exe upload --file D:\x.zip --parent 0
123pan-core.exe download --id 123 --out D:\x.zip
123pan-core.exe protect --text '{"token":"..."}'    # 输出 DPAPI 密文（base64）
```

每行一个 JSON 对象：`{"type":"progress",...}` 与 `{"type":"result","ok":...}`。
令牌可以用 `DSH_123PAN_TOKEN` 环境变量传入，或用
`login --account <账号>`

# Aemeath 语音输出（GPT-SoVITS → DeepSeek Harness）

把你自己训练的 GPT-SoVITS 音色做成一个本地 HTTP 语音服务，DeepSeek（DSH）通过一条命令就能把文字念出来。

这一整套已经打包成 DSH 插件 **`dsh-yourself-voice`（你的语音）**：
设置页在「设置 → 插件 → 你的语音」，助手回复下方还有一个喇叭按钮可以手动朗读/停止。
插件源码就是本目录的 `plugin\`，上架材料见 [`plugin\PUBLISH.md`](plugin/PUBLISH.md)。

当前默认音色：**Aemeath.3.0（v4 模型）**，参考音频 `ref/aemeath_ref.wav`。

想把这一整套音色给别人用：`plugin\dist\aemeath3-1.0.0.tar.gz`（203 MB，权重 + 参考音频 + 参考原文）一个包搞定，
插件的「音色包」tab 里点一下就装好并自动切换 —— 主 npm 包因此不用背着 200 MB 的权重。
做法与托管见 [`plugin\README.md`](plugin/README.md) 的「音色包」一节。

---

## 0. 三种用法

| 用法 | 入口 | 适合 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **DSH 插件 · 工具与命令**（推荐） | 模型工具 `voice_speak` / `voice_settings`，输入框命令 `/voice` | 让模型自己开口；每轮回复自动朗读 |
| **DSH 插件 · 网页按钮** | 每条助手回复下方的喇叭图标（点一下朗读、再点停止） | 手动挑一条重听，不影响自动朗读开关 |
| **DSH 插件 · 设置页** | 「设置 → 插件 → 你的语音」 | 可视化切音色 / 调参数 / 试听 / 看服务状态，不用手改 json |
| 命令行脚本 | `speak.ps1` | 不经过 DSH 手动试音、批处理、别的程序调用 |

插件源码在 `plugin\`，装法/改法/设置项见 **[`plugin\README.md`](plugin/README.md)**。
两者共用同一份 `settings.json` 与同一个推理服务（端口 9880），可以同时用。

---

## 1. 目录结构

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `settings.json` | **唯一事实来源**：模型、参考音频、语速、播放、自动朗读等 29 项（插件写） |
| `tts_config.yaml` | 服务用的模型配置，由 `settings.json` 自动生成，**不要手改**（会被覆盖） |
| `start_server.ps1` | 启动推理服务，监听 `http://127.0.0.1:9880` |
| `speak.ps1` | 合成 + 播放一条文本（服务没开会自动拉起） |
| `plugin\` | DSH 插件 `dsh-yourself-voice`：宿主半边 `index.mjs`/`api.mjs`/`engine.mjs`/`models.mjs`/`settings.mjs`/`voicepack.mjs`、浏览器半边 `client.js`、自带资产 `assets\` |
| `plugin\dist\` | 音色包产物（`scripts\build-voicepack.mjs` 生成；203 MB，不进 npm 包也不进 git） |
| `install\` | 插件的安装 / 卸载脚本与 profile patch 片段 |
| `ref/aemeath_ref.wav` | 参考音频（3.7 秒，来自 Aemeath.3.0 训练集的 32k 切片） |
| `ref/prompt.txt` | 参考音频对应的原文 |
| `out/` | 输出：`last.wav`、`server.log`、两个插件挂载标记 |
| `tmp/`、`numba_cache/` | 运行时临时目录（见「坑」一节，**不要删**） |

## 2. 怎么用

```powershell
# 说话
cd C:\Users\森\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\aemeath-voice
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\speak.ps1 "你好，我是爱弥斯。"

# 只合成不播放（拿到 wav 文件）
.\speak.ps1 "只出声不播放" -NoPlay -OutFile .\out\demo.wav

# 英文
.\speak.ps1 "Hello, I am Aemeath." -TextLang en -PromptLang en

# 语速
.\speak.ps1 "说慢一点" -Speed 0.85
```

> `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` 不能省：系统默认禁止运行 `.ps1` 脚本。
> 服务没启动时 `speak.ps1` 会自动拉起（实测约 16 秒），不想自动启动就加 `-NoAutoStart`。

单独启动 / 重启服务：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start_server.ps1          # 前台，日志同时写到 out\server.log
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start_server.ps1 -Port 9881
```

## 3. 换成别的已训练模型

最省事：打开 **设置 → 插件 → 你的语音 → 音色与模型**，插件会把权重目录里能配成一对的
GPT+SoVITS 权重列成音色卡片，点卡片即切换（卡片上有 ▶ 可直接试听），下面还有高级区可以手填
单侧权重。切完的合成参数会按音色分别记住。

也可以走工具/命令或直接改 `settings.json` 里的 `version` / `gptWeights` / `sovitsWeights` 三项
（`tts_config.yaml` 会按它自动重新生成）：

```
voice_settings {action:"set", changes:{"version":"v4","gptWeights":"GPT_weights_v4/Aemeath.3.0-e15.ckpt","sovitsWeights":"SoVITS_weights_v4/Aemeath.3.0_e2_s214_l32.pth"}}
```

只换权重（`version` 不变）会自动走服务端热切换，不重启；换世代则自动重启服务。
没用插件时，直接编辑 `tts_config.yaml` 的 `custom:` 段（路径都相对 GPT-SoVITS 根目录）再重启服务也行：

```yaml
custom:
  version: v4                                            # v1 v2 v2Pro v2ProPlus v3 v4
  t2s_weights_path: GPT_weights_v4/Aemeath.3.0-e15.ckpt   # GPT 权重
  vits_weights_path: SoVITS_weights_v4/Aemeath.3.0_e2_s214_l32.pth
  bert_base_path: GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large
  cnhuhbert_base_path: GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/chinese-hubert-base
  device: cuda
  is_half: true
```

本机已有的训练成果：

| 模型 | GPT 权重 | SoVITS 权重 | version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Aemeath.3.0（当前） | `GPT_weights_v4/Aemeath.3.0-e{5,10,15}.ckpt` | `SoVITS_weights_v4/Aemeath.3.0_e{1_s107,2_s214}_l32.pth` | `v4` |
| Aemeath.2.1 | `GPT_weights_v2ProPlus/Aemeath.2.1-e{5,10,15}.ckpt` | `SoVITS_weights_v2ProPlus/Aemeath.2.1_e{4_s108,8_s216}.pth` | `v2ProPlus` |
| Aemeath.2.0 | `GPT_weights_v2Pro/Aemeath.2.0-e{5,10,15}.ckpt` | `SoVITS_weights_v2Pro/Aemeath.2.0_e{4_s108,8_s216}.pth` | `v2Pro` |
| Aemeath_v2Pro_01 | `GPT_weights_v2Pro/Aemeath_v2Pro_01-e{5,10,15}.ckpt` | `SoVITS_weights_v2Pro/Aemeath_v2Pro_01_e{4_s72,8_s144}.pth` | `v2Pro` |

`e5/e10/e15` 是训练轮数，一般 `e15` 效果最好但更容易过拟合；换成别的版本时 `version` 必须同步改，否则加载会报维度不匹配。

**不重启服务换模型**（服务已跑起来时）：

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod "http://127.0.0.1:9880/set_gpt_weights?weights_path=GPT_weights_v2ProPlus/Aemeath.2.1-e15.ckpt"
Invoke-RestMethod "http://127.0.0.1:9880/set_sovits_weights?weights_path=SoVITS_weights_v2ProPlus/Aemeath.2.1_e8_s216.pth"
```

## 4. 换参考音频（决定音色与语气）

`ref_audio_path` 的音频是「音色模板」，`prompt_text` 必须与它逐字对应。换音色：

```powershell
.\speak.ps1 "测试" -RefAudio "D:\...\logs\Aemeath.3.0\5-wav32k\source.wav_0000000000_0000121600.wav" `
                 -PromptText "椿姐姐和我一起在冰原上追着隧群跑过."
```

参考音频建议 3–10 秒、干净无 BGM（`logs\<模型名>\5-wav32k\` 下就是训练用的 32k 切片，`2-name2text.txt` 里有每条的原文）。三版模型的切片都在，可混用。

## 5. 直接调 HTTP 接口

```powershell
$body = @{
  text = "你好"; text_lang = "zh"
  ref_audio_path = "C:\...\aemeath-voice\ref\aemeath_ref.wav"
  prompt_text = "陆医生是个有能力的好人,学生们大多都很喜欢他."; prompt_lang = "zh"
  text_split_method = "cut5"; media_type = "wav"; streaming_mode = $false
} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Invoke-WebRequest "http://127.0.0.1:9880/tts" -Method Post -ContentType "application/json" `
  -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) -OutFile out\http.wav
```

接口文档：服务启动后打开 <http://127.0.0.1:9880/docs>。

## 6. 两个必须知道的坑

1. **`import librosa` 会永久挂死**。numba 用 `tempfile` 探测缓存目录，如果 `TMP/TEMP` 指向不可写的位置，`api_v2.py` 会卡在 import 阶段——没有报错、没有输出、端口永远不监听。`start_server.ps1` 里已经把 `TMP/TEMP/NUMBA_CACHE_DIR` 指到本目录的 `tmp/`、`numba_cache/`，别把它们删掉或改成别处。
2. **`.ps1` 必须是 UTF-8 with BOM**。Windows PowerShell 5.1 对无 BOM 的 `.ps1` 按 GBK 解码，中文注释会串行、把下一行代码吞进注释里，表现为「$PSScriptRoot 是空的」之类的怪错。用文本编辑器改这两个脚本后，请确认保存为 **UTF-8 带 BOM**。

## 7. 环境

- GPT-SoVITS：`D:\Aemeath\AI   GPT-SoVITS\GPT-SoVITS-v2pro-20250604`（内置 `runtime\python.exe`，Python 3.9 + torch 2.0.0+cu118）
- GPU：RTX 4060 Laptop（8 GB）
- 实测速度：13.6 秒语音约 16 秒合成（首句含预热约 12–20 秒）

plugins.description: Desktop mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: sessions as movable windows with a taskbar (experimental)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-ui

**Desktop mode** for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Keep the sidebar exactly as it
is, and turn the conversation area into a desktop where every session is a
movable, resizable window — with a taskbar along the bottom.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-desktop-ui.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-desktop-ui)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

- **Source code:** [github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui](https://github.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui)
- **npm package:** [npmjs.com/package/dsh-desktop-ui](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-desktop-ui)

**Contents:** [Why](#why-this-plugin-exists) · [Install](#install-from-npm) ·
[Features](#features) · [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-limitations) ·
[Development](#build-and-test) · [Local setup](./LOCAL-SETUP.md) · [Release checklist](./RELEASE.md)

![Four sessions from different workspaces tiled on the desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/tiled-light.webp)

## Why this plugin exists

DSH shows one conversation at a time. When you juggle several sessions — a long
agent run, a quick question, a code review — you keep clicking back and forth in
the sidebar. Desktop mode lets you keep them all on screen at once, arrange them
side by side, and park the rest in a taskbar.

## Install from npm

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-desktop-ui
```

Restart `dsh web` when asked, then refresh the DSH page. A **Desktop mode** switch
appears in the sidebar, directly above **Settings**.

To remove:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-desktop-ui
```

Restart and refresh. The normal conversation view comes back unchanged; only the
browser-local window layout remains in `localStorage`.

## Features

| Feature | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Desktop mode switch** | Sits directly above Settings. Off by default; the choice persists in this browser. Turning it off returns to the normal conversation on the focused window's session. |
| **Sessions as windows** | Clicking a session in the sidebar opens it as a window. A session can only have one window — clicking it again restores and focuses the existing one. Every window shows the **same conversation UI as the main chat** — header, view tabs, transcript, composer, and anything other plugins add (for example `dsh-rewind-plugin`'s rewind button under your messages). |
| **Window titles** | Every title bar reads `workspace | session` (for example `acme-web | Fix flaky checkout test`), with the workspace name in a quieter colour. Ungrouped sessions show just the session title. The full label is also the window's tooltip and accessible name. |
| **Find it in the sidebar** | Hovering a window highlights its session and its workspace in the sidebar. If that workspace is collapsed, it opens while you hover and closes again when you move away (unless you clicked in the sidebar meanwhile). Turn this off in **Plugins → dsh-desktop-ui → Highlight the sidebar on hover**; the choice is saved with the layout. |
| **Taskbar tooltips** | Hovering (or keyboard-focusing) a taskbar button shows `workspace | session`, plus "minimized" or "popped out" when it applies. |
| **Wallpaper and transparency** | **Plugins → dsh-desktop-ui → Desktop background** has a live preview. **Wallpaper**: PNG, WebP, GIF, JPEG, AVIF or SVG, up to 12 MB, with Fill / Fit / Center / Tile; transparent pixels in the image show the theme colour. **Wallpaper opacity** blends the image into the theme colour. **Canvas opacity** is how much of the theme-coloured canvas covers the wallpaper (0% = wallpaper fully visible, 100% = hidden); without a wallpaper it makes the empty desktop see-through to what is behind it. **Taskbar opacity** turns the taskbar into frosted glass below 100%. Windows always stay solid. Choosing a first wallpaper sets canvas opacity to 0% so the image is visible right away. **Reset appearance** restores the defaults. |
| **Window controls** | Drag the title bar to move; drag any edge or corner to resize; double-click the title to maximize/restore; minimize, maximize and close buttons. |
| **Pop out (browser only)** | The ↗ button left of minimize opens that session in its own browser window, showing just that conversation (no sidebar). The desktop keeps a placeholder with **Pop back in**; the popout window has a **Pop back in** button in its header too. Either one closes the popout and returns the session to the canvas. Closing the popout window yourself also brings it back. The button is hidden in the DeepSeek desktop app, which is detected through the `data-platform` marker its preload sets on `<html>` (the same signal DSH's shortcut layer uses). |
| **Linked borders** | When windows sit side by side or stacked (for example after Tile or Side by side, or a left/right snap), dragging the border between them resizes all of them at once: as one grows, its neighbour shrinks, and the gap stays the same. In a grid the whole straight split moves together. It stops at each window's minimum size. Corner grips and windows that don't touch still resize on their own. |
| **Snapping** | Drag a window to the left or right edge to fill that half, or to the top to maximize. |
| **Taskbar** | New session button, one button per window (click to focus, click the focused one to minimize, a dot shows running sessions), Cascade / Tile / Side-by-side layouts, a clock, and a Show desktop strip at the far right. |
| **Window text size** | Window contents are the stock UI scaled down uniformly (default 85%), so every element — including ones added by other plugins — shrinks together. Click the percentage in the taskbar to make it larger, right-click to make it smaller (70–100%). The normal full-width conversation is untouched. |
| **Restored after restart** | Desktop mode, the open windows, their positions and sizes, minimized/maximized state, stacking order and text size are saved to your DSH profile config and restored after you stop and restart DSH — even in a different browser. Windows you closed stay closed. |
| **Plays well with sidebar plugins** | The Desktop mode switch is always the top entry above Settings; other footer buttons (for example `dsh-all-usage`) stack underneath it instead of being pushed sideways. |
| **Light and dark** | Uses DSH's own theme tokens only, so it follows the GUI theme automatically. |
| **Narrow screens** | Below 720px the focused window fills the canvas and you switch through the taskbar. |

The wallpaper image itself never leaves the browser: it is kept in IndexedDB (database `dsh-desktop-ui`), not in the profile config, so it is not synced to other browsers. Only its settings (on/off, layout, strength, file name) are.

Closing a window never deletes or archives a session. The layout is stored as one
small JSON value in this plugin's own config entry (`dsh-desktop-ui` → `layout` in
your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`), written through DSH's settings service, with a
browser `localStorage` copy (`dsh-desktop-ui.state.v1`) for instant reloads. It
contains session ids, geometry and flags only — never conversation content,
credentials or prompts. The plugin makes no network requests of its own. To reset
the desktop, remove the `layout` line or switch Desktop mode off and close the windows.

![Dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/tiled-dark.webp)

![Dragging a window to the right edge shows the snap preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/snap-preview.webp)

![A session popped out: the canvas keeps a Pop back in placeholder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/popout-canvas.webp)

![The popout browser window shows just that conversation, with Pop back in in its header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeandev/dsh-desktop-ui/main/assets/showcase/popout-window.webp)

## Compatibility and limitations

**Requires DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`.** Tested on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 with Node 24.

This is an **internal integration**, not a stable public DSH API. It plugs into:

| Seam | Use |
|---|---|
| `main` keyed

plugins.description: DSH 内建 STM32 工作台插件：Keil AC5 编译、ST-Link/OpenOCD 烧录、引脚规划、串口与功能契约（适配 DSH 0.2.1）
plugins.readme_text:
# stm32-workbench 插件（DSH 内建单片机工作台）

把 STM32 工作台做成 DSH 插件：**不另开浏览器**，在 DSH 里选工作区 → 会话进入「单片机模式」→ 工作台就在会话视图里。

> **当前版本 0.4.0，适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（2026-10-19/20）**。mcu 工具 **18 个 action**
> （0.3.0 新增 `symbols`/`readmem`/`gfx`，0.4.0 新增 `watch` 并重做为「AI 省 token」形态：
> status 一次拿全貌、紧凑输出、gfx 基线差异、spec 增量更新）。升级适配的根因与修复见文末。

## 目录中为什么不是「挂在每个对话下面」

第一版我把面板注册进了 `conversation.input.dock`（会话级全宽插槽），结果**每个对话下面都会冒出工作台**——错的。

正确做法参考 [dsh-openwrite](https://github.com/LiPu-jpg/Openwrite)（DSH 小说创作插件，含原生工作台）：

| 它的做法 | 本插件的对应实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧栏底部一个入口按钮（`sidebar.footer.action`，id `openwrite.launch`） | 侧栏底部「STM32 工作台」（id `stm32.launch`） |
| 点击后选作品目录 → 建工作区 → 建会话 → `ctx.remote.agentPresets.select(sessionId, 自己的预设)` → 打开会话 | 同样流程，预设 id = `mcu` |
| 工作台是 `conversation.view`，并由 `watchWritingScope` **门控**：只读当前主视图会话的 `projectionValues.agentPreset`，等于自己的预设才挂载 | `watchScope(list, isMcuSession, mountView)`，非 `mcu` 会话不挂载 |
| 预设由插件自己注册（`ctx.agentPresets.register()`，见其 `plugin.mjs`） | 宿主半边 `ctx.inject(['agentPresets'], …)` 注册「单片机模式」 |
| 已有会话不会被自动切换预设 | 同样：只影响入口新建/选中的那个会话 |

关键判据（照抄自它的 `writing-scope.ts`）：`state.byId[id].projectionValues.agentPreset`，会话 id 取 `retainedBy.mainView > 0` 的那一行（0.1 是 `state.current`）。

## 半边职责

| 半边 | 文件 | 干什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宿主 | `index.js` | ① `ctx.agentPresets.register()` 注册「单片机模式」预设；② 拉起/停止 MCU 后端进程；③ 注册同源路由 `/mcu/state`、`/mcu/start`、`/mcu/stop`、`/mcu/api/*` 代理 |
| 客户端 | `client.js` | ① 侧栏入口按钮 + 选工作区对话框；② 门控的 `conversation.view` 工作台（引脚图/构建台/串口/计算器） |
| 后端 | `backend/` | 真编译（Keil AC5）、真烧录（OpenOCD + ST-Link）、串口桥；固件源码与 BSP 随仓库提供，便携 OpenOCD 由 `backend/scripts/fetch-openocd.ps1` 一键下载（不随仓库分发） |

**入口一旦某个会话被选定，「单片机模式」下 agent 就能直接用编译/烧录/串口**：端口与 routes 都在 `/mcu` 下。

## 安装与生效

- **从 GitHub 克隆后**：先准备便携 OpenOCD（仓库故意不提交这 7.6 MB 第三方二进制）：
  `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File backend\scripts\fetch-openocd.ps1`
  （从官方 xPack release 下载并校验 sha256，只需一次）
- 安装：`plugin_manager: install_bundle target=<你放本插件的绝对路径>`
- **改动插件代码后必须重启 DSH**：装载器不会热替换已装载的包代际（客户端资源还要刷新页面）
- 生效后：侧栏底部出现「STM32 工作台」；模式选择器里出现「单片机模式」（由插件注册，不再依赖 profile 补丁）
- 换台电脑怎么装、需要什么前置条件、数据落在哪：见 [PORTING.md](PORTING.md)

## 许可证

- 本仓库代码：**MIT**，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
- 第三方组件：ARM CMSIS（Apache-2.0）、STMicroelectronics STM32F10x 标准外设库（ST 许可）、
  xPack OpenOCD（GPLv2，**不随仓库分发**，由脚本按需下载）——详见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

## 目录结构与数据落点（2026-10-14 重构）

**插件本体只装代码，运行期不往自己目录里写任何东西。** 一个目录拷到别的机器就是干净的一份。

```
stm32-workbench/              ← 约 1.8 MB（不含便携 OpenOCD；它由 fetch-openocd.ps1 按需下载）
├── package.json              ← files: 白名单；dsh.bundle / dsh.client / exports 声明（含 locale/icon）
├── cordis.patch.yml          ← backendDir 故意留空 → 取「index.js 旁边那份 backend/」
├── index.js / client.js      ← 宿主半边（mcu 工具 + preset + 路由）/ 客户端半边（工作台面板）
├── locale/{en,zh}.json       ← 设置页/插件页的显示标题与描述（DSH 0.2.1 起必需）
├── icon.svg                  ← 插件图标（原创，≤256 KiB）
├── .gitignore                ← 兜底老版本遗留
├── PORTING.md / README.md
└── backend/
    ├── server/               ← 后端模块（16 个）
    ├── scripts/              ← 诊断脚本（35 个，全相对路径）
    ├── data/                 ← pins.json / peripherals.json
    ├── tools/openocd/        ← 便携 OpenOCD（不提交进仓库；fetch-openocd.ps1 下载到此）
    ├── firmware/{bsp,projects,template}   ← 自带测试工程（只读）
    └── web/                  ← 老版独立浏览器界面（留作调试）
```

数据分两处，规则在 `backend/server/paths.js`：

```
<你打开的 Keil 工程目录>/.dsh-mcu/     ← 跟这个工程有关的一切，都可以安全删除
    .gitignore（内容 `*`）  build/keil/<工程>-<哈希>/  last-build.json
    logs/  src-backup/<时间戳>/  uv4-ref/  tmp/

<DSH_HOME>/mcu/                       ← 默认 ~/.dsh/mcu
    recent.json                        ← 上次打开哪个工程（唯一一处跨工程记忆）
    build/<工程>/                       ← 自带测试工程的构建输出
```

三条好处，都是这次重构换来的：

1. **插件瘦了 30 多倍**（61.0 MB → 1.8 MB 代码；7.6 MB 的便携 OpenOCD 改为按需下载），而且拷走不用清理；
2. **换工作区 = 换一整套缓存**，切回去直接读得到，不用重新编译；
3. **顺手修掉一个真错误**：以前构建账本是全局唯一一份，切换工程后会把**旧工程**的
   `programSize`/`map` 拿来当新工程的占用数据展示（界面上还挂着新工程的名字）。
   按工程分开存之后，这个错误在结构上不可能发生。

工程目录只读时（网络盘、受保护目录），`.dsh-mcu/` 自动退到
`<DSH_HOME>/mcu/projects/<路径哈希>/` 并留一张 `WHY-HERE.txt`。

**怎么证明插件本体没被写脏**：跑完一整套操作后对插件目录做文件快照比对，
应当「新增 0 / 删除 0 / 变化 0」。这是设计保证，也可以自己核对。

## 设计约束（创造模式随包技能给的硬规矩）

1. **禁止 iframe**：插件 UI 必须是真 React 组件、用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌。
2. **禁止 import Harness 客户端包**（如 `dsh-client-ui-primitives`）：随版本变动，且抛错会让插槽整块崩掉。
3. **资源注册要用 effect 管生命周期**：`ctx.slots.inject(ownerKey, () => ctx.slots.register(...))`，卸载即撤销。
4. **不写 profile 的 package.json / cordis.patch.yml**：交给 `plugin_manager`。

## 踩过的坑

1. **`type: "module"` 毒死 CommonJS 后端** → `backend/package.json` 写 `{"type":"commonjs"}` 就近隔离。
2. **DSH 路由匹配 = 精确表优先 + 前缀取最长**，所以 `/mcu/state`（精确）不会被 `/mcu`（前缀代理）吃掉。
3. **插件资源 URL 带内容哈希 rev**（`/plugins/<包名>/client.js?rev=<sha1前12>`），无 rev 一律 404，不能凭猜 URL 验证客户端。
4. **重复 preset id 会让声明加载失败**：所以本插件注册预设后，必须把先前手写进 profile 补丁的那段撤掉（已撤，备份 `cordis.patch.yml.bak-mcu-*`）。

## 待验证（如实记录）

- 客户端渲染只能在 DSH 页面里验证；本会话无浏览器控制能力，不能截图或读 DOM。
- 若侧栏没有出现入口、或工作台没起来，看浏览器控制台是否有 `slot entry crashed in 'conversation.view'` 或我打印的 `[stm32-workbench]` 警告。
- 烧录与串口仍需 ST-Link 与实物才能验证（没插设备时界面会如实显示「未检测到 ST-Link」）。

## 回滚

```
plugin_manager: set_bundle enabled=false target=dsh-plugin-stm32-workbench
```

## Keil 工程接入（2026-10-13）

原来只能编插件自带的 `firmware/projects/<id>/`，编译参数写死。现在可以直接吃用户的 Keil 工程，
**产物与 Keil UV4 逐字节一致**（已用真实毕设工程验证：53788 字节、0 差异）。

### 新增模块

| 文件 | 干什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `server/uvprojx.js` | 解析 .uvprojx：芯片 / 宏 / 头路径 / 文件清单 / 优化 / 输出设置 + 配置诊断 |
| `server/keil-build.js` | 用工程自己的配置驱动 armcc → armasm → armlink → fromelf |
| `server/srcfile.js` | 编码感知的源码读写（GBK / UTF-8 / BOM 自动识别） |
| `server/pinmap.js` | 从源码**静态解析引脚配置**：跟踪 SPL 结构体状态、关联 EXTI、检出冲突 |
| `server/regread.js` | SWD 直读寄存器：RCC 时钟树、外设时钟使能、GPIO 实际配置，并与源码对照 |

### 新增接口

- `POST /api/keil/open` — 打开工程（进程内记住，界面刷新不丢）
- `GET  /api/keil/state` — 当前工程摘要
- `GET  /api/keil/pins` — 引脚配置（静态解析结果）
- `POST /api/keil/registers` — 寄存器 + 「源码分析 vs 芯片实际」对照
- `POST /api/keil/build` — 按工程编译（NDJSON 流式日志）

### 踩到的坑（全是实测踩出来的）

1. **Keil 的 `<Optim>` 是 1-based**。工程写 `<Optim>3</Optim>` 要用 `-O2` 而不是 `-O3`。
   实测 `-O3` 编出的 `main` 是 610 B，Keil 自己编的是 590 B；换 `-O2` 后逐字节一致。
   映射：`1→-O0、2→-O1、3→-O2、4→-O3`。
2. **Keil 生成的 scatter 多一行 `.ANY (+XO)`**，照抄才能对齐链接结果。
3. **`.uvprojx` 里没有器件宏**。Keil 按 `<Device>` 自动定义 `STM32F10X_MD` 之类，
   外部工具链必须自己补，否则 `#error "Please select first the target STM32F10x device"`。
4. **`<Cpu>CLOCK(...)` 不是晶振频率**，只是 Keil IDE 的显示值。真实值要看源码
   `stm32f10x.h` 的 `HSE_VALUE`（还要区分 `STM32F10X_CL` 分支是否生效）。
   信错了会把 8 MHz×9=72 MHz 算成 12 MHz×9=108 MHz，看起来像严重超频。
5. **中文路径**：armcc 是 ANSI 程序，命令行里出现中文会被拆坏。所以 cwd 设为工程目录、
   源文件与 `-I` 一律用**工程文件里的相对路径原文**，只有 `-o`/`--scatter` 用绝对路径，
   且落在纯 ASCII 的插件工作区（不污染用户工程）。
6. **Keil 工程源码常常是 GBK**。按 UTF-8 读会 `invalid UTF-8` 或乱码，改完写回去会在 Keil 里
   显示成乱码。读写都必须走 `srcfile.js`；写回依赖 `scripts/transcode.ps1`（Node 无内置 GBK 编码器）。
7. **插件根 `package.json` 是 `type: module`**。放在插件根目录的辅助 `.js` 脚本要么写 ESM，
   要么改名 `.cjs`（`backend/` 已用 `{"type":"commonjs"}` 就近隔离）。

### 验证方式（可复现）

拿 Keil 自己的命令行 UV4 在**临时副本**上做参照构建，再逐地址比对两份 hex：

```
仅 Keil 有 / 仅插件有 / 公共地址上不同的字节：0 / 0 / 0
✅ 内容完全一致
```

单文件定位差异用 `scripts/keil-param-experiment.js`（参数二分）、
`scripts/keil-symdiff.js`（符号表逐函数比大小）。

## 闭环补强（2026-10-14）—— P0 四项

对着「写代码 → 编译 → 烧录 → 观测 → 回归」逐环核对，结论是：**编译与烧录两环有实测证据，
写代码那一环是断的**。四项 P0 已补，全部有可复现的验证。

### 病根：同一个逻辑走了两条路

宿主半边原来只注册了路由和 preset，**一个 DSH 工具都没有**。于是界面走 HTTP，
AI 自己跑 `node scripts/*.js` 或手拼 URL —— 同一个逻辑两条路，这才是「Flash 面板数字不对」
「诊断脚本比对到 D 盘旧产物还打印一致」这类事故的共同原因。

### ① 宿主注册 `mcu` 工具（`index.js`）

一个工具、18 个 action：
`status/open/scan/files/read/write/build/flash/size/pins/regs/chip/reset/spec/symbols/readmem/gfx/watch`。
AI 与界面从此落在**同一套 /api** 上。

2026-10-18 新增三项（对应用户《工具问题记录》第 1/3/13 条）：
- `symbols`：解析构建产物 `.axf` 的符号表（`fromelf --text -s`），变量/函数的地址与大小不用再靠段偏移推算；
- `readmem`：读目标内存，`addr` 可写十六进制地址或符号名；后端 `init → mdw → exit`，**不 halt**；
- `gfx`：把 SSD1306 显存解成 128×64 点阵，返回 ASCII 图并落一份标准 PBM（默认自动找 `shadow` 等显存符号）。

同时修了两个工具输出/写入问题：
- `write` 失败时返回的 `data` 以前带 `undefined`（`currentMtime`），会被 DSH 判成
  `value is not lossless JSON`、把真实错误盖掉；现在 `done()` 统一清洗成无损 JSON，失败原因如实返回。
- `write` 现在**支持新建文件**：文件不存在时按 `encoding` 新建（默认含中文=UTF-8 BOM、纯 ASCII=UTF-8），
  返回 `created:true`；只有修改已有文件才有备份。

注册形态照 DSH 自己的 `dsh-tool-todo`：**不导入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`**
（插件不能依赖 Harness 的包）。`defineTool` 那套 DSL 编译完就是原生 JSON Schema
（见其 `parameterSchemaSpecToJsonSchema`），所以直接

--- ## 📖 项目全景与定位 (Overview) `dsh-community` 是专为 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 深度定制的官方与开源生态资产扩展中心。本插件深度整合 Cordis 微内核设计哲学，为 DSH 注入了极高审美、丝滑交互的**「Cordis 插件（Plugins）」与「智能体技能（Agent Skills）」双生态统一应用市场**。 无论是运行在 **DSH 官方桌面端 (Electron)**，还是在 **纯 Web 端 / 远端服务器 (Headless / Docker)**，`dsh-community` 均能自动识别当前宿主环境，提供秒级检索、在线 SOP 规范解析、一键安装装配、沙箱验证与运行诊断的全生命周期闭环。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性矩阵 (Key Features) ### 1. 🔌 双生态并行中心 (Dual-Ecosystem Architecture) * **Cordis 插件市场（Plugins Market）**： * **海量收录**：覆盖深度推理强化、视觉多模态适配、Agent 工作流调度、持久化终端、系统桌宠与个性化 UI 增强等 400+ 款在册插件。 * **容器级生命周期管控**：支持插件的一键安装、试运行校验（Trial）、在线热重载（HMR）、启用/禁用状态切换与事务级原子化卸载。 * **配置自愈机制**：自动维护 `cordis.patch.yml` 与环境依赖项，无需手动修改底层 YAML 配置文件。 * **智能体技能市场（Skills Market）**： * **SOP 资产标准化**：收录符合 Anthropic / DSH 现代 Agent 规范的精选技能库（Prompt / SOP / Action Rules）。 * **零 Token 冗余开销**：技能以模块化方式落地于宿主 `~/.dsh/skills/{id}/` 目录，对话中按需调度，杜绝全局上下文污染与无谓的上下文 Token 浪费。 * **即开即览**：支持在市场内直接在线预览完整的 `SKILL.md` 正文，直观查阅触发场景（`whenToUse`）与前置依赖工具清单（`requiredTools`）。 ### 2. 🏷️ 深度适配官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件标签与标准 (Official Standards) * **认证标签（Official Badge）**： * 自动深度比对官方插件元数据库，针对官方自研旗舰（如 `dsh-better-sidebar`、`dsh-infinite-gen`、`dsh-plugin-agent-workflow`、`modlens` 等）以及高星官方金牌扩展，在列表中自动高亮展示 `官方` 专属认证标签。 * **多维场景与标签检索矩阵**： * **主分类维度**：开发底座（`dev`）、效率工具（`tools`）、多模态与视觉（`models`）、提示词与推理（`prompt`）、工作流自动化（`workflow`）、视觉外观（`ui`）。 * **自由场景标签（Scene Tags）**：支持快捷筛选 `#官方`、`#视觉`、`#终端`、`#RAG` 等场景标签，点击标签即可秒级聚合。 * **生态多维排序**：热门总榜、⭐ 必装精选、飙升榜、最新发布、累计下载、星标榜与用户真实评分榜。 * **严格遵循官方 Manifest 契约**： * 产物全面遵循 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-package-manifest` 契约，自动注入 `"dsh": { "manifestVersion": 1 }`，向下兼容标准 Cordis Loader 容器。 ### 3. 🌉 Universal Bridge 全平台双模自适应架构 * **DSH 桌面端环境 (Desktop Native Mode)**： * 对接底层 Electron IPC 与 Windows 注册表协议，支持通过浏览器或中台点击一键直接唤醒桌面客户端完成静默装配。 * **可视化任务诊断控制台**： * **任务执行日志面板 (`CommunityTaskLogPanel`)**：实时滚屏查看下载速率、解压进度、Junction 虚拟软链状态与 pnpm 构建事务日志。 * **运行时诊断面板 (`CommunityRuntimeLogPanel`)**：实时捕获宿主渲染层异常与崩溃堆栈，支持一键脱敏导出与排障。 * **标准 Web / 远程环境 (Universal Web Fallback)**： * 在无 Electron 底座的 Web 模式下无缝降级，直接连通深流社区云端中枢（`https://deepseek.stream/api`）。 * 提供完全一致的浏览、搜索、分页与 SOP 在线预览体验，并支持一键复制外部拉起协议命令。 ### 4. 🎨 极致的原生视觉与交互设计 * 采用 DSH 官方底层 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 组件库构建，视觉风格与深流宿主浑然一体。 * 原生暗黑科技极简风格，流畅动效与状态指示灯。 * 完备的国际化本地化字典（`community-locales.ts`），中英双语无缝切换。 * 原生注册全局侧边栏入口与快捷键呼出（`CmdOrCtrl+M`）。 --- ## 🏗️ 架构拓扑 (Architecture Topology) ```text ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ DeepSeek Stream 云端生态中枢 │ │ (https://deepseek.stream) │ └──────────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘ │ HTTP API / dsh:// 外部协议 ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ dsh-community 客户端插件 │ │ │ │ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Universal Bridge 桥接层 │ │ │ │ (自动环境探测: window.dshDesktop ? DesktopMode : WebMode) │ │ │ └──────────────────┬──────────────────────────┬──────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ [Desktop 模式: Electron IPC] [Web 降级模式: Fetch API] │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ │ │ ┌──────────────────────────────────┐ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ 本地宿主进程 (Host IPC) │ │ 深流云端 OpenAPI 直连 │ │ │ │ - dsh:// 协议解析器 │ │ - 插件/Skill 大厅检索 │ │ │ │ - aiInspect 安全预检 │ │ - 在线 SOP Markdown 解析│ │ │ │ - Junction 软链与 Patch 事务自愈 │ │ - 协议调用指令一键复制 │ │ │ │ - 实时任务诊断 (TaskLog) │ └─────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ - 运行状态诊断 (RuntimeLog) │ │ │ └──────────────────┬───────────────┘ │ │ ▼ │ │ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ DeepSeek Harness 核心容器 │ │ │ │ ~/.dsh/plugins/ & ~/.dsh/skills/ & cordis.yml │ │ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## 🚀 安装与装配指引 (Installation & Setup) ### 方式一：DSH Profile 配置文件集成（推荐） 1. **获取插件代码**： 将本仓库直接克隆至你的 DSH 用户插件目录： ```bash git clone https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-community.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-community ``` 2. **在 Cordis 配置中注入挂载**： 在当前运行的 Profile 配置文件（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 或 `cordis.yml`）中添加插入项： ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-community name: dsh-community ``` 3. **重启并体验**： 启动或重启 DeepSeek Harness，左侧导航栏将出现 **「插件与 Skill 市场」** 入口图标（支持全局快捷键 `CmdOrCtrl+M`）。 --- ### 方式二：外部 `dsh://` 协议一键静默安装 通过深流官方中台（[deepseek.stream/software](https://deepseek.stream/software)）点击「🚀 一键唤醒桌面端安装」，或在系统运行终端中执行： ```powershell # Windows 环境协议模拟执行 Start-Process "dsh://plugin/install?id=dsh-community&name=深流社区插件市场&downloadUrl=https://deepseek.stream/api/plugins/download?id=dsh-community" ``` 桌面端守护进程捕获协议后，将自动完成依赖下载、目录挂载与热重载。 --- ## 📡 `dsh://` 协议调用规范 (Protocol Specification) 桌面端通过注册 Windows 系统 URL Protocol `dsh://` 实现跨应用交互，支持如下标准调用范式： ### 1. 插件安装协议 (`dsh://plugin/install`) ```text dsh://plugin/install?id={id}&name={name}&version={version}&repo={repo}&downloadUrl={downloadUrl}&permissions={permissions} ``` * **参数说明**： * `id` *(必填)*: 插件全英文唯一标识符（如 `dsh-community`、`dsh-infinite-gen-3`）。 * `name` *(必填)*: 插件友好中文显示名称（URL 编码）。 * `version` *(可选)*: 版本号约束（如 `0.2.1` 或 `latest`）。 * `downloadUrl` *(可选)*: 预编译安装包 ZIP 直链。 * `repo` *(可选)*: GitHub 源码仓库标识（如 `Minglink/dsh-community`）。 ### 2. 技能安装协议 (`dsh://skill/install`) ```text dsh://skill/install?id={id}&name={name}&version={version}&downloadUrl={downloadUrl} ``` * **落地动作**： * 下载并解压技能包至 `~/.dsh/skills/{id}/` 目录； * 自动验证包含核心 `SKILL.md` SOP 规范正文； * 即时挂载至 Agent 思考上下文，无需重启宿主。 --- ## 🛠️ 二次开发与构建 (Development & Build) 本工程采用现代轻量化单文件打包架构，源码基于 TypeScript 与 React 18，无需繁冗笨重的脚手架。 ### 目录结构导航 ```text dsh-community/ ├── cordis.patch.yml # Cordis 容器自动装配配置 ├── index.js # Cordis Host 插件生命周期入口 ├── package.json # 模块元数据与导向配置 ├── build.js # 基于 tsdown & lightningcss 的构建引擎 ├── tsconfig.client.json # 客户端 TypeScript 严格配置 ├── client/ # 预构建前端 Bundle（供 DSH __ModuleLoader__ 直接加载） │ ├── client.js # 编译后生产环境单文件 Bundle (带 SourceMap) │ └── client.js.map └── src/ └── client/ # 完整前端源码 ├── index.ts # 客户端注入点（含 Desktop/Web 双模式桥接） ├── CommunitySection.tsx # 市场主面板（双 Tab、SOP 预览、分类与检索） ├── CommunityRuntimeLogPanel.tsx # 运行时诊断日志组件 ├── CommunityTaskLogPanel.tsx # 任务执行日志组件 ├── community-locales.ts # 完整中英双语国际化字典 ├── community-types.ts # TypeScript 强类型契约定义 └── Community.module.css # 暗黑极简设计规范样式 ``` ### 构建指令 ```bash # 1. 安装开发构建依赖 (若独立编译) npm install # 2. 执行生产级单文件极速构建 (输出 client/client.

# dsh-accountdisplayname-edit Replaces the sidebar account label — the phone number, email, or account name DeepSeek Harness shows at the bottom-left — and the avatar above it, with a name and image you choose, so screenshots do not expose the original. The edit entry is a new **Edit display name** row in the account menu, the one you open by clicking that label. The dialog it opens holds both the avatar and the name. ## What it does - Replaces the account label text in the sidebar footer with a display name you set. - Replaces the launcher avatar with an image you pick from a local file. - Adds an **Edit display name** / **编辑显示名称** row to the account menu, directly under Settings. - Opens one editor dialog for both: pick or clear an avatar, type a name, then Save, Cancel, or Use default. `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels. - Both edits are drafts until Save — Cancel leaves the sidebar untouched. - Saving an empty value restores the account's own text; clearing the avatar restores the account's own avatar. - A picked image is centre-cropped square, downscaled to 128×128 and re-encoded, so the stored copy stays in the low tens of KB. - Stores both per browser in `localStorage`, under `dsh.account-display-name-edit.alias` and `dsh.account-display-name-edit.avatar`. - Display only. The account, the credentials and the profile are never read or changed, and the plugin makes no network requests of its own. ## Requirements Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. The account launcher and `Menu` DOM it targets — `data-signed-out`, the `_avatar` / `_label` spans, the portaled `div[role="menu"]` with its `role="presentation"` viewport and `itemIcon` / `itemLabel` rows — is unchanged in `0.2.1-rc.2`, which this package was checked against. The host half imports nothing and the browser half fails soft, so a build whose DOM has moved on degrades to "no override, no extra row" rather than an error — see [Compatibility](#compatibility). ## Install ### From the desktop app The `desktop` profile is managed exclusively by the Electron application, so install it there through the app's own plugin surface (Settings → Plugins, or `dshmarket`); the CLI refuses that profile by design. ### From the CLI, for any profile the app does not own ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit ``` There is **no build step and no `prepare` script**: the browser half is committed as `lib/client.js`, so pnpm never asks for build approval and the install is a plain file copy. ### Manually, which is exactly what the commands above do 1. Put the package where the profile resolves its bundles — `/profiles//node_modules/dsh-accountdisplayname-edit`. A directory junction/symlink to a checkout works. 2. Add this to `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: account-display-name-edit name: dsh-accountdisplayname-edit ``` That patch layer is watched, so it applies live — no restart needed. ## Use 1. Click the account row at the bottom of the sidebar. 2. Choose **Edit display name**. 3. Optionally click **Choose image…** and pick a PNG / JPG / WebP; the round preview shows the cropped result. **Clear avatar** goes back to the account's own avatar. 4. Type the name you want. Save an empty value to go back to the account's own text. 5. Click **Save**. Nothing changes until you do. ## Screenshots The account menu, with the **Edit display name** row added under Settings, and the chosen name and avatar on the launcher below it: ![The account menu with the Edit display name row](assets/screenshot-1.png) The editor dialog: avatar preview, name field, and Save / Cancel / Use default: ![The editor dialog](assets/screenshot-2.png) ## Uninstall Remove the insert from `cordis.patch.yml` and delete the package directory. The stored name and avatar stay in the browser's `localStorage` until you clear them; the plugin writes nothing else. ## How it works A dual-face plugin whose host half does almost nothing. - **Host half — `lib/index.js`.** Deliberately import-free. Its only job is to be a Loader entry, so the host's client-module scanner reads `dsh.client` from `package.json` and serves `./client` to the browser. With no dependencies and no `peerDependencies`, it cannot fail to load because of a missing, renamed or version-mismatched peer package. - **Browser half — `lib/client.js`.** A hand-written single-file bundle, already in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` form the module system serves verbatim, so the package needs no build. It requires only `react`, which the shell seeds as a platform module — which is why `react` is not a dependency either. ### Why the menu row is done in the DOM `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account` renders that menu from a hard-coded `items` array, and its only slot (`settings.launcher`, a `single` slot) is the launcher row itself. Occupying that slot would delete 设置 / 意见反馈 / 退出登录, which this plugin must not do. There is no menu-item slot to add to. So the row is appended to the **open** menu's list, cloned from a shipped row — it therefore inherits that build's exact markup, classes and styling. Appending one node leaves React's own children untouched, and the row is removed with the menu because React never tracked it. Selectors use only stable identifiers, never a hashed CSS-module prefix: - the launcher is `button[aria-haspopup="menu"][data-signed-out]`, an attribute the account component always writes; the text node is found by the `_label` suffix and the avatar by the `_avatar` suffix, with positional fallbacks; - the menu is a `div[role="menu"]` the `Menu` primitive portals to ``, identified as the one that appeared after the launcher was activated. ### How the avatar is replaced The avatar span's real contents are React's — an `` or an initial. Rather than remove them, the plugin paints the picked image as the span's **background** and hides the span's children with one scoped rule: ```css [data-dsh-accountdisplayname-edit-avatar="1"] > * { display: none !important } ``` That is two attribute writes and a background image; no React-owned node is detached, re-parented or replaced, so a later account refresh cannot collide with it. Clearing the avatar removes the attribute and the background, and the real avatar reappears. ### Failing soft Every DOM probe runs inside `try`/`catch`; when a probe misses, the plugin does nothing — it never edits another node and never throws into the shell's plugin loader. Clearing the name hands the account plugin's own text back. The label is written through React's own text node (`nodeValue`, not `textContent`), so later account refreshes stay observable instead of updating a node React no longer owns. ## Compatibility - `dsh.client.immediately: true` is required: the plugin works through side effects registered when its bundle materializes, so it belongs in the boot graph's immediate tier. - No `engines.dsh` range is declared, on purpose. node-semver only admits a prerelease version when some comparator in the range shares its exact `major.minor.patch` tuple and itself carries a prerelease tag, so any range would silently exclude a later prerelease of the harness — the failure mode the awesome-dsh-plugin contributing guide warns about. Failing soft is the safer contract here. ## Verification ```sh npm install npm test ``` 116 checks against a real DOM (jsdom + React 18.3.1): - `test/dom.test.mjs` — 40 checks: the bundle wrapper contract, `apply()` registration, label replacement, re-application after the account half re-renders, menu-row injection (label, icon, dropped shortcut, insertion position, shipped rows untouched), row activation closing the menu and opening the dialog, save and reset, and disposal. - `test/robustness.test.mjs` — 16 checks over the fail-soft paths: the account row gone entirely, the `_label` class renamed, the collapsed rail where the avatar is the only span, an English locale, a menu rendered before its rows exist, no `document.body`, t

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件与设置备份 / 跨机同步工具：一键把全部插件、配置和插件数据打包成可移植 .zip，在新电脑上先预览再批量还原。5 个 agent 工具 + 零依赖独立 CLI；凭据默认排除、可选 AES-256-GCM 加密导出；还原默认只预览，应用前自动生成还原点。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-config-sync

把本机 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**全部插件与设置**备份成一个可移植的 `.zip`，再批量同步到下一台电脑。

> 📖 **日常操作请看 [使用说明.md](使用说明.md)**——按"照着做"的口径编写，含换电脑完整流程、回退步骤和常见问题。本文档偏设计与实现。

## 它解决什么问题

换电脑时，DSH 的环境散落在很多地方：profile 里装了哪些插件、每个插件的版本、`cordis.patch.yml` 里的配置覆盖、插件自己写的数据、全局工作区设置……手工搬极易漏项，而**漏掉一处就可能让新电脑上的 DSH 起不来**。

这个插件把这些收拢成一个文件，并保证还原过程可预览、可回退。

## 核心设计取舍

| 决策 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **不备份 `node_modules`** | 插件本体有几百 MB，且完全可由 `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` 复现。归档只记录版本，还原时重装，新电脑得到的是干净正确的依赖树。 |
| **不备份运行时/Electron/日志/缓存** | 这些属于机器而非用户，是可重建的。把 Windows 运行时拷到新装环境正是"还原把好环境弄坏"的典型原因。 |
| **凭据默认不含，且永不明文** | `.credentials.yaml` 和 `workbuddy-vault/` 里是 API key 和登录 token。归档是会被拷到 U 盘和网盘的文件，**默认排除**；显式要求时用 AES-256-GCM 加密成独立成员。 |
| **还原默认只预览** | 写入前必须先看到"会改哪些文件、会增删哪些插件"。加 `apply: true` 才真正执行。 |
| **应用前自动做还原点** | 每次写入前把当前 profile 配置快照到带时间戳的目录，误操作可退回。 |
| **目标有额外插件时拒绝执行** | 避免"同步一次，把本机独有的插件配置弄丢"。需显式 `overwritePlugins: true`。 |

## 安装

插件目录：`D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync`

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync
```

装完需要**重启 DSH** 才会注册工具。

> 该命令要写 `C:\Users\ThinkPad\.dsh\profiles\desktop`（在工作区之外），在受限沙箱下会报 EPERM，需要一次完全权限。

## 用法

### 在 DSH 会话里（推荐）

装好后直接对 agent 说，例如：

- 「看看我这台电脑现在有哪些插件和设置」→ `dsh_config_status`
- 「把插件和设置备份出来」→ `backup_dsh_config`
- 「把这个备份还原到新电脑」→ `restore_dsh_config`

五个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_config_status` | 看现状：装了哪些插件、各类设置文件数量、备份会包含什么 |
| `backup_dsh_config` | 生成备份归档（支持 `dryRun` 预览） |
| `restore_dsh_config` | 预览/应用还原 |
| `verify_dsh_config` | 校验归档完整性（逐个成员核对 sha256） |
| `list_dsh_backups` | 列出已有归档 |

### 命令行（DSH 起不来时用这个）

```powershell
$cli = "D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"   # 仅用于装插件
node D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync\bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs <命令>
```

```powershell
# 看现状
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs status

# 备份（默认不含凭据和会话）
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 备份并加密包含登录凭据
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip `
     --categories profile-config,home-config,plugin-state,credentials --password 你的口令

# 校验
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 还原：默认只预览
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop

# 确认后真正写入
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

## 换电脑的完整流程

**旧电脑**

```powershell
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\dsh-backup.zip
```

**新电脑**（先装好 DSH 本体）

```powershell
# 1. 校验归档，确认传输没损坏
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\dsh-backup.zip

# 2. 预览：看清楚会写入什么、插件增删情况
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop

# 3. 应用
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

**4. 安装插件**（归档不含 `node_modules`，第 3 步会打印完整命令）

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-pet@0.3.7
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mnemon@0.5.29
# …按第 3 步输出的清单逐个装
```

**5. 重启 DSH。**

## 备份类别

| 类别 | 默认 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `profile-config` | ✅ | `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`cordis.yml`、`cordis.patch.yml` 等 |
| `home-config` | ✅ | `storages/workspace.json`、`telemetry/` 等全局设置 |
| `plugin-state` | ✅ | 各插件在 `DSH_HOME` 下的状态目录 |
| `credentials` | ❌ | 登录凭据，需 `password`，AES-256-GCM 加密 |
| `sessions` | ❌ | 会话记录，体积大 |

## 安全说明

- 明文凭据**从不**进入归档。代码里有一条独立防线：任何成员名命中凭据模式都会直接报错中止，而不是默默写进去。
- `workbuddy-vault/` 存的是明文 token，它在 `plugin-state` 里会被自动排除并给出提示——这是实测发现的真实风险点。
- 加密用 scrypt（N=2¹⁵）派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM，口令错误或归档被篡改都会解密失败，不会还原出似是而非的内容。
- **忘记口令 = 凭据无法恢复**，需要在新电脑重新登录。

## 测试

```powershell
node --test test/          # 或直接：node test/sync.test.mjs
```

覆盖 ZIP 往返与损坏检测、加密往返与错误口令、清单排除规则、凭据隔离、预览不落盘、还原点、篡改检测和 CLI。

> 在受限沙箱里，涉及子进程的 4 个 CLI 用例会因 `spawn EPERM` 跳过——那是沙箱禁止管道 stdio，不是插件缺陷。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-config-sync/
├── bin/dsh-config-sync.mjs   # 独立 CLI（DSH 起不来时的救援通道）
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js              # 插件入口，注册 5 个工具
│   ├── inventory.js          # 决定备份什么（核心策略所在）
│   ├── archive.js            # 备份 / 预览 / 还原 / 校验
│   ├── crypto.js             # 口令加密
│   └── zip.js                # 零依赖 ZIP 读写
├── test/sync.test.mjs
└── cordis.patch.yml
```

零运行时依赖：ZIP 和加密都用 Node 内置模块实现，避免在"正在修环境"的机器上还要先装依赖。

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. plugins.description: GPT娘额度挂件 by Tokyo — Codex quota monitoring, editable replies and an original draggable mascot for DSH.
plugins.readme_text:
# GPT娘额度挂件

Tokyo · 1.5.1 · MIT 代码 / Tokyo 授权立绘 / CC0 音效与回复 · `dsh-gpt-niang-quota`

DSH 聊天界面的纯 DOM 陪伴挂件：角色默认位于输入框左侧，可拖动、缩放，点击切换回复气泡与 Codex 额度卡片。额度展示套餐、剩余比例与北京时间重置点，以 Codex 实际返回窗口为准。

![Tokyo 原创陪伴角色](assets/niang.png)

公开版使用 Tokyo 创作并授权随插件公开分发的龙娘立绘；合成音效与 12 句原创回复保持不变。不包含个人账户数据、真实额度截图或原应用提取的音效与语录库。

## 安装

发布并上架后，在 DSH 插件市场搜索包名，通过标准 bundle 安装并启用。也可交由 DSH 的插件管理工具安装：

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-gpt-niang-quota" }
```

启动型 profile 安装后重启 DSH。无需本地安装脚本，也无需手工编辑 profile。需要支持 `webServer`、`webserver/index-inject` 或 `tapIndex` 的 DSH 版本；聊天输入框 DOM 变化可能影响挂载与定位。

## 使用与设置

- 拖动角色移动；悬停显示缩小、放大、音效、刷新与设置按钮。Shift / Ctrl / ⌘ 加滚轮也可缩放。位置与缩放在当前浏览器中记忆。
- 单击角色在回复与额度之间切换，点击回复气泡换一句，点击空白或 Esc 收起。浏览器音频策略可能需要先进行一次用户交互；音效资源缺失时使用合成提示音。
- **设置 → 额度监控**：开启／关闭监控、控制额度角标、设置刷新间隔（15～3600 秒，默认 60 秒）。点击“保存”应用。关闭后停止新的自动查询，已在途请求仍可能完成。
- **手动程序路径**：自动检测失败时，填写运行 DSH 的机器上的 Codex 可执行文件绝对路径，单独点击“保存路径并检测”；留空保存恢复自动检测。“重新检测”仅确认文件，“刷新额度”验证登录与额度接口。手动路径失效时不会回退到其他程序。
- **设置 → 回复信息**：每行一句，直接增删改；保存后仅使用编辑框内容，留空即不显示回复。最多保存 200 句，每句 500 字；“恢复内置回复”填回发行包提供的回复，随后点击“保存”。发行包内置 12 句原创回复。

后台成功查询缓存 60 秒，即使前端间隔更短也可能得到缓存；“刷新”绕过缓存，同时进行的请求会合并。默认缩放 0.65、音量 0.4，通用提示语为“休息一下，再继续吧。”。

## 平台与账号边界

先在 Codex 中使用 ChatGPT 账号登录，并安装提供 `app-server --stdio` 的 Codex CLI／客户端。API Key 登录不提供订阅额度；不同账户或版本可能没有可展示窗口。

- macOS：检测 Codex.app、用户 daemon、PATH、Homebrew 与常见用户 bin。
- Windows：检测原生 `codex.exe`、用户 daemon、npm 原生包和可访问的 WindowsApps 布局；`.cmd` / `.bat` / `.ps1` 只用于解析固定 npm 原生路径，不通过 shell 执行。受保护目录或特殊安装位置可使用手动路径。
- Linux：检测用户 daemon、PATH 与常见用户／系统 bin。

路径发现含 x64／arm64 分支和平台虚拟文件系统测试，但不代表所有平台已完成真机验收。WSL、容器与远程 DSH 分别使用各自运行环境；浏览器所在电脑的 Codex 登录不会自动转移到 DSH 服务端。

## 隐私与本地存储

插件通过本地子进程发送 `initialize`、`account/read`（`refreshToken: false`）与 `account/rateLimits/read`，另发送初始化通知，不创建对话或请求模型生成。Codex 自身可能连接其官方服务；插件没有独立遥测或第三方上传端点。

插件不主动写入账户邮箱、账户 ID 或凭据，额度接口仅返回套餐、登录类型、额度窗口和查询状态，缓存保存在进程内存。手动程序路径保存在当前 DSH profile 的插件状态中，并通过受宿主访问控制保护的检测接口返回给设置页；本地路径仍属于隐私信息。客户端偏好、自定义回复与位置保存在当前站点的 localStorage（`dgn-cfg`、`dgn-pos`），不会由插件上传至服务端。卸载插件不会自动清除这些浏览器偏好或路径设置。

## 开发、许可与发行资源

```bash
npm run check
npm test
# 可选：Chrome 路径由 CHROME_PATH 指定；Node.js 需支持全局 WebSocket
npm run test:browser
```

源码沿用本地 gptniang-dsh，并参考 GPTNiangMac / Local GPT Niang Widget 与 dsh-whale-widget 的实现思路。保留原代码 MIT 署名；完整条款见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。该条款不将原应用角色、美术、音效或语录重新授权为 MIT。

龙娘立绘及衍生图标版权归 Tokyo，已授权随本插件、GitHub 仓库、npm 包和市场分发；保留署名与许可说明，不等于将立绘作为 CC0 素材或单独出售。合成提示音、回复文字采用 CC0 1.0，详见 [素材许可](assets/LICENSE.txt)。1.5.0 的占位 SVG 已替换，不是当前立绘的源图。回复格式为 `{ "quotes": [{ "text": "原创回复", "weight": 1 }] }`。

首次市场收录需目录维护者审核；公开仓库、npm 发布和目录收录是分别完成的步骤。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：对话标题工具，支持当前会话命名和历史会话重命名
plugins.readme_text:
# 对话标题工具 · DSH 插件

**插件类型：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。**

给 DeepSeek Harness 的模型侧工具：把对话命名成 `MMDD|类型|主题`。

| 工具 | 作用 | 底层路径 |
|---|---|---|
| `set_session_title(title, force?)` | 命名**当前**对话 | `ctx.sessionTitle.rename(session, title)`，直接写日志 |
| `rename_conversation(session_id, title, force?)` | 重命名**任意已有**对话（含已关闭的历史对话） | `ctx.sessionController.rename`，即 Web 侧栏改名同一条路径（会解析/恢复目标会话） |

两者的共同规则：

- 写入的是 `user` 来源的 `session/title` 事件，因此标题被「钉住」：harness 的自动标题（first-prompt provider）被取代，之后的用户消息也不会再自动改名。
- 格式校验 `^\d{4}\|(功能|设计|修复|优化|发布|探索|文档|研究)\|[^|]+$`，报错时附上规范说明。
- **字节上限预检**：上限从部署里挂载的标题服务读取（`ctx.get("sessionTitle").config.maxTitleBytes`）。超限会直接报错并给出实际字节数，避免被服务静默截断；`force: true` 表示"照写不误"，此时接受服务的安全截断。
- `force: true` 同时绕过格式与长度校验，只在用户明确要求非规范标题时使用。
- 子代理调用 `set_session_title` 时，若能取到存活 agent 注册表（`ctx.get("agents")`，惰性），会沿会话血缘上溯到仍然存活的父会话，改的是人在看的那个对话。

## 测试

```sh
node --import ./test/setup-stub.mjs --test ./test/title-tools.test.mjs   # 或 pnpm test
```

15 条用例覆盖：注册、当前会话改名、任意会话改名、格式拒绝、`force` 旁路、空标题、无 agent、子代理上溯、无存活父会话、字节上限（取自服务 / 回退默认）、控制器缺失、以及规则函数本身。测试通过 `test/setup-stub.mjs` 把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 指向桩模块，因此不需要 harness 安装即可运行。

> 桩只透传定义对象；真实 `defineTool` 的 schema 转换由"启动验证"覆盖（见下）。

## 实现要点（踩过的坑）

- `inject` 只能列 **profile 根作用域** 存在的服务。本插件用 `["tools", "sessionTitle"]`。
  早期版本把 `agents` 也写进 `inject`，而该服务在 preset 作用域里才组装，profile 层插件永远等不到它、`apply` 从不执行，工具也就永远不注册。agent 注册表改为在 `execute` 里惰性取用。
- 安装形态必须是 **真实包目录**：`link:`（软链到工作区）在运行中的进程里不会成为包解析拦截层；用 tarball 安装进 profile 的 `node_modules` 才可靠（与 dshmarket 等一致）。
- 替换已安装的包后热更 **不会** 换掉进程里已缓存的模块代：必须重启 Harness 才会加载新代码。

## 运行时已知边界

- **热更不 import 新模块**：profile 配置重载只重新应用 patch，不会 import 新插入行的模块（新文件的新 URL 也不行）——新工具一律等一次重启。
- `rename_conversation` 对**正被另一个进程持有的活跃会话**会被拒绝（`already owned by an active write handle`）：这种对话在 Web 侧栏改名，或让那个对话自己的 agent 调 `set_session_title`（同进程即可）。
- **子代理会话**（`parentSession` 血缘、侧栏隐藏）被服务层拒绝（`owned by subagent routing`），属设计内行为。
- 跨进程只追加标题事件时，磁盘投影缓存（`storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`）不一定刷新；同进程改名会自动刷新。

## 安装 / 升级

```sh
# 1. 在包目录打包
cd <repo>/dsh-tool-set-session-title
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/vendor
pnpm pack --pack-destination ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/vendor     # 产出 <name>-<version>.tgz

# 2. 在 profile 目录安装（相对路径，保持 profile 自包含）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add ./vendor/dsh-tool-set-session-title-<version>.tgz

# 3. 首次安装还要把包名追加进 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles

# 4. 重启 Harness 让新模块代生效
```

说明：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 被 CLI 显式拒绝（desktop profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理），所以走 pnpm；Web 侧栏 **插件 → 添加插件** 也接受本地绝对路径/压缩包，但要注意 `link:` 形态的坑（见上）。

自包含校验：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 在 profile 目录应当直接 `Already up to date`（已验证）。

## 验证

- 会话里让模型调用两个工具，标题应立刻变成新值，且此后不再被自动标题覆盖。
- 侧栏 **插件** 页能看到组合包 `dsh-tool-set-session-title`。
- 启动验证（schema 转换等只有真实运行才能覆盖）：复制 profile 到隔离的 `DSH_HOME`，用 `--profile <副本> --no-open --port 0` 起一次性实例，确认工具注册且行为正确，再销毁。

## 卸载

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm remove dsh-tool-set-session-title
# 并从 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 移除该名字
```

然后重启。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|

plugins.description: Live per-session cost badge for DeepSeek Harness (top-right), with peak/off-peak (time-of-day) pricing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-cost-meter

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2ea44f)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts a **live cost badge in the conversation header (top-right)** and prices every request with **peak / off-peak (time-of-day) tiers**.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Session title                                [¥0.0042]      │   ← badge here
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  … conversation …                                            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Features

- **Live** — the badge updates as the host reports provider usage; no polling, no timers.
- **Historically correct** — each request is priced by its **own wall-clock timestamp**, so a session that spans peak and off-peak stays accurate even if the page sits open overnight.
- **Weekday-aware peak tiers** — DeepSeek bills peak only **Monday–Friday**; weekends are off-peak all day. The schedule is configurable (windows, weekdays, multiplier, time zone).
- **Silent price sync** — a bundled price catalog plus an out-of-band remote catalog refreshed on an interval. Push a new `catalog/prices.json` and every installed copy picks it up **without a plugin release**; a failed refresh keeps the last good rates.
- **Explicit peak/off-peak rates** — models may carry an explicit discounted pair (`cacheMiss` + `cacheMissOffPeak`), not just a multiplier.
- **Route-aware matching** — `provider/model`, `provider/*`, `*`-model wildcards, and case/space/punctuation-insensitive model ids.
- **Never fakes a number** — an unpriced route renders `未配置` (`unpriced`) instead of a made-up fallback rate.

## Install

### From npm (recommended)

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-cost-meter
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` activates it as a profile layer automatically — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

### From a local checkout

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:E:/path/to/dsh-plugin-cost-meter"
```

`link:` keeps the checkout live, so edits apply after a `dsh web` restart without reinstalling.

Restart the server afterwards:

```cmd
dsh web
```

## Configure

The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row with defaults. Override it by adding a `cost-meter` row with the same `id` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: cost-meter
      name: dsh-plugin-cost-meter
      config:
        currency: CNY                 # display currency; empty = catalog currency
        fx:
          cnyPerUsd: 7.1              # used when the catalog is USD and you display CNY
        catalogUrl: ""                # "" = this package's own catalog (derived from repository)
        refreshMinutes: 360           # silent refresh interval; 0 disables it
        pricingTimeoutMs: 4000
        pricingUrl: ""                # optional legacy { models, default } document
        models:                       # manual overrides (highest priority, display currency)
          deepseek-official/deepseek-flash:
            inputPerM: 1.06           # off-peak base
            cacheReadPerM: 0.021
            cacheWritePerM: 1.06
            outputPerM: 4.26
        default:                      # optional fallback; omit to report unknown routes as unpriced
          inputPerM: 1
          outputPerM: 4
        peak:
          enabled: true
          multiplier: 2               # used only when a rate has no explicit off-peak value
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: 480  # UTC+8
          days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]       # ISO weekdays; weekends are off-peak
          windows: [[9, 12], [14, 18]]
```

Two rate styles are accepted everywhere:

- **Catalog style** (peak base + optional off-peak): `cacheMiss`, `cacheHit`, `cacheWrite`, `output`, and `cacheMissOffPeak`, `cacheHitOffPeak`, `cacheWriteOffPeak`, `outputOffPeak`.
- **Legacy style** (off-peak base): `inputPerM`, `cacheReadPerM`, `cacheWritePerM`, `outputPerM` (with optional `*Peak` fields).

## Automatic price updates

Prices resolve in this order (highest wins):

1. `config.models` / `config.default`
2. `config.pricingUrl` (legacy document)
3. the **remote catalog** at `config.catalogUrl` — default: this package's own `catalog/prices.json` on GitHub, derived from `package.json.repository`
4. the **bundled** `catalog/prices.json` (offline fallback)

A timer re-reads the remote catalog and `pricingUrl` every `refreshMinutes` (default 6 hours) and swaps the live table in place:

- a failed refresh **keeps the last successful data**;
- a source that never loaded does not clear anything;
- **historical amounts are frozen**: a sample is priced when it is folded and the amount is stored, so a price change applies only to samples folded after it — a past session's total is never rewritten;
- the frozen amounts ride the persisted projection cache, so they survive restarts; only a cold replay without a checkpoint prices the log at the then-current table.

This makes the catalog the single place to maintain rates: **edit and push `catalog/prices.json`, and installed copies update themselves** — no new plugin release. Forks get their own update channel automatically because the default URL is derived from `package.json.repository`.

To point at a private mirror or a local file, set `catalogUrl` (`https://…`, a path, or `file:///…`). Set it to `""` to disable remote syncing.

## Peak / off-peak

- Tiering uses the **request's own `event.time`**, never "now".
- Peak applies only on the configured weekdays (`days`, default Monday–Friday); weekends are off-peak all day.
- The schedule comes from the catalog's `peakSchedule` (time zone, days, windows, off-peak ratio) and can be overridden field by field in `config.peak`.
- `peak.enabled: false` bills one flat rate; `peak.timezoneOffsetMinutes` shifts the wall clock for the window check.

The hover tooltip shows the current tier, the multiplier, the route, and the token breakdown.

## Pricing model

```
cost = Σ_routes [ cost_off(route) + cost_peak(route) ]

cost_tier(route) = (uncachedInput × miss
                  + cacheRead     × hit
                  + cacheWrite    × write
                  + output        × out) / 1_000_000
```

Totals are accumulated per `{ provider, model }` route and per tier, so switching models mid-session keeps each route on its own price. A repeated usage sample for the same `(turn, step)` replaces the earlier one instead of double-counting.

## Compatibility

| Surface | DSH ≤ 0.1.0-rc.6 | DSH ≥ 0.1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| Projection contract | `schema` + `view` | `stateSchema` + `wire: { viewSchema, view }` |
| Client deps | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` |
| Compatibility gate | — | `engines.dsh` / `peerDependencies` must satisfy the running version |

The badge uses the additive `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot; `…header.corner` is a `single` slot already occupied by a shipped plugin.

## Development

```cmd
npm install
npm test
```

`test/contract.test.mjs` covers the projection contract, weekday peak, catalog parsing, explicit dual rates, currency conversion, normalization/wildcards, unpriced routes, and manual overrides. It runs offline (`catalogUrl: ""`).

## Notes

- Costs are **estimates**: they depend on the provider-reported `usage` and on the price table.
- The badge is **per session**; it does not aggregate sub-sessions or the whole account.
- The bundled catalog is a dated snapshot — verify it against the [official pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) and update `catalog/prices.json` when rates change.
- The plugin is a Web surface plugin; compositions without `sessionProjections` (e.g. headless) skip registration.

## Li

plugins.description: DSH community plugin: ask any set of models to draw a pelican riding a bicycle on a schedule, then lay every drawing out on a read-only board. No scoring — the pictures are the result. Pausable, with a settable interval.
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A DeepSeek Harness **community plugin** that runs a long-term
**model-quality probe** (降智监测) on a schedule, across **any number of
models**:

- **Pick your models** — the gear in the panel's top-right corner lists every model the
  configured providers report (live `/models` discovery, merged with the models
  in your DSH profile) and probes a multi-selected set, each model through its
  own provider and API key.
- **Scheduled drawing** — every 30 minutes (configurable) each selected model is
  asked to draw an **animated** *pelican riding a bicycle*: a single-file HTML
  page with an inline SVG whose motion is SVG declarative animation (`<animate>`
  / `<animateTransform>`).
- **No skills, no tools** — each run is a bare `chat/completions` request with
  no tool definitions and no agent loop, so the result measures the model
  alone, never your local skills.
- **Everything flat, nothing to click** — the main board is read-only: one band
  per model, its status and figures on the left (when its newest drawing landed,
  runs, average duration, how many came back without a drawing, and the failure
  reason) and every drawing it ever made on the right, all laid out at once —
  nothing collapsed, filtered, or hidden behind a click.
- **Run state in the header** — while probing: “n/m done”, which models are in
  flight, how long the slowest has waited (m:ss) and the timeout cap (m:ss), so a
  slow model and a stuck one are told apart at a glance.
- **One gear button** — the panel's own top-right corner opens a settings sheet:
  pick models, pause or retune the schedule, stop the pass, see one drawing
  bigger. The board below stays pure viewing, so nothing has to be clicked to be
  read. To probe **one** model, press 「单独检测」 on its band: one request for
  that model — and several bands can be probing at the same time.
- **Stop it, retune it** — that same sheet can **pause / resume automatic
  probing**, change the **interval** (1–1440 minutes), and **stop the pass that is
  running right now**: requests in flight are aborted, models that had not started
  are skipped without a request being sent. Pausing is written to
  `settings.json` immediately and survives a restart, so a plugin you only probe
  by hand never costs a token on its own.
- **Bounded history** — keeps the newest N drawings **per model** (10 by
  default); the cap never gets divided between the models you are probing, and
  two providers serving the same model id keep separate histories. Same prompt,
  same model, over days: degradation shows up as worse structure, refusals
  (saved and badged 「未检出 SVG」), or latency growth.

## Install

From this GitHub repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch.git
```

Or from a local path or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pelican-watch
```

Note: `link:`-installed plugins are not watched by HMR, so editing
`lib/index.js` or `lib/client.js` requires an app restart to take effect.

## Choosing models

The gear in the panel's top-right corner opens the settings sheet, which lists
**every provider route registered in DSH** — the signed-in 「DeepSeek 账号」
account, the official API-key route, and any third-party provider you configured
— grouped by the display name DSH uses, each with the models it advertises. Tick
any number of models and **Save models**: from the next cycle on each selected
model draws its own picture and gets its own band on the board.

**The board shows exactly the selected models**, in the order they were saved —
a band never jumps around. Unticking a model and saving **deletes its drawings**:
anything the board cannot show is only invisible dead weight on disk, and these
probe drawings are meant to be re-drawn anyway. The save toast says how many went.

A model id is not unique: the signed-in account and a third-party provider can
both serve `deepseek-flash`. A band is therefore a **provider + model** pair, and
it carries the provider's display name next to the model name — two providers
never share one band, nor one another's drawings.

The plugin never touches key material: calls go through DSH's model service
(`ctx.llm`), which resolves the credential itself. That is why the
account-backed provider (no API key at all, just a signed-in account) can be
probed here, and why any provider that works in DSH works here. A provider that
cannot list its models (not signed in, expired key) still appears, with the
reason attached.

That selection lives in `dir/settings.json` and is what the scheduler uses;
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the first run. The same file holds
two knobs that decide what you spend, both changeable from the panel's gear
without touching any config file:

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoEnabled` | `true` | Off disarms the timer at once (`nextRunAt` goes empty); only the manual “probe now” then spends anything, and the choice survives a restart. |
| `intervalMinutes` | follows `config.intervalMinutes` (30) | Changing it in the panel re-arms the countdown immediately — no restart. |
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the very first run. At most 12
models are probed per cycle — `concurrency` of them at the same time (3 by
default), one drawing each.

## Speed and timeouts

- **Models run in parallel** (3 at a time by default), so one slow model no
  longer delays the others: every drawing is written to disk the moment it
  arrives and shows up in the panel within seconds.
- **Each request has its own timeout** (`timeoutSeconds`, default 600). A model
  that exceeds it is reported as `超过 N 秒没有返回` on its own band instead of
  hanging the whole pass. Reasoning models can genuinely be slow — measured
  against one provider: `qwen3.7-max` ~52s, `deepseek-flash` ~121s (15k of those
  completion tokens were reasoning), while `glm-5.3-flash` sometimes exceeded
  4 minutes.
- **A timeout or HTTP error is not a drawing**: nothing is saved and it does not
  count as a drawing, because that is an infrastructure fact rather than model
  behaviour. A model that *answers* without an SVG (a refusal) is saved and
  marked `没出图` — that is the signal worth looking at.
- `maxTokens` is not sent by default: reasoning models spend tens of thousands of
  completion tokens before they draw, and a tight ceiling would truncate the SVG
  instead of speeding anything up.
- **A truncated drawing is reported as such**: when the answer stops at the
  output ceiling (an `<svg>` without its closing tag), the band says
  「回答被截断（已输出 N tokens）：SVG 没有画完，多半是达到模型的输出上限」 instead of the
  vague 「未检出 SVG」, and the half-drawn page is not kept as history. Raise
  `maxTokens` in the config to give a verbose model more room.

## Configuration

Defaults match the usual profile setup; override any of them on a
`pelican-watch` row in your profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: pelican-watch
  config:
    # initial selection (the panel's picker wins once used)
    provider: deepseek-account           # a DSH provider route; account by default
    model: deepseek-flash                # model id
    # targets:                           # optional: seed several models at once
    #   - { provider: deepseek-account, model: deepseek-flash }
    #   - { provider: taotoken, model: glm-5.3-flash }
    intervalMinutes: 30                  # drawing cadence
    maxImages: 10                        # drawings kept per model (1–100; ≈5h at 30min)
    timeoutSeconds: 600                  # per-request ceiling (5–3600); lower it if a model hangs
    concurrency: 3                       # how many models are probed at once
    # maxTokens: 8192                    # optional; unset by default (see below)
    dir: ~/.dsh/pelican-watch            # where drawings are saved
    runOnStart: true                     # draw once ~8s after boot
    # temperature: 0.7                   # optional; omitted by default
    # prompt: …                          # only if you must change the benchmark
```
